xmls: <Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nia/2011/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2011/5" NumberOfProvisions="22" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2023-01-02"><Primary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nia/2011/5/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2011/5/body" NumberOfProvisions="18" RestrictStartDate="2023-01-02"><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nia/2011/5/crossheading/waste" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2011/5/crossheading/waste" NumberOfProvisions="10" id="crossheading-waste" RestrictStartDate="2023-01-02"><Title><Emphasis>Waste</Emphasis></Title><P1group RestrictStartDate="2023-01-02"><Title>Powers to require removal of waste unlawfully deposited</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nia/2011/5/section/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2011/5/section/4" id="section-4"><Pnumber PuncAfter=""><CommentaryRef Ref="key-042118"/>4</Pnumber><P1para><Text>For Articles 28 and 28A of the 1997 Order substitute—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default"><P1group><Title>Power to require removal of waste unlawfully deposited</Title><P1><Pnumber PuncAfter="">28</Pnumber><P1para><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>If any controlled waste is deposited in or on any land in contravention of Article 4(1), an enforcing authority may, by notice served on him, require the appropriate person to do either or both of the following, that is—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to remove the waste from the land within a specified period not less than a period of 21 days from the service of the notice;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>to take within such a period specified steps with a view to eliminating or reducing the consequences of the deposit of the waste.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A person on whom any requirements are imposed under paragraph (1) may, within the period of 21 days mentioned in that paragraph, appeal against the requirement to a court of summary jurisdiction.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>On any appeal under paragraph (2) the court shall quash the requirement if it is satisfied that—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the appellant neither deposited nor knowingly caused nor knowingly permitted the deposit of the waste;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>there is a material defect in the notice; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in order to comply with the requirement the appellant would be required to enter the land unlawfully;</Text></P3para></P3><Text>and in any other case shall either modify the requirement or dismiss the appeal.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where a person appeals against any requirement imposed under paragraph (1), the requirement shall be of no effect pending the determination of the appeal; and where the court modifies the requirement or dismisses the appeal it may extend the period specified in the notice.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>If a person on whom a requirement has been imposed under paragraph (1) fails, without reasonable excuse, to comply with the requirement he shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on summary conviction to a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>If in the case of a continuing offence under paragraph (5), the offender continues to fail to comply with the requirement he shall be guilty of a further offence and shall be liable on summary conviction to an additional fine not exceeding one-tenth of level 5 on the standard scale for each day on which the offence is continued and before the enforcing authority has begun to exercise its powers under paragraph (7).</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where a person on whom a requirement has been imposed under paragraph (1) by an enforcing authority fails to comply with the requirement, the enforcing authority may do what that person was required to do and may recover from him any expenses reasonably incurred by the enforcing authority in doing it.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>8</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In this Article and Articles 28A and 28B  “<Term>enforcing authority</Term>” means—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the Department; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in relation to land in its district, a district council.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group><Title>The  “appropriate person”</Title><P1><Pnumber PuncAfter="">28A</Pnumber><P1para><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Subject to the following provisions of this Article, the appropriate person in relation to any deposit of waste in or on any land is the person (“D”) who deposited the waste.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Unless paragraph (3) applies, the appropriate person is the occupier of the land if—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>D cannot be identified or cannot be found without the enforcing authority incurring unreasonable expense; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the enforcing authority has served a notice under Article 28(1) imposing a requirement on D and—</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>D has failed to comply with that requirement within the period specified in the notice; or</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>that requirement has been quashed on the ground specified in Article 28(3)(a).</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The appropriate person is the owner of the land if—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>there is no occupier of the land or the occupier cannot be found without the enforcing authority incurring unreasonable expense; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the enforcing authority has served a notice under Article 28(1) imposing a requirement on the occupier of the land and—</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>the occupier has failed to comply with that requirement within the period specified in the notice; or</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>that requirement has been quashed on the ground specified in Article 28(3)(a).</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>This Article applies for the purposes of Article 28.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A notice under Article 28(1) which may be served—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>by virtue of paragraph (1) may not be served by virtue of paragraph (2) or (3);</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>by virtue of paragraph (2) may not be served by virtue of paragraph (3).</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Reserve powers of enforcing authority</Title><P1><Pnumber PuncAfter="">28B</Pnumber><P1para><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>If it appears to an enforcing authority that waste has been deposited in or on any land in contravention of Article 4(1) and that—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in order to remove or prevent pollution of land, water or air or harm to human health it is necessary that the waste be forthwith removed or other steps taken to eliminate or reduce the consequences of the deposit or both, or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>there is no occupier of the land, or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the occupier neither made nor knowingly permitted the deposit of the waste,</Text></P3para></P3><Text>the enforcing authority may remove the waste from the land or take other steps to eliminate or reduce the consequences of the deposit or, as the case may require, to remove the waste and take those steps.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where an enforcing authority exercises any of the powers conferred on it by paragraph (1) it may recover any costs necessarily incurred by it in removing the waste or taking the steps or both and in disposing of the waste—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>from the person who deposited the waste; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>if that person cannot be identified or cannot be found without the enforcing authority incurring unreasonable expense—</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>in a case falling within paragraph (1)(a), from the occupier of the land,</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>in a case falling within paragraph (1)(b) or (c), from the owner of the land, unless (in either case) he proves that he neither made nor knowingly caused nor knowingly permitted the deposit of the waste.</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Any waste removed by an enforcing authority under paragraph (1) shall belong to the enforcing authority and may be dealt with accordingly.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock></Body></Primary></Legislation>

                    ”</InlineAmendment>;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nia/2016/7/schedule/2/paragraph/5/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2016/7/schedule/2/paragraph/5/3/b" id="schedule-2-paragraph-5-3-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in sub-paragraph (b), after  “lateral drain”, in the first place those words occur, insert <InlineAmendment>“

                    ”</InlineAmendment>;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nia/2016/7/schedule/2/paragraph/5/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2016/7/schedule/2/paragraph/5/3/c" id="schedule-2-paragraph-5-3-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in sub-paragraph (b), for  “or lateral drain” substitute <InlineAmendment>“
                      , lateral drain or system
                    ”</InlineAmendment>;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nia/2016/7/schedule/2/paragraph/5/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2016/7/schedule/2/paragraph/5/3/d" id="schedule-2-paragraph-5-3-d"><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in the words following sub-paragraph (b), after  “or the lateral drain” insert <InlineAmendment>“

                    ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nia/2016/7/schedule/2/paragraph/5/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nia/2016/7/schedule/2/paragraph/5/4" id="schedule-2-paragraph-5-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In paragraph (4)(a), for  “or lateral drain” substitute <InlineAmendment>“

IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5" id="article-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/1" id="article-5-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Water (Northern Ireland) Order 1999 (<Acronym Expansion="Northern Ireland">NI</Acronym> 6) is amended as follows.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/2" id="article-5-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For Article 20 substitute—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default"><P1group><Title>Abstraction and impounding of water</Title><P1><Pnumber>20</Pnumber><P1para><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Subject to paragraph (2), the Department may by regulations make such provision as appears to it to be expedient for the purpose of—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>controlling, restricting or prohibiting the abstraction of water from underground strata or waterways;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>controlling, restricting or prohibiting the construction, alteration or operation of any impounding works.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Regulations under paragraph (1) shall not apply to a person who—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>holds a licence under Article 10(1)(a) of the Electricity (Northern Ireland) Order 1992 (licences to supply electricity, <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation>); and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>is acting in accordance with an authorisation obtained from the Department under paragraph 2 of Schedule 5 to that Order (abstraction, diversion and use of water for hydro-electric generating stations).</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1), regulations under that paragraph may include provision—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>prohibiting the abstraction of water except in pursuance of a licence granted by the Department and in accordance with the provisions of that licence;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>prohibiting the construction, alteration or operation of impounding works except in pursuance of a licence granted by the Department and in accordance with the provisions of that licence;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the issue, variation, transfer, review, surrender, suspension or revocation by the Department of any such licence as is mentioned in sub-paragraph (a) or (b);</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>as to the manner in which applications for the issue, variation, transfer, surrender or revocation of any such licence as is mentioned in sub-paragraph (a) or (b) are to be dealt with, including provision requiring the giving of notices of, and information relating to, the making of such applications or decisions on any such applications;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>e</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for authorising or requiring the carrying out of works by a person carrying on an activity mentioned in paragraph (1)(a) or (b), including provision—</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>for access to, and the carrying out of such works on, land owned or occupied by another person;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>for, or in connection with, the payment of compensation to that other person;</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>f</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for, and in connection with, the holding of public local inquiries in prescribed circumstances;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>g</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the payment, in such circumstances as may be prescribed, of compensation where any such licence as is mentioned in sub-paragraph (a) or (b) is varied, suspended, or revoked;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>h</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for appeals to the Appeals Commission against prescribed decisions of the Department taken under or for the purposes of the regulations (including provision applying with or without modification any statutory provision relating to appeals to that Commission);</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for ensuring the taking of steps by way of preventative or remedial action where there is a contravention of any of the regulations, including provision—</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>enabling the Department to require prescribed persons to take such steps;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>for the enforcement by the Department of any such requirement;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>iii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>for the taking of those steps by the Department in prescribed circumstances;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>iv</Pnumber><P4para><Text>in relation to the bearing or recovery of the cost of taking any such steps;</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>j</Pnumber><P3para><Text>creating offences punishable —</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>on summary conviction, with a fine not exceeding £20,000 and, in the case of a continuing offence, with a fine not exceeding £200 for each day during which the offence is continued after conviction;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>on indictment, with a fine or with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 5 years, or both; and</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>k</Pnumber><P3para><Text>conferring on courts power, on conviction of a person of such an offence, to order the taking by that person of steps by way of remedial action.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where regulations made under this Article include provisions prohibiting the construction, alteration or operation of impounding works except in pursuance of a licence granted by the Department and in accordance with the provisions of that licence, the Department shall consult the Department of Agriculture and Rural Development before issuing such a licence.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>References in this Article to a waterway shall not include references to any adit or passage constructed in connection with a well, borehole or other similar work for facilitating the collection of water in the well, borehole or work.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Any reference in this Article to the doing of anything in pursuance of such a licence as is mentioned in paragraph (3)(a) or (b) is a reference to its being done—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>by the holder of such a licence; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>by a person acting as a servant or agent of, or otherwise under the authority of, the holder of such a licence,</Text></P3para></P3><Text>at a time when the licence is in force and in circumstances such that, if no such licence were in force, the doing of that thing would contravene a restriction imposed by regulations made under this Article.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In this Article and in Article 21,  “<Term>impounding works</Term>” means—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any dam, weir or other works in any waterway by which water may be impounded; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any works for diverting the flow of any waterway in connection with the construction or alteration of any such dam, weir or other works.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3" id="article-5-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 21 (1)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3/a" id="article-5-3-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for  “or alteration” substitute  “, alteration or operation”;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3/b" id="article-5-3-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in sub-paragraph (a) for  “or transfer” substitute  “, surrender or transfer”.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/4" id="article-5-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 27(4) after  “discharge consent” insert  “or a licence mentioned in Article 20(3)(a) or (b)”.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/5" id="article-5-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 27(6)(a)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/5/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/5/a" id="article-5-5-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>after  “discharge consent” insert  “or a licence mentioned in Article 20(3)
								(a) or (b)”;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/5/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/5/b" id="article-5-5-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>after  “consent” insert  “or licence”.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/6" id="article-5-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 28 after paragraph (1) insert—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>1A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Department may give directions requiring any person who is operating any impounding works to give such information to the Department as to the operation of those works, at such times and in such form, as may be specified in the directions.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/7" id="article-5-7"><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 28(2), (3) and (4) after  “(1)” insert  “or (1A)”.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8" id="article-5-8"><Pnumber>8</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 29(b)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8/a" id="article-5-8-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>after  “discharge consent” insert  “or any licence mentioned in Article 20(3)
								(a) or (b)”; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8/b" id="article-5-8-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for  “variation of such a consent” substitute  “variation, transfer or surrender of such a consent or licence”.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/9" id="article-5-9"><Pnumber>9</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 30 (1) after sub-paragraph (o) insert—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default"><P3><Pnumber>oa</Pnumber><P3para><Text>such matters relating to the abstraction or impounding of water as may be prescribed;</Text></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/10" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/10" id="article-5-10"><Pnumber>10</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 32(2) after  “to the Department” insert  “under regulations under Article 20 or”.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/11" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/11" id="article-5-11"><Pnumber>11</Pnumber><P2para><Text><CommentaryRef Ref="c1954190"/>. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Part></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/2" id="article-5-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For Article 20 substitute—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default"><P1group><Title>Abstraction and impounding of water</Title><P1><Pnumber>20</Pnumber><P1para><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Subject to paragraph (2), the Department may by regulations make such provision as appears to it to be expedient for the purpose of—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>controlling, restricting or prohibiting the abstraction of water from underground strata or waterways;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>controlling, restricting or prohibiting the construction, alteration or operation of any impounding works.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Regulations under paragraph (1) shall not apply to a person who—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>holds a licence under Article 10(1)(a) of the Electricity (Northern Ireland) Order 1992 (licences to supply electricity, <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation>); and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>is acting in accordance with an authorisation obtained from the Department under paragraph 2 of Schedule 5 to that Order (abstraction, diversion and use of water for hydro-electric generating stations).</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1), regulations under that paragraph may include provision—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>prohibiting the abstraction of water except in pursuance of a licence granted by the Department and in accordance with the provisions of that licence;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>prohibiting the construction, alteration or operation of impounding works except in pursuance of a licence granted by the Department and in accordance with the provisions of that licence;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the issue, variation, transfer, review, surrender, suspension or revocation by the Department of any such licence as is mentioned in sub-paragraph (a) or (b);</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>as to the manner in which applications for the issue, variation, transfer, surrender or revocation of any such licence as is mentioned in sub-paragraph (a) or (b) are to be dealt with, including provision requiring the giving of notices of, and information relating to, the making of such applications or decisions on any such applications;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>e</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for authorising or requiring the carrying out of works by a person carrying on an activity mentioned in paragraph (1)(a) or (b), including provision—</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>for access to, and the carrying out of such works on, land owned or occupied by another person;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>for, or in connection with, the payment of compensation to that other person;</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>f</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for, and in connection with, the holding of public local inquiries in prescribed circumstances;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>g</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the payment, in such circumstances as may be prescribed, of compensation where any such licence as is mentioned in sub-paragraph (a) or (b) is varied, suspended, or revoked;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>h</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for appeals to the Appeals Commission against prescribed decisions of the Department taken under or for the purposes of the regulations (including provision applying with or without modification any statutory provision relating to appeals to that Commission);</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for ensuring the taking of steps by way of preventative or remedial action where there is a contravention of any of the regulations, including provision—</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>enabling the Department to require prescribed persons to take such steps;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>for the enforcement by the Department of any such requirement;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>iii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>for the taking of those steps by the Department in prescribed circumstances;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>iv</Pnumber><P4para><Text>in relation to the bearing or recovery of the cost of taking any such steps;</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>j</Pnumber><P3para><Text>creating offences punishable —</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>on summary conviction, with a fine not exceeding £20,000 and, in the case of a continuing offence, with a fine not exceeding £200 for each day during which the offence is continued after conviction;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>on indictment, with a fine or with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 5 years, or both; and</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>k</Pnumber><P3para><Text>conferring on courts power, on conviction of a person of such an offence, to order the taking by that person of steps by way of remedial action.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where regulations made under this Article include provisions prohibiting the construction, alteration or operation of impounding works except in pursuance of a licence granted by the Department and in accordance with the provisions of that licence, the Department shall consult the Department of Agriculture and Rural Development before issuing such a licence.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>References in this Article to a waterway shall not include references to any adit or passage constructed in connection with a well, borehole or other similar work for facilitating the collection of water in the well, borehole or work.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Any reference in this Article to the doing of anything in pursuance of such a licence as is mentioned in paragraph (3)(a) or (b) is a reference to its being done—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>by the holder of such a licence; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>by a person acting as a servant or agent of, or otherwise under the authority of, the holder of such a licence,</Text></P3para></P3><Text>at a time when the licence is in force and in circumstances such that, if no such licence were in force, the doing of that thing would contravene a restriction imposed by regulations made under this Article.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In this Article and in Article 21,  “<Term>impounding works</Term>” means—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any dam, weir or other works in any waterway by which water may be impounded; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any works for diverting the flow of any waterway in connection with the construction or alteration of any such dam, weir or other works.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3" 								(a) or (b)”;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/5/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/5/b" id="article-5-5-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>after  “consent” insert  “or licence”.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/6" id="article-5-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 28 after paragraph (1) insert—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>1A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Department may give directions requiring any person who is operating any impounding works to give such information to the Department as to the operation of those works, at such times and in such form, as may be specified in the directions.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/7" id="article-5-7"><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 28(2), (3) and (4) after  “(1)” insert  “or (1A)”.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8" id="article-5-8"><Pnumber>8</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 29(b)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8/a" id="article-5-8-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>after  “discharge consent” insert  “or any licence mentioned in Article 20(3)
								(a) or (b)”; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8/b" id="article-5-8-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for  “variation of such a consent” substitute  “variation, transfer or surrender of such a consent or licence”.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/9" id="article-5-9"><Pnumber>9</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 30 (1) after sub-paragraph (o) insert—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default"><P3><Pnumber>oa</Pnumber><P3para><Text>such matters relating to the abstraction or impounding of water as may be prescribed;</Text></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/10" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/10" id="article-5-10"><Pnumber>10</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 32(2) after  “to the Department” insert  “under regulations under Article 20 or”.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/11" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/11" id="article-5-11"><Pnumber>11</Pnumber><P2para><Text><CommentaryRef Ref="c1954190"/>. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Part></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946" NumberOfProvisions="6" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2007-04-01"><Title>Abstraction and impounding of water</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5" id="article-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/1" id="article-5-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Water (Northern Ireland) Order 1999 (<Acronym Expansion="Northern Ireland">NI</Acronym> 6) is amended as follows.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/2" id="article-5-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For Article 20 substitute—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default"><P1group><Title>Abstraction and impounding of water</Title><P1><Pnumber>20</Pnumber><P1para><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Subject to paragraph (2), the Department may by regulations make such provision as appears to it to be expedient for the purpose of—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>controlling, restricting or prohibiting the abstraction of water from underground strata or waterways;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>controlling, restricting or prohibiting the construction, alteration or operation of any impounding works.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Regulations under paragraph (1) shall not apply to a person who—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>holds a licence under Article 10(1)(a) of the Electricity (Northern Ireland) Order 1992 (licences to supply electricity, <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation>); and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>is acting in accordance with an authorisation obtained from the Department under paragraph 2 of Schedule 5 to that Order (abstraction, diversion and use of water for hydro-electric generating stations).</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1), regulations under that paragraph may include provision—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>prohibiting the abstraction of water except in pursuance of a licence granted by the Department and in accordance with the provisions of that licence;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>prohibiting the construction, alteration or operation of impounding works except in pursuance of a licence granted by the Department and in accordance with the provisions of that licence;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the issue, variation, transfer, review, surrender, suspension or revocation by the Department of any such licence as is mentioned in sub-paragraph (a) or (b);</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>as to the manner in which applications for the issue, variation, transfer, surrender or revocation of any such licence as is mentioned in sub-paragraph (a) or (b) are to be dealt with, including provision requiring the giving of notices of, and information relating to, the making of such applications or decisions on any such applications;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>e</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for authorising or requiring the carrying out of works by a person carrying on an activity mentioned in paragraph (1)(a) or (b), including provision—</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>for access to, and the carrying out of such works on, land owned or occupied by another person;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>for, or in connection with, the payment of compensation to that other person;</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>f</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for, and in connection with, the holding of public local inquiries in prescribed circumstances;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>g</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the payment, in such circumstances as may be prescribed, of compensation where any such licence as is mentioned in sub-paragraph (a) or (b) is varied, suspended, or revoked;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>h</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for appeals to the Appeals Commission against prescribed decisions of the Department taken under or for the purposes of the regulations (including provision applying with or without modification any statutory provision relating to appeals to that Commission);</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for ensuring the taking of steps by way of preventative or remedial action where there is a contravention of any of the regulations, including provision—</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>enabling the Department to require prescribed persons to take such steps;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>for the enforcement by the Department of any such requirement;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>iii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>for the taking of those steps by the Department in prescribed circumstances;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>iv</Pnumber><P4para><Text>in relation to the bearing or recovery of the cost of taking any such steps;</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>j</Pnumber><P3para><Text>creating offences punishable —</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>on summary conviction, with a fine not exceeding £20,000 and, in the case of a continuing offence, with a fine not exceeding £200 for each day during which the offence is continued after conviction;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>on indictment, with a fine or with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 5 years, or both; and</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>k</Pnumber><P3para><Text>conferring on courts power, on conviction of a person of such an offence, to order the taking by that person of steps by way of remedial action.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where regulations made under this Article include provisions prohibiting the construction, alteration or operation of impounding works except in pursuance of a licence granted by the Department and in accordance with the provisions of that licence, the Department shall consult the Department of Agriculture and Rural Development before issuing such a licence.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>References in this Article to a waterway shall not include references to any adit or passage constructed in connection with a well, borehole or other similar work for facilitating the collection of water in the well, borehole or work.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Any reference in this Article to the doing of anything in pursuance of such a licence as is mentioned in paragraph (3)(a) or (b) is a reference to its being done—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>by the holder of such a licence; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>by a person acting as a servant or agent of, or otherwise under the authority of, the holder of such a licence,</Text></P3para></P3><Text>at a time when the licence is in force and in circumstances such that, if no such licence were in force, the doing of that thing would contravene a restriction imposed by regulations made under this Article.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In this Article and in Article 21,  “<Term>impounding works</Term>” means—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any dam, weir or other works in any waterway by which water may be impounded; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any works for diverting the flow of any waterway in connection with the construction or alteration of any such dam, weir or other works.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3" id="article-5-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 21 (1)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3/a" id="article-5-3-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for  “or alteration” substitute  “, alteration or operation”;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/3/b" id="article-5-3-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in sub-paragraph (a) for  “or transfer” substitute  “, surrender or id="article-5-5-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>after  “discharge consent” insert  “or a licence mentioned in Article 20(3)
								(a) or (b)”;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/5/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/5/b" id="article-5-5-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>after  “consent” insert  “or licence”.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/6" id="article-5-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 28 after paragraph (1) insert—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>1A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Department may give directions requiring any person who is operating any impounding works to give such information to the Department as to the operation of those works, at such times and in such form, as may be specified in the directions.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/7" id="article-5-7"><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 28(2), (3) and (4) after  “(1)” insert  “or (1A)”.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8" id="article-5-8"><Pnumber>8</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Article 29(b)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisi/2006/1946/article/5/8/a" id="article-5-8-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>after  “discharge consent” insert  “or any licence mentioned in Article 20(3)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228" NumberOfProvisions="139" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/body" NumberOfProvisions="27" NumberFormat="default"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/part/V/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/part/V" NumberOfProvisions="6" id="part-V"><Number>Part V</Number><Title>Miscellaneous</Title><P1group><Title>Modifications of statutory provisions</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26" id="regulation-26">
<Pnumber>26</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/1" id="regulation-26-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The 1993 Regulations shall have effect subject to the modifications specified in Schedule 2.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/2" id="regulation-26-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2 of the 1995 Regulations—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/2/a" id="regulation-26-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1) after the definition of “relevant waters” there shall be inserted the following definition—</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>‘ “stand-by vessel” means a vessel which is ready to give assistance in the event of an emergency on or near an offshore installation;';</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/2/b" id="regulation-26-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (3) there shall be inserted the following paragraph—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of these Regulations, a person shall be deemed to be engaged in diving operations throughout any period from the time when he commences to prepare for diving until the time when—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>he is no longer subjected to raised pressure;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>he has normal inert gas partial pressure in his tissues; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if he entered the water, he has left it,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and diving operations include the activity of any person in connection with the health and safety of a person who is, or is deemed to be, engaged in diving operations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/3" id="regulation-26-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Regulation 2 of the Offshore Installations (Prevention of Fire and Explosion, and Emergency Response) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1995<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/> shall be renumbered “2.—(1)”, and after that paragraph there shall be inserted the following paragraphs—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of these Regulations, any structures and devices on top of a well shall be treated as forming part of the well.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of these Regulations, a person shall be deemed to be engaged in diving operations throughout any period from the time when he commences to prepare for diving until the time when—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>he is no longer subjected to raised pressure;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>he has normal inert gas partial pressure in his tissues; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if he entered the water, he has left it,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and diving operations include the activity of any person in connection with the health and safety of a person who is, or is deemed to be, engaged in diving operations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/4" id="regulation-26-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2 (now 2(1)) of the Offshore Installations (Prevention of Fire and Explosion, and Emergency Response) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1995, in the definition of “pipeline”, “pipeline works,”, “territorial waters” and “vessel”, after the words “pipeline works,” there shall be inserted the words “stand-by vessel,”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228" NumberOfProvisions="139" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/body" NumberOfProvisions="27" NumberFormat="default"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/part/V/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/part/V" NumberOfProvisions="6" id="part-V"><Number>Part V</Number><Title>Miscellaneous</Title><P1group><Title>Modifications of statutory provisions</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26" id="regulation-26">
<Pnumber>26</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/1" id="regulation-26-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The 1993 Regulations shall have effect subject to the modifications specified in Schedule 2.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/2" id="regulation-26-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2 of the 1995 Regulations—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/2/a" id="regulation-26-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1) after the definition of “relevant waters” there shall be inserted the following definition—</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>‘ “stand-by vessel” means a vessel which is ready to give assistance in the event of an emergency on or near an offshore installation;';</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/2/b" id="regulation-26-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (3) there shall be inserted the following paragraph—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of these Regulations, a person shall be deemed to be engaged in diving operations throughout any period from the time when he commences to prepare for diving until the time when—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>he is no longer subjected to raised pressure;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>he has normal inert gas partial pressure in his tissues; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if he entered the water, he has left it,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and diving operations include the activity of any person in connection with the health and safety of a person who is, or is deemed to be, engaged in diving operations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/3" id="regulation-26-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Regulation 2 of the Offshore Installations (Prevention of Fire and Explosion, and Emergency Response) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1995<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/> shall be renumbered “2.—(1)”, and after that paragraph there shall be inserted the following paragraphs—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of these Regulations, any structures and devices on top of a well shall be treated as forming part of the well.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purposes of these Regulations, a person shall be deemed to be engaged in diving operations throughout any period from the time when he commences to prepare for diving until the time when—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>he is no longer subjected to raised pressure;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>he has normal inert gas partial pressure in his tissues; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if he entered the water, he has left it,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and diving operations include the activity of any person in connection with the health and safety of a person who is, or is deemed to be, engaged in diving operations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/1996/228/regulation/26/4" id="regulation-26-4">

Amendment of the Air Quality Limit Values Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2002 3 1 The Air Quality Limit Values Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2002 shall be amended in accordance with paragraphs (2) to (11). 2 In regulation 2(1) (definitions and interpretation), in the definition of “relevant pollutants”, for the words “and lead” there shall be substituted “, lead, benzene and carbon monoxide”. 3 In regulation 7 (method of assessment of ambient air quality)– a in paragraph (6)– i in sub-paragraph (b) the word “and” at the end shall be omitted; ii in sub-paragraph (c) after “PM10” there shall be added a semi-colon; iii after sub-paragraph (c) there shall be inserted– d the sampling and analysis of benzene; and e the analysis of carbon monoxide, . b in paragraph (9) for the words “and oxides of nitrogen” there shall be substituted “, oxides of nitrogen, benzene and carbon monoxide”. 4 In regulation 11 (public information), after paragraph (3), there shall be inserted the following paragraphs– 3A Information on ambient concentrations of benzene, as an average value over the last 12 months, shall be updated– a where practicable on a monthly basis; b in all other cases, as a minimum on a three-monthly basis. 3B Information on ambient concentrations of carbon monoxide, as a maximum running average over eight hours, shall be updated– a where practicable on an hourly basis; b in all other cases, as a minimum on a daily basis. . 5 In Schedule 1 (limit values, margins of tolerance etc.) after Part IV there shall be added– PART V BENZENE
Averaging periodLimit valueMargin of toleranceDate by which limit value is to be met
Limit value for the protection of human healthCalendar year5μg/m35μg/m3 on 13 December 2002, reducing on 1 January 2006 and every 12 months thereafter by 1 μg/m3 to reach 0 by 1 January 20101 January 2010
PART VI CARBON MONOXIDE
Averaging periodLimit valueMargin of toleranceDate by which limit value is to be met
The maximum daily 8-hour mean concentration will be selected by examining 8-hour running averages, calculated from hourly data and updated each hour. Each 8-hour average so calculated will be assigned to the day on which it ends, i.e. the first calculation period for any one day will be the period from 17:00 on the previous day to 01:00 on that day; the last calculation period for any one day will be the period from 16:00 to 24:00 on that day.
Limit value for the protection of human healthMaximum daily 8-hour mean10mg/m36 mg/m3 on 13th December 2002, reducing on 1 January 2003 and every 12 months thereafter by 2 mg/m3 to reach 0 by 1 January 20051 January 2005
. 6 In Part I of Schedule 2 (upper and lower assessment thresholds and exceedances) after paragraph (d) there shall be added– e BENZENE
Annual Average
Upper assessment threshold70% of limit value (3.5 μg/m3)
Lower assessment threshold40% of limit value (2 μg/m3)
f CARBON MONOXIDE
Eight-hour average
Upper assessment threshold70% of limit value (7mg/m3)
Lower assessment threshold50% of limit value (5mg/m3)
. 7 In Schedule 3– a for the heading of that Schedule there shall be substituted– Location of Sampling Points for the Measurement of Relevant Pollutants in Ambient Air. ; b in Part II in the fourth indent– i after the words “for nitrogen dioxide” there shall be added the words “and carbon monoxide”; and ii for the words “for particulate matter and lead” there shall be substituted “for particulate matter, lead and benzene”. 8 In Schedule 4 (criteria for determining minimum numbers of sampling points for fixed measurement of concentrations of relevant pollutants in ambient air), in the table in paragraph (a) of Part I after the words “traffic oriented station” there shall be added “. This requirement shall also apply to benzene and carbon monoxide provided that it does not increase the number of sampling points.”. 9 In Schedule 5 (data-quality objectives) at the end of Part 1 there shall be added–

The following data-quality objectives, for allowed uncertainty of assessment methods, and of minimum time coverage and of data capture of measurement are provided to guide quality assurance programmes.
BenzeneCarbon monoxide
The uncertainty (on a 95% confidence interval) of the assessment methods will be evaluated in accordance with the ‘Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty of Measurements' (ISO 1993) or the methodology of ISO 5725:1994 or equivalent. The percentages for uncertainty in the above table are given for individual measurements averaged over the period considered by the limit value, for a 95% confidence interval. The uncertainty for the fixed measurements should be interpreted as being applicable in the region of the appropriate limit value. The uncertainty for modelling and objective estimation is defined as the maximum deviation of the measured and calculated concentration levels, over the period considered, by the limit value, without taking into account the timing of the events. The requirements for minimum data capture and time coverage do not include losses of data due to the regular calibration of the normal maintenance of the instrumentation. The Department may allow for random measurements to be made instead of continuous measurements for benzene if the uncertainty, including the uncertainty due to random sampling, meets the quality objective of 25%. Random sampling must be spread evenly over the year.

Minimum time coverage14% (one day’s measurement a week at random, evenly distributed over the year, or 8 weeks evenly distributed over the year)14% (one measurement a week at random, evenly distributed over the year, or 8 weeks evenly distributed over the year)
Modelling

Eight-hour averages–50%
Annual averages50%–
Objective estimation
Uncertainty100%75%

. 10 In Schedule 6– a for the heading of that Schedule there shall be substituted the words– Reference Methods for Assessment of Concentrations of Relevant Pollutants. ; b after Part IV there shall be added– PART V REFERENCE METHOD FOR THE SAMPLING AND ANALYSIS OF BENZENE

The reference method for the measurement of benzene will be pumped sampling on a sorbent cartridge followed by gas chromatographic determination.

PART VI REFERENCE METHOD FOR THE ANALYSIS OF CARBON MONOXIDE

The reference method for the measurement of carbon monoxide will be a method based on the non-dispersive infra-red spectrometric (NDIR) method.

law.title: Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423" NumberOfProvisions="24" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/body" NumberOfProvisions="15" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1993</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Personal Protective Equipment at Work Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1993<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/> shall be amended –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/a" id="regulation-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>by substituting for sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) of paragraph (3) of regulation 4 the following sub-paragraphs –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>it is appropriate for the risk or risks involved, the conditions at the place where exposure to such risk or risks may occur, and the period for which it is worn;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>it takes account of ergonomic requirements and the state of health of the person or persons who may wear it, and of the characteristics of the workstation of each such person;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/b" id="regulation-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>by adding to regulation 4 the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where it is necessary to ensure that personal protective equipment is hygienic and otherwise free of risk to health, every employer and every self-employed person shall ensure that personal protective equipment provided is provided to a person for use only by him.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c" id="regulation-5-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) of regulation 6 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/i" id="regulation-5-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by deleting the word “and” after sub-paragraph (b);</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/ii" id="regulation-5-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by substituting a semi-colon for the full stop at the end of sub-paragraph (c) and after that by adding the word “and”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/c/iii" id="regulation-5-c-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by adding after sub-paragraph (c) the following sub-paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an assessment as to whether the personal protective equipment is compatible with other personal protective equipment which is in use and which an employee would be required to wear simultaneously.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d" id="regulation-5-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1) of regulation 9 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/i" id="regulation-5-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by substituting a comma for the full stop at the end of sub-paragraph (c); and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/d/ii" id="regulation-5-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>by adding after sub-paragraph (c) the words “and shall ensure that such information is kept available to employees.”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/423/regulation/5/e" id="regulation-5-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>by adding after paragraph (2) of regulation 9 the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1) the employer shall, where appropriate, and at suitable intervals, organise demonstrations in the wearing of personal protective equipment.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/454/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/454" NumberOfProvisions="11" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/454/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/454/body" NumberOfProvisions="6" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Fire Precautions (Workplace) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2001</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Fire Precautions (Workplace) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2001<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/> shall be amended in accordance with the following paragraphs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 9(1) there shall be omitted the words “provisions of health and safety regulations or”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 9(2)(a)(ii), for the words “premises to which” there shall be substituted the words “premises of a description specified in Part I of Schedule 1 to” and the word “apply” shall be omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/4" id="regulation-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For head (ii) of regulation 9(2)(b) there shall be substituted the following head –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>have effect in relation to a workplace in Northern Ireland other than –</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>an excepted workplace, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any workplace referred to in paragraphs (i) and (ii) of paragraph (2)(a), other than a building on the surface at a mine,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/5" id="regulation-3-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 9(2) there shall be inserted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Notwithstanding that the provisions of Part II are not provisions forming part of the relevant statutory provisions, the provisions of Part II shall, in so far as they apply to any workplace referred to in paragraphs (i) and (ii) of paragraph (2)(a) other than a building on the surface at a mine, be deemed to be health and safety regulations for the purposes of Articles 18 to 26, 28, 30, 31 to 37, 39 and 43 of the <Abbreviation Expansion="Health and Safety at Work (Northern Ireland) Order 1978 (S.I. 1978/1039 (N.I. 9))">1978 Order</Abbreviation>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/6" id="regulation-3-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 9 there shall be inserted the following regulation –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Civil liability for breach of statutory duty</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">9A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (2), breach of a duty imposed on an employer by the workplace fire precautions legislation shall, so far as it causes damage, confer a right of action in civil proceedings.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Breach of a duty imposed on an employer by the workplace fire precautions legislation shall not confer a right of action in civil proceedings in so far as that duty applies for the protection of persons not in his employment.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/7" id="regulation-3-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 16 –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/7/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/7/a" id="regulation-3-7-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) sub-paragraph (g) shall be omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/7/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/454/regulation/3/7/b" id="regulation-3-7-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (5) there shall be inserted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Insofar as Part II contains any provision which is made under the 1984 Order, Article 44A of the 1984 Order shall not apply in respect of any contravention of such provision.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/regulation/2002/1774" id="c00038" Class="EuropeanUnionRegulation" Year="2002" Number="1774">(EC) No. 1774/2002</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council as regards the use in feed of used cooking oil;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>Commission Decision <Citation <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/regulation/2002/1774" id="c00040" Class="EuropeanUnionRegulation" Year="2002" Number="1774">(EC) No. 1774/2002</Citation> of the European <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/regulation/2002/1774" id="c00044" Class="EuropeanUnionRegulation" Year="2002" Number="1774">(EC) No. 1774/2002</Citation> of the European
