IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/3" id="regulation-25-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For regulation 2(1)(d) there shall be substituted –</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default"><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any wholly owned subsidiary of the Northern Ireland Railways Company Limited which has applied in accordance with these Regulations for registration as a carrier of controlled waste but only –</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>if it is registered under paragraph 12 of Part I of Schedule 3 to the 2003 Regulations; and</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>whilst its application is pending.</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/4" id="regulation-25-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For regulation 2(1)(j), there shall be substituted –</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default"><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>subject to paragraph (1A) a person transporting animal by-products provided that such transportation –</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>is by the holder of an approval in accordance with the Community Regulation;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>is in connection with the activity to which that approval relates; and</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>iii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>only involves waste which is animal by-products.</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/5" id="regulation-25-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After regulation 2(1), there shall be inserted –</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default"><P2><Pnumber>1A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Regulation 2(1)(j) shall not apply to the transportation of animal by-products –</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the purposes of their final deposit in or on land or for the purposes of their incineration or co-incineration;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>which are dead domestic pets; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>which comprise or contain either catering waste or waste which is former foodstuffs unless such waste is to be fed to animals in accordance to Article 23(2) of the Community Regulation.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>1B</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For the purpose of paragraph (1A), the reference to feeding waste to animals shall be taken to include a reference to feeding such waste to maggots.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/6" id="regulation-25-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In regulation 2(2) –</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/6/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/6/a" id="regulation-25-6-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the definition of “animal by-products” there shall be substituted –</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default"><UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition"><ListItem><Para><Text>“animal by-products” has the meaning given by Article 2 of the Community Regulation;</Text></Para></ListItem></UnorderedList></BlockAmendment><AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/6/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/6/b" id="regulation-25-6-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the following definitions shall be inserted at the appropriate places –</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default"><UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition"><ListItem><Para><Text>“catering waste”, “incineration” and “co-incineration” shall have the meaning set down in Annex I to the Community Regulation;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“former foodstuffs” are those animal by-products referred to in Article 6(1)(f) of the Community Regulation;</Text></Para></ListItem><ListItem><Para><Text>“wholly owned subsidiary” has the same meaning as in Article 4 of the Companies (Northern Ireland) Order 1986.</Text></Para></ListItem></UnorderedList></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/7" id="regulation-25-7"><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After regulation 4(6), there shall be inserted the following paragraphs –</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default"><P2><Pnumber>6A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where an applicant wishes to apply to be registered both as a broker and as a carrier of controlled waste, he may make a combined application on a form provided by the Department for that purpose.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>6B</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where an applicant wishes to apply both for the renewal of his registration as a broker of controlled waste and for the renewal of his registration as a carrier of controlled waste, he may make a combined application on a form provided by the Department for that purpose.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/8" id="regulation-25-8"><Pnumber>8</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For regulation 4(7), there shall be substituted –</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default"><P2><Pnumber>7</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Department shall provide a copy of the appropriate application form free of charge to any person requesting one.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/9" id="regulation-25-9"><Pnumber>9</Pnumber><P2para><Text>For regulation 4(8), there shall be substituted –</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default"><P2><Pnumber>8</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Department shall charge an applicant in respect of its consideration of his application –</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>subject to paragraph (c), in the case of either an application for registration as a carrier of controlled waste or a combined application for registration as both a carrier and broker of controlled waste, £120;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in the case of either an application for the renewal of a registration as a carrier of controlled waste or a combined application for renewal of registration both as a carrier and as a broker of controlled waste, £60;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in the case of an application by a registered broker of controlled waste for registration as a carrier of controlled waste, £30,</Text></P3para></P3><Text>and the applicant shall pay the charge when he makes his application.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/10" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2003/493/regulation/25/10" id="regulation-25-10"><Pnumber>10</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After regulation 4(10) there shall be inserted –</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default"><P2><Pnumber>11</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In this regulation –</Text><UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition"><ListItem><Para><Text>“broker of controlled waste” has the same meaning as in regulation 22 of, and Schedule 4 to, the 2003 Regulations;</Text></Para></ListItem></UnorderedList></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the Schedule to the Air Quality Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> in the entry relating to Sulphur dioxide in column (2) for “35μg/m<Superior>3</Superior>” there shall be substituted “350μg/m<Superior>3</Superior>”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/body" NumberOfProvisions="9" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><Title>Interpretation</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-abde8b"/>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Interpretation Act (Northern Ireland) 1954<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> shall apply to these Regulations as it applies to an Act of the Northern Ireland Assembly.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In these Regulations “the <Abbreviation Expansion="Landfill Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003 (S.R. 2003/496)">Landfill Regulations</Abbreviation>” means the Landfill Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><Title>Amendment of the Landfill Regulations</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-e5cbc9"/>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Landfill Regulations are amended in accordance with the following Regulations.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><Title>Amendment of Part I (General)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-2ba412"/>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/4/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following definitions are inserted at the appropriate places in regulation 2(2) –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“European Waste Catalogue” means the list of wastes set out in the Annex to Commission Decision <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/decision/2000/0532" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDecision" Year="2000" Number="532">2000/532/<Acronym Expansion="European Community">EC</Acronym></Citation>, as for the time being amended<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“SIC Code” means a code included in “the United Kingdom Standard Industrial Classification of Economic Activities 2003”, published by the Office for National Statistics in 2002 and implemented on 1st January 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Stable, non-reactive hazardous waste” means hazardous waste, the leaching behaviour of which will not change adversely in the long-term under landfill design conditions or foreseeable accidents –</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in the waste alone (for example, by biodegradation);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>under the impact of long-term ambient conditions (for example, water, air, temperature, mechanical constraints); or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by the impact of other wastes (including waste products such as leachate and gas);”</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/4/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the definition of “relevant waste acceptance criteria” in regulation 2(2) substitute –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant waste acceptance criteria” means in relation to a landfill, the waste acceptance criteria under Parts I and <Acronym Expansion="3">III</Acronym> of Schedule 1 which apply to the class of landfill to which that landfill belongs;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><Title>Amendment of Part II (Landfill Permits)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-767447"/>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/1" id="regulation-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 9(1)(e) delete “as from the relevant date”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/2" id="regulation-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Regulation 10 –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/2/a" id="regulation-5-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (2) substitute “The operator of a landfill shall ensure that only waste which meets the relevant waste acceptance criteria shall be accepted at the landfill”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/2/b" id="regulation-5-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>delete paragraphs (3) to (5).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/3" id="regulation-5-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Regulation 12 –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/3/a" id="regulation-5-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraphs (1) and (2) substitute –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The operator of a landfill shall ensure that waste only be accepted at the landfill if –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>it has been subject to the relevant waste acceptance procedures set out in Part II of Schedule 1; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any sampling or testing required under Parts II or III of Schedule 1 is carried out in accordance with Part 4 of that Schedule.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (2A) the operator shall visually inspect waste at the entrance to the landfill and at the point of deposit and shall satisfy himself that it conforms to the description provided in the documentation submitted by the holder.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the operator is also the producer of the waste, the visual inspection required by paragraph (2) may be made at the point of dispatch.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The operator shall at appropriate periodic intervals –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>test the waste to establish whether it corresponds to the description in the accompanying documents, by checking its appearance, odour and any other relevant, readily determined properties; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>take representative samples for analysis which shall thereafter be retained, together with the results of the analysis for a period of at least one month.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/3/b" id="regulation-5-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3)(f) after “its” insert “identity and”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/4" id="regulation-5-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 14(4) for “it” substitute “he”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/5" id="regulation-5-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 15(4)(a) for “it” substitute “him”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/6" id="regulation-5-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 15(6) for “it” when it secondly appears substitute “he”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><Title>Amendment of Schedule 1 (Waste Acceptance Criteria)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-d547ac"/>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Schedule (which substitutes a schedule for Schedule 1 of the Landfill Regulations) shall have effect.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2004-07-16"><Title>Amendment of Schedule 3 (Minimum Monitoring Procedures for Landfills)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/7" id="regulation-7">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-433ace"/>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In paragraph 4(4) of Schedule 3 for “As” substitute “anionic surfactants”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2004-07-16"><Title>Amendment of Schedule 4 (Transitional Provisions)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8" id="regulation-8">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-caf983"/>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8/1" id="regulation-8-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following amendments are made to Schedule 4.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8/2" id="regulation-8-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>At the end of paragraph 1(6)(a) insert “or”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8/3" id="regulation-8-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph 3(4) for “sub-paragraph (3)(a)(i)” substitute “sub-paragraph (1)(14)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/body" NumberOfProvisions="9" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><Title>Interpretation</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-abde8b"/>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Interpretation Act (Northern Ireland) 1954<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> shall apply to these Regulations as it applies to an Act of the Northern Ireland Assembly.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In these Regulations “the <Abbreviation Expansion="Landfill Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003 (S.R. 2003/496)">Landfill Regulations</Abbreviation>” means the Landfill Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><Title>Amendment of the Landfill Regulations</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-e5cbc9"/>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Landfill Regulations are amended in accordance with the following Regulations.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><Title>Amendment of Part I (General)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-2ba412"/>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/4/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following definitions are inserted at the appropriate places in regulation 2(2) –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“European Waste Catalogue” means the list of wastes set out in the Annex to Commission Decision <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/decision/2000/0532" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDecision" Year="2000" Number="532">2000/532/<Acronym Expansion="European Community">EC</Acronym></Citation>, as for the time being amended<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“SIC Code” means a code included in “the United Kingdom Standard Industrial Classification of Economic Activities 2003”, published by the Office for National Statistics in 2002 and implemented on 1st January 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Stable, non-reactive hazardous waste” means hazardous waste, the leaching behaviour of which will not change adversely in the long-term under landfill design conditions or foreseeable accidents –</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in the waste alone (for example, by biodegradation);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>under the impact of long-term ambient conditions (for example, water, air, temperature, mechanical constraints); or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by the impact of other wastes (including waste products such as leachate and gas);”</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/4/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the definition of “relevant waste acceptance criteria” in regulation 2(2) substitute –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant waste acceptance criteria” means in relation to a landfill, the waste acceptance criteria under Parts I and <Acronym Expansion="3">III</Acronym> of Schedule 1 which apply to the class of landfill to which that landfill belongs;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><Title>Amendment of Part II (Landfill Permits)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-767447"/>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/1" id="regulation-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 9(1)(e) delete “as from the relevant date”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/2" id="regulation-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Regulation 10 –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/2/a" id="regulation-5-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (2) substitute “The operator of a landfill shall ensure that only waste which meets the relevant waste acceptance criteria shall be accepted at the landfill”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/2/b" id="regulation-5-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>delete paragraphs (3) to (5).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/3" id="regulation-5-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Regulation 12 –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/3/a" id="regulation-5-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraphs (1) and (2) substitute –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The operator of a landfill shall ensure that waste only be accepted at the landfill if –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>it has been subject to the relevant waste acceptance procedures set out in Part II of Schedule 1; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any sampling or testing required under Parts II or III of Schedule 1 is carried out in accordance with Part 4 of that Schedule.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (2A) the operator shall visually inspect waste at the entrance to the landfill and at the point of deposit and shall satisfy himself that it conforms to the description provided in the documentation submitted by the holder.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the operator is also the producer of the waste, the visual inspection required by paragraph (2) may be made at the point of dispatch.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The operator shall at appropriate periodic intervals –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>test the waste to establish whether it corresponds to the description in the accompanying documents, by checking its appearance, odour and any other relevant, readily determined properties; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>take representative samples for analysis which shall thereafter be retained, together with the results of the analysis for a period of at least one month.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/3/b" id="regulation-5-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3)(f) after “its” insert “identity and”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/4" id="regulation-5-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 14(4) for “it” substitute “he”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/5" id="regulation-5-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 15(4)(a) for “it” substitute “him”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/5/6" id="regulation-5-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 15(6) for “it” when it secondly appears substitute “he”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-07-16"><Title>Amendment of Schedule 1 (Waste Acceptance Criteria)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-d547ac"/>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Schedule (which substitutes a schedule for Schedule 1 of the Landfill Regulations) shall have effect.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2004-07-16"><Title>Amendment of Schedule 3 (Minimum Monitoring Procedures for Landfills)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/7" id="regulation-7">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-433ace"/>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In paragraph 4(4) of Schedule 3 for “As” substitute “anionic surfactants”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2004-07-16"><Title>Amendment of Schedule 4 (Transitional Provisions)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8" id="regulation-8">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-caf983"/>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8/1" id="regulation-8-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following amendments are made to Schedule 4.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8/2" id="regulation-8-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>At the end of paragraph 1(6)(a) insert “or”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2004/297/regulation/8/3" id="regulation-8-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph 3(4) for “sub-paragraph (3)(a)(i)” substitute “sub-paragraph (1)(14)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165" NumberOfProvisions="12" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2009-07-27"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/body" NumberOfProvisions="5" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2009-07-27"><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01"><Title>Amendment of the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a" id="regulation-3-a" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 2(1) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/i" id="regulation-3-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “maximum exposure limit” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/ii" id="regulation-3-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “occupational exposure standard” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iii" id="regulation-3-a-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “the risk assessment” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“risk phrase” has the meaning assigned to it in regulation 2(1) of the <Abbreviation Expansion="Chemicals (Hazard Information and Packaging for Supply) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2002 (S.R. 2002/301)">CHIP Regulations</Abbreviation>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iv" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iv" id="regulation-3-a-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “substance hazardous to health”, in sub-paragraph (b), for the words “a maximum exposure limit or an occupational exposure standard” there shall be substituted the words “a workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" id="regulation-3-a-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “workplace” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“workplace exposure limit” for a substance hazardous to health means the exposure limit approved by the Executive for that substance in relation to the specified reference period when calculated by a method approved by the Executive, as contained in the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “EH/40 Workplace Exposure Limits 2005” as updated from time to time.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/b" id="regulation-3-b" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 3, for paragraph (3) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations shall not apply to the master or crew of a ship or to the employer of such persons in respect of the normal shipboard activities of a ship’s crew which –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>are carried out solely by the crew under the direction of the master; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>are not liable to expose persons other than the master and crew to a risk to their health and safety,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and for the purposes of this paragraph “ship” includes every description of vessel used in navigation, other than a ship forming part of Her Majesty’s Navy.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/c" id="regulation-3-c" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 6(2)(f), for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit”, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>d</Pnumber>

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" id="regulation-3-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for paragraph (7), there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1), where there is exposure to a substance hazardous to health, control of that exposure shall only be treated as adequate if –</Text>

<P3para>

<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for a substance –</Text>

<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>

</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R42 or R42/43, or which is listed in section C of the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “Asthmagen? Critical assessments of the evidence for agents implicated in occupational asthma”<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> as updated from time to time, or any other substance which the risk assessment has shown to be a potential cause of occupational asthma,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<Text>exposure is reduced to as low a level as is reasonably practicable.</Text>

</P3>

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" id="regulation-3-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraph (8) shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" id="regulation-3-e" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 9, for paragraph (1) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Every employer who provides any control measure to meet the requirements of regulation 7 shall ensure that –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of plant and equipment, including engineering controls and personal protective equipment, it is maintained in an efficient state, in efficient working order, in good repair and in a clean condition; and</Text>

<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>

</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 12(2) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" id="regulation-3-f-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a)(ii) for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit” there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" id="regulation-3-f-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (d) for the words “maximum exposure limit”, in each place where they occur, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" id="regulation-3-g" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to the end of Schedule 2 there shall be added –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" id="regulation-3-g-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>

<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Cement and cement-containing preparations which contain, when hydrated, more than 0·0002% soluble chromium (<Acronym Expansion="6">VI</Acronym>) of the total dry weight of the cement.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" id="regulation-3-g-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to correspond with it in column 2 the entry –</Text>

<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Supply and use for all purposes except for controlled, closed and totally automated processes in which cement and cement-containing preparations are handled solely by machines and in which there is no possibility of contact with the skin.</Text>

</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" id="regulation-3-h" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>h</Pnumber>

</P3para>
</P3>

</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" id="regulation-3-a-v">

<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>

law.title: Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165" NumberOfProvisions="12" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2009-07-27"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/body" NumberOfProvisions="5" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2009-07-27"><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01"><Title>Amendment of the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a" id="regulation-3-a" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 2(1) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/i" id="regulation-3-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “maximum exposure limit” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/ii" id="regulation-3-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “occupational exposure standard” shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iii" id="regulation-3-a-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “the risk assessment” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“risk phrase” has the meaning assigned to it in regulation 2(1) of the <Abbreviation Expansion="Chemicals (Hazard Information and Packaging for Supply) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2002 (S.R. 2002/301)">CHIP Regulations</Abbreviation>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iv" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/iv" id="regulation-3-a-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “substance hazardous to health”, in sub-paragraph (b), for the words “a maximum exposure limit or an occupational exposure standard” there shall be substituted the words “a workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/a/v" id="regulation-3-a-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “workplace” there shall be added the following definition –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“workplace exposure limit” for a substance hazardous to health means the exposure limit approved by the Executive for that substance in relation to the specified reference period when calculated by a method approved by the Executive, as contained in the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “EH/40 Workplace Exposure Limits 2005” as updated from time to time.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/b" id="regulation-3-b" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 3, for paragraph (3) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations shall not apply to the master or crew of a ship or to the employer of such persons in respect of the normal shipboard activities of a ship’s crew which –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>are carried out solely by the crew under the direction of the master; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>are not liable to expose persons other than the master and crew to a risk to their health and safety,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and for the purposes of this paragraph “ship” includes every description of vessel used in navigation, other than a ship forming part of Her Majesty’s Navy.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/c" id="regulation-3-c" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 6(2)(f), for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit”, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 7 –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/i" id="regulation-3-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for paragraph (7), there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1), where there is exposure to a substance hazardous to health, control of that exposure shall only be treated as adequate if –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the principles of good practice for the control of exposure to substances hazardous to health set out in Schedule 2A are applied;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any workplace exposure limit approved for that substance is not exceeded; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for a substance –</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R45, R46 or R49, or for a substance or process which is listed in Schedule 1, or</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>which carries the risk phrase R42 or R42/43, or which is listed in section C of the Great Britain Health and Safety Executive publication “Asthmagen? Critical assessments of the evidence for agents implicated in occupational asthma”<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> as updated from time to time, or any other substance which the risk assessment has shown to be a potential cause of occupational asthma,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<Text>exposure is reduced to as low a level as is reasonably practicable.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/d/ii" id="regulation-3-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>paragraph (8) shall be omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/e" id="regulation-3-e" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 9, for paragraph (1) there shall be substituted the following paragraph –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Every employer who provides any control measure to meet the requirements of regulation 7 shall ensure that –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of plant and equipment, including engineering controls and personal protective equipment, it is maintained in an efficient state, in efficient working order, in good repair and in a clean condition; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the case of the provision of systems of work and supervision and of any other measure, it is reviewed at suitable intervals and revised if necessary.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 12(2) –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/i" id="regulation-3-f-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a)(ii) for the words “occupational exposure standard, maximum exposure limit” there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/f/ii" id="regulation-3-f-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (d) for the words “maximum exposure limit”, in each place where they occur, there shall be substituted the words “workplace exposure limit”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g" id="regulation-3-g" RestrictStartDate="2005-05-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b2d982"/>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>to the end of Schedule 2 there shall be added –</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/i" id="regulation-3-g-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in column 1 the entry –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Cement and cement-containing preparations which contain, when hydrated, more than 0·0002% soluble chromium (<Acronym Expansion="6">VI</Acronym>) of the total dry weight of the cement.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/g/ii" id="regulation-3-g-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>to correspond with it in column 2 the entry –</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>Supply and use for all purposes except for controlled, closed and totally automated processes in which cement and cement-containing preparations are handled solely by machines and in which there is no possibility of contact with the skin.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2005/165/regulation/3/h" id="regulation-3-h" RestrictStartDate="2005-06-01">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-0e3c3d"/>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after Schedule 2 there shall be inserted the Schedule set out in the Schedule to these Regulations.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
SCHEDULE Regulation 3(h)

SCHEDULE 2A PRINCIPLES OF GOOD PRACTICE FOR THE CONTROL OF EXPOSURE TO SUBSTANCES HAZARDOUS TO HEALTH Regulation 7(7)

Design and operate processes and activities to minimise emission, release and spread of substances hazardous to health. Take into account all relevant routes of exposure – inhalation, skin absorption and ingestion – when developing control measures. Control exposure by measures that are proportionate to the health risk. Choose the most effective and reliable control options which minimise the escape and spread of substances hazardous to health. Where adequate control of exposure cannot be achieved by other means, provide, in combination with other control measures, suitable personal protective equipment. Check and review regularly all elements of control measures for their continuing effectiveness. Inform and train all employees on the hazards and risks from the substances with which they work and the use of control measures developed to minimise the risks. Ensure that the introduction of control measures does not increase the overall risk to health and safety.

.

RestrictStartDate="2006-07-31"><Title>Amendment of the Waste and Contaminated Land (Northern Ireland) Order 1997</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-ce270b"/>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Waste and Contaminated Land (Northern Ireland) Order 1997 is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Article 2 (General interpretation)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a" id="regulation-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/i" id="regulation-2-2-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “commercial waste”—</Text>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/i/aa" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/i/aa" id="regulation-2-2-a-i-aa">
<Pnumber>aa</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (b) insert “and”; and</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/i/bb" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/i/bb" id="regulation-2-2-a-i-bb">
<Pnumber>bb</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>repeal sub-paragraph (c);</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/ii" id="regulation-2-2-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “industrial waste”—</Text>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/ii/aa" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/ii/aa" id="regulation-2-2-a-ii-aa">
<Pnumber>aa</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (c) delete “or”; and</Text>
</P5para>
</P5>
<P5 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/ii/bb" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/ii/bb" id="regulation-2-2-a-ii-bb">
<Pnumber>bb</Pnumber>
<P5para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (d) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<Text>or</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any mine or quarry or any premises used for agriculture within the meaning of the Agriculture Act (Northern Ireland) 1949;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P5para>
</P5>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/a/iii" id="regulation-2-2-a-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “the Waste Directive” delete “and” at the end of sub-paragraph (a) and after sub-paragraph (b) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the decision of the European Commission, dated 24th May 1996, adapting Annexes IIA and IIB to Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1975/0442" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1975" Number="442">75/442/EEC</Citation> on waste; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council, dated 29th September 2003, adapting to Council Decision <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/decision/1999/0468" id="c00002" Class="EuropeanUnionDecision" Year="1999" Number="468">1999/468/EC</Citation> the provisions relating to committees which assist the Commission in the exercise of its implementing powers laid down in instruments subject to the procedure referred to in Article 251 of the EC Treaty.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/b" id="regulation-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/b/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/b/i" id="regulation-2-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>repeal the words “but no regulations shall be made under this paragraph in respect of such waste as is mentioned in sub-paragraph(c) of the definition of “commercial waste”“; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/b/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/2/b/ii" id="regulation-2-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for “that definition” substitute “the definition of commercial waste”.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Article 4 (Prohibition on unauthorised or harmful deposit, treatment or disposal, etc., of waste)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/3/a" id="regulation-2-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (2) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to paragraph (2A), sub-paragraphs (a) and (b) of paragraph (1) do not apply in relation to household waste from a domestic property which is treated, kept or disposed of within the curtilage of the property.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (2) does not apply to the treatment, keeping or disposal of household waste by an establishment or undertaking.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/3/b" id="regulation-2-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the beginning of paragraph (8), insert “Subject to paragraph (10)”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/3/c" id="regulation-2-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the beginning of paragraph (9), insert “Subject to paragraph (10),”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/3/d" id="regulation-2-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (9), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A person (other than an establishment or undertaking) who commits an offence under this Article in respect of a contravention of paragraph (1)(c) consisting of the treatment, keeping or disposal within the curtilage shall be liable—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>on summary conviction, to a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>on conviction on indictment, to a fine.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After Article 5(2) (Duty of care, etc. as respects waste) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>It shall be the duty of the occupier of any domestic property to take all such measures available to him as are reasonable in the circumstances to secure that any transfer by him of household waste produced on the property is only to an authorised person or to a person for authorised transport purposes.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/5" id="regulation-2-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Article 5(3) after “for the purpose of paragraph (1)(c)” insert “or paragraph (2A)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/6" id="regulation-2-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Article 5(4) and (5) after “for the purposes of paragraph (1)(c)” insert “or paragraph (2A)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/7" id="regulation-2-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Article 5(8) after “Any person who fails to comply with paragraph (1)” insert “or paragraph (2A)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/8" id="regulation-2-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Article 31(1) and (4) (Waste other than controlled waste) is repealed.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>

<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>It shall be the duty of the occupier of any domestic property to take all such measures available to him as are reasonable in the circumstances to secure that any transfer by him of household waste produced on the property is only to an authorised person or to a person for authorised transport purposes.</Text>

</P2>

<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/5" id="regulation-2-5">

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/6" id="regulation-2-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2para>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/7" id="regulation-2-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>

</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/2/8" id="regulation-2-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2para>
</P2>

<Text>In paragraph (3)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/8/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/8/a" id="regulation-8-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>insert the following definitions at the appropriate places—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>agriculture</Term>” has the same meaning as in the Agriculture Act (Northern Ireland) 1949;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>agricultural waste</Term>” means waste from premises used for agriculture within the meaning of the Agriculture Act (Northern Ireland) 1949;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>Directive waste</Term>” means any substance or object in the categories set out in Schedule 1 to the 1997 Order which the producer or the person in possession of it discards or intends or is required to discard but with the exception of anything excluded from the scope of the Directive by Article 2 of the Directive, “<Term>producer</Term>” means anyone whose activities produce Directive waste or who carries out pre-processing, mixing or other operations resulting in a change in its nature or composition;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>mines or quarries waste</Term>” means waste from a mine or quarry;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>plant tissue</Term>” means tissue from a plant and “<Term>plant</Term>” has the same meaning as in Article 2 of the Plant Health Order (Northern Ireland) 2006</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/8/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/8/b" id="regulation-8-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “the Community Regulation” substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>the Community Regulation</Term>” has the same meaning as in regulation 2(1) of the Animal By-Products Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." <Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-e42531"/>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/11/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/11/1" id="regulation-11-1">

<P2para>

</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/11/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/11/2" id="regulation-11-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>At the end of paragraph (1)(f) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<Text>; and</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the disposal of agricultural waste in or on land under an authorisation under regulation 17 of the Groundwater Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1998.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." <P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/12/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/12/1" id="regulation-12-1">

<P2para>

</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/12/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/12/2" id="regulation-12-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph (4) at the end insert “or where the waste which is the subject of the exempt activity consists of agricultural waste.”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/12/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/12/3" id="regulation-12-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After paragraph (4) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (3)(d) shall not apply to an exempt activity where the waste which is the subject of the exempt activity consists of agricultural waste.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/12/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/12/4" id="regulation-12-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For paragraph (5) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of exempt activities set out in paragraphs 8, 9, 10, 11, 13, 19, or 45 of Part I of Schedule 2, except where the waste which is the subject of the exempt activity consists of agricultural waste, any additional information specified in Part II of that Schedule shall be entered in the register.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the case of exempt activities set out in paragraphs 9, 10, 11, 25 or 47A of Part I of Schedule 2, where the waste which is the subject of the exempt activity consists of agricultural waste or in any event where the activity is carried out under paragraph 25 the establishment or undertaking shall provide to the Department details of the benefit to agriculture or ecological improvement in accordance with Part III of Schedule 2 and these details shall be entered in the register.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/12/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/12/5" id="regulation-12-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph (12) for “Subject to regulation 19(2)” substitute “Subject to paragraph (4A) and regulation 19(2)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." RestrictStartDate="2006-07-31"><Title>Amendment of Regulation 19: Registration obligations</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2006/280/regulation/13" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2006/280/regulation/13" id="regulation-13">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-2706e3"/>13</Pnumber>

</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictExtent="N.I." <P1para>
