<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (8)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/3/d/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/3/d/i" id="regulation-2-3-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after “fails” insert “without reasonable excuse”; and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/3/d/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/3/d/ii" id="regulation-2-3-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for “paragraph (1) or paragraph (2A)” substitute “paragraphs (1), (2A), (2B), (2E) or (2F)”;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/3/e" id="regulation-2-3-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (9), for “the duty imposed on them by paragraph (1)” substitute “a duty imposed on them by paragraphs (1), (2B), (2E) or (2F)”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/3/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/3/f" id="regulation-2-3-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (13), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this Article—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“business” includes the undertaking of a canteen, club, school, hospital or institution, whether carried on for profit or not, and any undertaking or activity carried on by a district council;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“catering waste” means all waste food, including used cooking oil, originating in restaurants, catering facilities and kitchens, including central kitchens and household kitchens;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“drain”, “lateral drain”, “public sewer” and “sewer” have the same meanings as in Article 2 of the Water and Sewerage Services (Northern Ireland) Order 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“food business” means an undertaking, whether carried on for profit or not, and whether public or private, carrying out any activity related to the processing, distribution, preparation or sale of food.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Article 20 (Collection of controlled waste)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/4/a" id="regulation-2-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/4/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/4/a/i" id="regulation-2-4-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (a), omit “and”; and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/4/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/4/a/ii" id="regulation-2-4-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (b), omit “.” and insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P3para><Text>; and</Text>
</P3para>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>if requested by the occupier of premises in its district to collect any food waste from the premises presented for collection in accordance with Article 5(2B), to arrange for the collection of the food waste.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/4/b" id="regulation-2-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (1), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In sub-paragraph (1)(c), the reference to “food waste” does not include waste from an occupier of a domestic property as respects the household waste produced on the property.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/2/5" id="regulation-2-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After Article 20 (Collection of controlled waste) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Separate collection of food waste</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">20A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>This Article applies when a district council is making an arrangement in accordance with Article 20(1)(a).</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>A district council shall, from 1st April 2015, take such steps as the council considers reasonable to promote separate collection of food waste (including the making of arrangements for the provision of a receptacle which enables the separate collection of food waste from every domestic property in its area).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>A district council shall, from 1st April 2017, arrange for there to be provided to the occupier of every domestic property in its area—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a receptacle which enables the separate collection of food waste from the property; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>where a district council is satisfied that the amount of food waste that will be collected is not substantially less than would be collected in a receptacle provided under paragraph (a), a receptacle which enables the occupier to present food waste and other bio-waste for separate collection.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this Article—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“domestic property” means a building or self-contained part of a building which is used wholly for the purposes of living accommodation;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“receptacle” has the same meaning as in Article 21(10).</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14" NumberOfProvisions="8" xml:lang="en" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/body" NumberOfProvisions="8" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Waste Management Licensing Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/1" id="regulation-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Waste Management Licensing Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003 are amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/2" id="regulation-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 11C (Conditions of waste management licences: calculation of recycling efficiencies of the recycling processes of waste batteries and accumulators), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Conditions of waste management licences: separately collected food waste</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">11D</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Department shall ensure that any waste management licence granted or varied on or after 1st April 2015 authorising the storage or treatment (or both) of food waste contains such conditions as it considers necessary to ensure that no waste collected and transported in accordance with Article 5(2E) of the 1997 Order is mixed with any other waste or any material, to the extent that mixing would hamper future recycling.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Any waste management licence granted before 1st April 2015 authorising the storage or treatment (or both) of food waste and which continues in existence after that date shall be deemed to contain a condition requiring the operator to ensure that food waste collected and transported in accordance with Article 5(2E) of the 1997 Order is not mixed with any other waste or any material, to the extent that mixing would hamper future recycling.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/3" id="regulation-5-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 20 (Refusal, revocation and cessation of registration), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Food waste exemptions from waste management licensing</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">20A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An establishment or undertaking carrying out an exempt activity in respect of food waste, under paragraphs 13 or 40 of Part 1 of Schedule 2 (Activities exempt from waste management licensing), may continue to carry out that activity at that place in accordance with these Regulations, as they were in operation immediately before 1 April 2015 until the determination date.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>“Determination date” in this regulation means where in accordance with regulation 18, notice is given by an establishment or undertaking in relation to an exempt activity in respect of food waste under paragraphs 13 or 40 of Part 1 of Schedule 2 (Activities exempt from waste management licensing), the date on which the Department enters the relevant particulars in the register or, if it refuses to do so, the date it notifies the establishment or undertaking of its decision.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4" id="regulation-5-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 2 Part 1 (Activities exempt from waste management licensing)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/a" id="regulation-5-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 13—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/a/i" id="regulation-5-4-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (1)(a), after “composting” insert “of food waste at the premises of a food business and”</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/a/ii" id="regulation-5-4-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (4) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>For the purposes of this paragraph—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“business” includes the undertaking of a canteen, club, school, hospital or institution, whether carried on for profit or not, and any undertaking or activity carried on by a district council;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“food business” means an undertaking, whether for profit or not, and whether public or private, carrying out any activity related to the processing, distribution, preparation or sale of food.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/b" id="regulation-5-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 40—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/b/i" id="regulation-5-4-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (1)(b), omit “and”; and</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2015/14/regulation/5/4/b/ii" id="regulation-5-4-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (1)(c), omit “.” and insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" NumberFormat="default">
<P3para><Text>; and</Text>
</P3para>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the person storing the waste ensures that no waste collected and transported in accordance with Article 5(2E) of the 1997 Order is mixed with any other waste or any material, to the extent that mixing would hamper future recycling.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2016/95/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2016/95" NumberOfProvisions="8" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2016/95/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2016/95/body" NumberOfProvisions="8"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Hazardous Waste Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2005</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Hazardous Waste Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2005<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> are amended in accordance with paragraphs (2) to (5)—</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2 (General interpretation) at paragraph (1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/2/a" id="regulation-4-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>For the definition of “recovery” substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“recovery” means any operation the principal result of which is the waste serving a useful purpose by replacing other materials which would otherwise have been used to fulfil a particular function, or waste being prepared for that function, in the plant or in the wider economy. Annex II to the Directive, as amended by Commission Directive (EU) 2015/1127, sets out a non-exhaustive list of recovery operations;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/2/b" id="regulation-4-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>Insert the following definition in the appropriate alphabetical order—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“Commission Directive (EU) 2015/1127” means Commission Directive (EU) 2015/1127 of 10th July 2015 amending Annex II to <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2008/0098" id="c00003" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2008" Number="0098">Directive 2008/98/EC</Citation> of the European Parliament and the Council on waste and repealing certain Directives;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/3" id="regulation-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 24(2)(c) for Annex I of <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2008/0098" id="c00004" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2008" Number="0098">Directive 2008/98/EC</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council, or storage of waste consisting materials intended for submission to any operation listed in Annex II of that Directive,” substitute “Annex I of <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2008/0098" id="c00005" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2008" Number="0098">Directive 2008/98/EC</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council, or storage of waste consisting of materials intended for submission to any operation listed in Annex II of that Directive as amended by Commission Directive (EU) 2015/1127.”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/4" id="regulation-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 37(6) after “Annex I or II” add “as amended by Commission Directive (EU) 2015/1127”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2016/95/regulation/4/5" id="regulation-4-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 40(3)(c) after “Annex I or II of the Waste Directive (as the case may be)” add “as amended by Commission Directive (EU) 2015/1127”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86" NumberOfProvisions="47" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/body" NumberOfProvisions="25"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Environmental Impact Assessment (Forestry) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2006</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Environmental Impact Assessment (Forestry) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> are amended in accordance with regulations 4 to 23.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 2 (interpretation)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/a" id="regulation-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “consultation bodies” substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“consultation bodies” in relation to any project means—</Text>
<Text>any public body, statutory authority or organisation which exercises statutory functions or is otherwise designated by any statutory provision as having responsibilities relating to the environment;;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/b" id="regulation-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “Department” substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the Department” means the Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/c" id="regulation-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “the Directive” substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the Directive” means <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2011/0092" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2011" Number="0092">Directive 2011/92/EU</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council on the assessment of the effects of certain public and private projects on the environment as amended by <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2014/0052" id="c00002" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2014" Number="0052">Directive 2014/52/EU</Citation></Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/d" id="regulation-4-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “environmental information” insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“environmental impact assessment” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>the preparation of an environmental statement;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>the carrying out of consultations under regulation 9 and, where relevant, regulation 15;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>the consideration of the environmental statement and other information under regulation 16;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>reaching a conclusion about the likely significant effects of the project under regulation 16; and</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>the consideration of that conclusion under regulation 16, before the decision whether or not to grant consent;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/e" id="regulation-4-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “environmental statement” substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“environmental statement” means a statement that—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>includes such of the information referred to in Part 1 of Schedule 1 as is relevant to the specific characteristics of a particular project or type of project and to the environmental features likely to be affected;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>includes at least the information referred to in Part 2 of Schedule 1;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>takes into account, with a view to avoiding duplication of assessments, the available results of other relevant assessments under Union or national legislation, when preparing the statement;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>is based on any opinion issued pursuant to regulation 7 and where such an opinion is issued, includes the information that may reasonably be required for reaching a conclusion on the significant effects of the project on the environment, taking into account current knowledge and methods of assessment;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>is prepared by competent persons; and</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>is accompanied by a statement from the proposer outlining the relevant experience or qualifications of such persons;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/f" id="regulation-4-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of ‘local advertisement’ substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“local advertisement” means publishing or making available a notice—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>in one or more newspapers circulating in the immediate locality of any relevant project; or</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>by a district council in that locality; or</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>at library premises (within the meaning of section 11 of the Libraries Act (Northern Ireland) 2008 in that locality);</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/4/g" id="regulation-4-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “relevant project”, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“Union legislation” means any enactment in the domestic legislation of Northern Ireland giving effect to an <Acronym Expansion="European Union">EU</Acronym> obligation</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 3 (interpretation of “relevant project”)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 3(c), for paragraphs (ii) and (iii) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>involves development which is not mentioned in Schedule 1 to, or in column 1 of the table in Schedule 2 to the Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2012<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>involves development for which planning permission is granted by Part 8 of the Schedule to the Planning (General Permitted Development) Order (Northern Ireland) 2015</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText><FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 4 (exemptions)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 4—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/6/a" id="regulation-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraphs (1) and (2) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Department may direct that a particular project is exempted—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>from the application of these Regulations, in accordance with Articles 1(3) or 2(4) of the Directive; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>from provisions relating to public consultation, in accordance with Article 2(5) of the Directive, provided the objectives of the directive will continue to be met.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Department shall only make a direction under paragraph (1)(a) or (b) in an exceptional case and where it does so, it shall—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>consider whether in that case another form of assessment of the environmental effects of the proposed project in question would be appropriate;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>make available to the public the information obtained under that other form of assessment, information relating to the making of the direction and the reasons for making it.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 6 (application for an opinion whether a project is a relevant project)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/7" id="regulation-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 6, for paragraphs (2) and (3) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>An application under paragraph (1) shall include or be accompanied by—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a map or plan sufficient to identify the land that is the subject of the proposed project and the extent of the proposed project;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>information on the characteristics of the project and its likely significant effects on the environment specified in Schedule 2A; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>such further information or representations as the proposer may wish to provide or make including a description of any features of the project or measures envisaged to avoid or prevent what might otherwise have been significant adverse effects on the environment.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The selection criteria set out in Schedule 3 must be taken into account, where relevant, when compiling the information required by sub-paragraph (2)(b).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2B</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The proposer must take into account, where relevant, the available results of other relevant assessments of the effects on the environment that have been carried out pursuant to Union legislation other than legislation implementing the requirements of the Directive.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Department shall, if it considers that it has not been provided with sufficient information to enable it to give an opinion under paragraph (1), notify the proposer in writing of the matters on which it requires further information and the proposer shall supply that further information to the Department within such period as the Department may reasonably require.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 7 (opinion of the Department)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/8" id="regulation-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 7—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/8/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/8/a" id="regulation-8-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (1) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Where a proposer applies to the Department under regulation 6, the Department shall give to him written notice of its opinion within 90 days beginning with the date of its receipt of the application or, where it notifies the proposer under regulation 6(3) that it requires further information, the date of its receipt of that information.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In exceptional cases, where the nature, complexity, location or size of the works demands a longer period for determination, the Department may extend the deadline in paragraph (1), informing the proposer in writing of the reasons justifying the extension and of the date on which its determination is expected.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/8/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/8/b" id="regulation-8-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (4), add—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4A</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Where the opinion of the Department is that a project is not a relevant project because an environmental assessment is not required, the Department must state the main reasons for not requiring such assessment, with reference to the relevant selection criteria in Schedule 3, and where proposed by the proposer, state any features of the project or measures envisaged to avoid or prevent what might otherwise have been significant adverse effects on the environment.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/8/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/8/c" id="regulation-8-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (5) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Department may, in the absence of an application under regulation 6, give its opinion whether or not a project is or would be a relevant project and where it gives an opinion under this paragraph—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>it shall give written notice of its opinion to any person who reasonably appears to it to be the proposer; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>paragraphs (2), (3), (4), (4A), (5) and (7) shall apply as they do to an opinion given under paragraph (1).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 9 (request as to the information to be included in an environmental statement)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/9" id="regulation-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 9, for paragraphs (1) and (2) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Before applying for consent in relation to a project, the Department must give its opinion as to the scope and level of detail of the information to be contained in the environmental statement required for that project.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Before a determination has been made whether the project is or would be a relevant project, the Department shall deal with the request on the assumption that the project is a relevant project</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 9A (Co-ordination)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/10" id="regulation-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After regulation 9, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P1group>
<Title>Co-ordination</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">9A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Where in relation to a particular project there is, in addition to the requirement for an environmental impact assessment to be carried out in accordance with these Regulations, also a requirement to carry out a Habitats Regulations Assessment, the Department must where appropriate ensure that the Habitats Regulations Assessment and the environmental impact assessment are co-ordinated.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this regulation, a “Habitats Regulation Assessment” means an assessment under regulation 43 of The Conservation (Natural Habitats, <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation>) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1995.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 12 (publicity)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/11" id="regulation-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 12—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/11/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/11/a" id="regulation-11-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1)(d), for “28 days” substitute “30 days”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/11/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/11/b" id="regulation-11-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (4)(b), for “28 days” substitute “30 days”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/11/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/11/c" id="regulation-11-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (5)(b), for “28 days” substitute “30 days”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 13 (further information and evidence relating to environmental statements)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/12" id="regulation-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 13—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/12/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/12/a" id="regulation-12-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (4)(b), for “28 days” substitute “30 days”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/12/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/12/b" id="regulation-12-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (5)(b), for “28 days” substitute “30 days”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 17 (notification of decisions)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/13/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/13" id="regulation-13">
<Pnumber>13</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 17—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/13/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/13/a" id="regulation-13-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (1)(a) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>give notice in writing of its decision to the applicant, the consultation bodies and any person from whom it received representations in relation to the application in accordance with paragraph (2);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/13/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/13/b" id="regulation-13-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (2) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Each notice under paragraph (1)(a) shall inform the person concerned of the determination stating that the Department has taken into account the environmental information relating to the application and shall give a statement of—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>where the decision in paragraph (1)(a) is to grant consent—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the reasoned conclusion of the Department pursuant to Article (1)(2)(g)(iv) of the Directive and any environmental conditions attached to the decision;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>a description of any features of the project and/or measures envisaged to avoid, prevent or reduce and if possible offset significant adverse effects on the environment as well as, where appropriate, monitoring measures;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>where the decision in paragraph (1)(a) is to refuse consent, the main reasons for the refusal.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/13/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/13/c" id="regulation-13-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (3)(b) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the main reasons and considerations on which its determination is based, including a summary of the results of the consultations and the information gathered pursuant to regulations 9, 10 and 15 and how those results have been incorporated or otherwise addressed; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 22 (conditions to be included in every consent)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/14" id="regulation-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 22, substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Every consent shall include conditions to the effect that—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>work in relation to the relevant project shall be commenced within such period (not being more than 5 years beginning with the date consent is granted) as is specified in the consent;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>no work shall be carried out in relation to the relevant project after the expiration of such period (not being more than 10 years beginning with the date consent is granted) as is specified in the consent;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the proposer must implement procedures to monitor significant adverse effects on the environment.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In sub-paragraph (1)(c), the types of parameters to be monitored and the duration of monitoring must be proportionate to the nature, location and size of the project and the significance of its effects on the environment but, to avoid duplication, existing monitoring arrangements under Union legislation other than the Directive may be used, if appropriate.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 29 (determinations following consideration of project under regulation 28)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/15/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/15" id="regulation-15">
<Pnumber>15</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In paragraph (1)(d) of regulation 29, for the words “28 days”, substitute “30 days”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 30 (notification of determination that a proposed project is likely to have significant effects on the environment)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/16/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/16" id="regulation-16">
<Pnumber>16</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In paragraph (2)(c) of regulation 30, for “28 days” substitute “30 days”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 32 (publicity for an environmental statement)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/17/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/17" id="regulation-17">
<Pnumber>17</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 32—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/17/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/17/a" id="regulation-17-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2)(b), for “28 days” substitute “30 days”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/17/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/17/b" id="regulation-17-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 3(b), for “28 days” substitute “30 days”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 33 (assistance in the preparation of environmental statements)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/18/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/18" id="regulation-18">
<Pnumber>18</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 33—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/18/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/18/a" id="regulation-18-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (4)(b), for the words “28 days” substitute the words “30 days”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/18/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/18/b" id="regulation-18-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (5)(b), for the words “28 days” substitute the words “30 days”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 35 (proposed project likely to have significant effect on the environment in another <Acronym Expansion="European Economic Area">EEA</Acronym> State)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/19/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/19" id="regulation-19">
<Pnumber>19</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 35(1)(c), for the words “28 days”, substitute the words “30 days”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Regulation 36 (determination of whether proposed project should proceed)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/20/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/20" id="regulation-20">
<Pnumber>20</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 36—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/20/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/20/a" id="regulation-20-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (7)(a)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/20/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/20/a/i" id="regulation-20-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the words “general and local” substitute the words “general, local and electronic”;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/20/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/20/a/ii" id="regulation-20-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for the words “28 days” substitute the words “30 days”;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/regulation/20/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/regulation/20/b" id="regulation-20-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (7)(a)(ii), for the words “28 days” substitute the words “30 days”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86" NumberOfProvisions="47" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Schedules><Title>SCHEDULES</Title><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2017/86/schedule/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2017/86/schedule/1" NumberOfProvisions="16" id="schedule-1">
<Number>SCHEDULE 1</Number>
<ScheduleBody>
<BlockAmendment Context="schedule" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown">
<Schedule>
<Number>SCHEDULE<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1</Number>
<TitleBlock>
<Title>Information for inclusion in Environmental Statements</Title>
</TitleBlock>
<Reference>Regulations 2(1) and 13(2)</Reference>
<ScheduleBody>
<Part>
<Number>PART<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1</Number><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the project, including in particular—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a description of the location of the project;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a description of the physical characteristics of the whole project, including where relevant requisite demolition works, and the land-use requirements during the construction and operational phases;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a description of the main characteristics of the operational phase of the project (in particular, any production processes), for instance, energy demand and energy used, nature and quantity of the materials and natural resources (including water, land, soil and biodiversity) used;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>an estimate, by type and quantity, of expected residues and emissions (such as water, air, soil and sub-soil pollution, noise, vibration, light, heat and radiation) resulting from the operation of the proposed project.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the reasonable alternatives (for example in terms of project design, technology, location, size and scale) studied by the applicant, which are relevant to the proposed project and its specific characteristics, and an indication of the main reasons for selecting the chosen option, including a comparison of the environmental effects.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the relevant aspects of the current state of the environment (baseline scenario) and an outline of the likely evolution thereof without implementation of the project as far as natural changes from the baseline scenario can be assessed with reasonable effort on the basis of the availability of environmental information and scientific knowledge.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the factors specified in Schedule 4 likely to be significantly affected by the project—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>population, human health;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>biodiversity (for example flora and fauna);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>land (for example land take), soil (for example organic matter, erosion, compaction, sealing), water (for example hydromorphological changes, quantity and quality), air and climate (for example greenhouse gas emissions, impacts relevant to adaptation);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>material assets, cultural heritage, including architectural and archaeological aspects, and landscapes.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the likely significant effects of the project on the environment resulting from, amongst others—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the construction and existence of the project, including, where relevant, demolition works;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the use of natural resources, in particular land, soil, water and biodiversity, considering as far as possible the sustainable availability of these resources;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the emission of pollutants, noise, vibration, light, heat and radiation, the creation of nuisances and the disposal and recovery of waste;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the risks to human health, cultural heritage or the environment (for example due to accidents or disasters);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the cumulation of effects with existing or approved projects, taking into account any existing environmental problems relating to areas of particular environmental importance likely to be affected or the use of natural resources;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the impact of the project on climate (for example the nature and magnitude of greenhouse gas emissions) and the vulnerability of the project to climate change;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the technologies used.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The description of the likely significant effects on the factors specified in Schedule 4 must cover the direct effects and any indirect, secondary, cumulative, transboundary, short-term, medium-term and long-term, permanent or temporary, positive and negative effects of the project. This description must take into account the environmental protection objectives established at Union or Member State level which are relevant to the project.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the forecasting methods or evidence, used to identify and assess the significant effects on the environment, including details of difficulties (for example technical deficiencies or lack of knowledge) encountered compiling the required information and the main uncertainties involved.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the measures envisaged to avoid, prevent, reduce or, if possible, offset any identified significant adverse effects on the environment and where appropriate, of any proposed monitoring arrangements (for example the preparation of a post-project analysis). That description must explain the extent to which significant adverse effects on the environment are avoided, prevented, reduced or offset, and must cover both the construction and operational phases.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the expected significant adverse effects of the project on the environment deriving from the vulnerability of the project to risks of major accidents and/or disasters which are relevant to the project concerned. Relevant information available and obtained through risk assessments pursuant to legislation such as <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2012/0018" id="c00003" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2012" Number="0018">Directive 2012/18/EU</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council on the control of major accident hazards involving dangerous substances<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> amending and subsequently repealing Council <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1996/0082" id="c00004" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1996" Number="0082">Directive 96/82/EC</Citation> or Council Directive 2009/71/Euratom establishing a Community framework for the nuclear safety of nuclear installations<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> or <Acronym Expansion="United Kingdom">UK</Acronym> environmental assessments may be used for this purpose provided that the requirements of the Directive are met. Where appropriate, this description should include measures envisaged to prevent or mitigate the significant adverse effects of such events on the environment and details of the preparedness for and proposed response to such emergencies.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A non-technical summary of the information provided under paragraphs 1 to 9 above.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A reference list detailing the sources used for the descriptions and assessments included in the statement.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</Part>
<Part>
<Number>PART<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2</Number><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the project comprising information on the site, design and size and other relevant features of the project.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the likely significant effects of the project on the environment.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of any features of the project, or measures envisaged in order to avoid, prevent or reduce and, if possible offset likely significant adverse effects on the environment.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the reasonable alternatives studied by the applicant which are relevant to the project and its specific characteristics, and an indication of the main reasons for the options chosen, taking into account the effects of the project on the environment.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A non-technical summary of the information provided under paragraphs 1 to 4.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</Part>
</ScheduleBody>
</Schedule>
</BlockAmendment>
</ScheduleBody>
</Schedule></Schedules></Secondary></Legislation>

SCHEDULES SCHEDULE 4 SCHEDULE4 Environmental factors Regulations 16(3) and 36(1)

The factors specified are— population and human health; biodiversity, with particular attention to species and habitats protected under Directive 92/43/EEC and Directive 2009/147/EC; land, soil, water, air and climate; material assets, cultural heritage and the landscape; the interaction between the factors mentioned in paragraphs (a) to (d); above and the expected effects on those factors deriving from the vulnerability of the project to risks of major accidents and/or disasters that are relevant to the project concerned.

<Number><CommentaryRef Ref="key-c0be25"/>SCHEDULE</Number>
<Reference>Regulations 8, 9, 10, 16 and 24</Reference>
<ScheduleBody>
<BlockAmendment Context="schedule" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary">
<Schedule>
<Number>SCHEDULE<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2A</Number>
<TitleBlock>
<Title>INFORMATION FOR INCLUSION IN ENVIRONMENTAL STATEMENT</Title>
</TitleBlock>
<Reference>Article 2(2)</Reference>
<ScheduleBody>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Description of the drainage works or drainage scheme (“the works”), including in particular—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a description of the location of the works;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a description of the physical characteristics of the whole works, including where relevant, requisite demolition works and the land-use requirements during the construction and operational phases;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a description of the main characteristics of the operational phase of the works (in particular any production processes), for instance, energy demand and energy used, nature and quantity of the materials and natural resources (including water, land, soil, and biodiversity) used;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>an estimate, by type and quantity, of expected residues and emissions such as (water, air, soil and subsoil pollution, noise, vibration, light, heat, radiation <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation>) resulting from the operation of the proposed works.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the reasonable alternatives (for example in terms of design, technology, location, size and scale) studied by the Department, which are relevant to the proposed works and its specific characteristics, and an indication of the main reasons for selecting the chosen option, including a comparison of the environmental effects.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the relevant aspects of the current state of the environment and an outline of the likely evolution thereof without implementation of the works as far as natural changes from the current state can be assessed with reasonable effort on the basis of the availability of environmental information and scientific knowledge.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the factors specified in Article 3(1) of the Directive likely to be significantly affected by the development: population, human health, biodiversity (for example fauna and flora), land (for example land take), soil (for example organic matter, erosion, compaction, sealing), water (for example hydromorphological changes, quantity and quality), air, climate (for example greenhouse gas emissions, impacts relevant to adaptation), material assets, cultural heritage including architectural and archaeological aspects, and landscape.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the likely significant effects of the works on the environment resulting from, inter alia—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the construction and existence of the works, including, where relevant, demolition works;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the use of natural resources, in particular land, soil, water and biodiversity, considering as far as possible the sustainable availability of these resources;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the emission of pollutants, noise, vibration, light, heat and radiation, the creation of nuisances, and the disposal and recovery of waste;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the risks to human health, cultural heritage or the environment (for example due to accidents or disasters);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the accumulation of effects with other existing or approved works, taking into account any existing environmental problems relating to areas of particular environmental importance likely to be affected or the use of natural resources;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the impact of the works on climate (for example the nature and magnitude of greenhouse gas emissions) and the vulnerability of the works to climate change;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the technologies and the substances used.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The description of the likely significant effects on the factors specified in Article 3(1) of the Directive should cover the direct effects and any indirect, secondary, cumulative, transboundary, short, medium and long-term, permanent and temporary, positive and negative effects of the works. This description should take into account the environmental protection objectives established at <Acronym Expansion="European Union">EU</Acronym> or member State level which are relevant to the works, including in particular those established under Council <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1992/0043" id="c00005" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1992" Number="0043">Directive 92/43/EEC</Citation><FootnoteRef Ref="f00015"/> and <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2009/0147" id="c00006" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2009" Number="0147">Directive 2009/147/EC</Citation><FootnoteRef Ref="f00016"/> of the European Parliament and of the Council.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the forecasting methods or evidence used to identify and assess the significant effects on the environment including details of the difficulties (for example technical deficiencies or lack of knowledge) encountered compiling the required information and the main uncertainties involved.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the measures envisaged to avoid, prevent, reduce and where possible, offset any identified significant adverse effects on the environment and, where appropriate, of any proposed monitoring arrangements (for example the preparation of a post-works analysis). That description should explain the extent to which significant adverse effects on the environment are avoided, prevented, reduced or offset, and should cover both the construction and operational phases.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A description of the expected significant adverse effects of the works on the environment deriving from the vulnerability of the works to risks of major accidents or disasters which are relevant to the works concerned. Relevant information available and obtained through risk assessments pursuant to EU legislation such as <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2012/0018" id="c00007" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2012" Number="0018">Directive 2012/18/EU</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council or Council Directive 2009/71/Euratom or relevant assessments carried out pursuant to national legislation may be used for this purpose provided that the requirements of the Directive are met. Where appropriate, this description should include measures envisaged to prevent or mitigate the significant adverse effects of such events on the environment and details of the preparedness for and proposed response to such emergencies.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A non-technical summary of the information provided under paragraphs 1 to 9.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">11</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A reference list detailing the sources used for the descriptions and assessments included in the environmental statement.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</ScheduleBody>
</Schedule>
<Schedule>
<Number>SCHEDULE<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2B</Number>
<TitleBlock>
<Title>SELECTION CRITERIA REFERRED TO IN ARTICLE 4(3) OF THE DIRECTIVE</Title>
</TitleBlock>
<Reference>Article 12A</Reference>
<ScheduleBody>
<P1group>
<Title>Characteristics of drainage works or drainage schemes “the works”</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The characteristics of drainage works or drainage schemes must be considered having regard, in particular, to—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the size and design of the whole works;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>their cumulative effects with other existing or approved works;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the use of natural resources, in particular land soil, water and biodiversity;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the production of waste;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>pollution and nuisances;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the risk of major accidents or disasters which are relevant to the works concerned, including those caused by climate change, in accordance with scientific knowledge, having regard in particular to substances or technologies used;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the risks to human health (for example due to water contamination or air pollution).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Location of drainage works or drainage schemes</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The environmental sensitivity of geographical areas likely to be affected by the works must be considered, having regard in particular, to—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the existing and approved land use;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the relative abundance, availability, quality and regenerative capacity of natural resources (including soil, land, water and biodiversity) in the area and its underground;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the absorption capacity of the natural environment, paying particular attention to then following areas—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>wetlands, riparian areas, river mouths;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>coastal zones and the marine environment;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>mountain and forest areas;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>nature reserves and parks;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>areas classified or protected under <Acronym Expansion="European Economic Area">EEA</Acronym> States’ legislation, Natura 2000 areas designated by EEA States pursuant to <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1992/0043" id="c00008" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1992" Number="0043">Directive 92/43/EEC</Citation> and <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2009/0147" id="c00009" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2009" Number="0147">Directive 2009/147/EC</Citation>;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>vi</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>areas in which there has already been a failure to meet the environmental quality standards, laid down in Union legislation and relevant to the project, or in which it is considered that there is such a failure;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>vii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>densely populated areas;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>viii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>landscapes and sites of historical, cultural or archaeological significance.</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Type and characteristics of the potential impact</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The likely significant effects on the environment must be considered in relation to the criteria set out under paragraphs 1 and 2 with regard to the impact of the works on the factors specified in Article 3(1) of the Directive, and having regard, in particular, to—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the magnitude and spatial extent of the impact of the works (for example the geographical area and size of the population likely to be affected;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the nature of the impact;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the transboundary nature of the impact;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the intensity and complexity of the impact;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the probability of the impact;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the expected onset, duration, frequency and reversibility of the impact;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the accumulation of the impact with the impact of other existing and/or approved projects;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the possibility of effectively reducing the impact.”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</ScheduleBody>
</Schedule>
<Schedule>
<Number>SCHEDULE<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>2C</Number>
<TitleBlock>
<Title>ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS TO BE TAKEN INTO ACCOUNT</Title>
</TitleBlock>
<Reference>Articles 12H(1), (9), 13(4) and 16(2)</Reference>
<ScheduleBody>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The environmental statement shall identify, describe and assess in an appropriate manner, in the light of each individual case, the direct and indirect effect of the drainage works or drainage scheme on the following factors—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>population and human health;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>biodiversity, with particular attention to species and habitats protected under <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1992/0043" id="c00010" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1992" Number="0043">Directive 92/43/EEC</Citation> and Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2009/0147" id="c00011" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="2009" Number="147">2009/147/<Acronym Expansion="European Economic Community">EEC</Acronym></Citation>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>land, soil, water, air, climate;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>material assets, cultural heritage; and the landscape;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the interaction between the factors referred to in sub-paragraphs (a) to (d).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The effects referred to in paragraph 1 on the factors set out in that paragraph shall include the expected effects deriving from the vulnerability of the drainage works or drainage scheme to risks of major accidents or disasters that are relevant to the drainage works or drainage scheme concerned.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</ScheduleBody>
</Schedule>
</BlockAmendment>
</ScheduleBody>
</Schedule></Schedules></Secondary></Legislation>
