law.title: Pollution Prevention and Control (Industrial Emissions) Regulations (Northern Ireland)

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2018/33/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2018/33" NumberOfProvisions="25" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2018/33/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2018/33/body" NumberOfProvisions="25"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2018/33/part/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2018/33/part/2" NumberOfProvisions="23" id="part-2"><Number>PART 2</Number><Title>Amendment of the Pollution Prevention and Control (Industrial Emissions) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2013</Title><P1group><Title>Regulation 2 (Interpretation: general)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2018/33/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2018/33/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2018/33/regulation/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2018/33/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In regulation 2(1) (Interpretation: general), in the appropriate alphabetical order, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Term>existing medium combustion plant</Term>” means a combustion plant put into operation before 20th December 2018 or for which a permit was granted before 19th December 2017 provided that the plant is put into operation no later than 20th December 2018;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Term>MCPD</Term>” means the “Medium Combustion Plant Directive” which is <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2015/2193" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2015" Number="2193">Directive 2015/2193/EU</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council of the 25 November 2015 on the limitation of emissions of certain pollutants into the air from medium combustion plants<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Term>medium combustion plant</Term>” means a combustion plant with a rated thermal input equal to or greater than 1 megawatt and less than 50 megawatts irrespective of the type of fuel they use and includes any combination of combustion plants referred to in article 2(2) or article 4 of the MCPD, provided that—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>it does not fall within Article 2(3) or (4) of the MCPD;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>it is not installed on an offshore platform situated on, above or below those parts of the territorial sea adjacent to Northern Ireland;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Term>mobile medium combustion plant</Term>” means a medium combustion plant which is designed to move or be moved whether on roads or other land;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Term>new medium combustion plant</Term>” means a medium combustion plant which is not an existing medium combustion plant;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText> and;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Term>specified generator</Term>” has the meaning given in paragraph 2 of Schedule 9B.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2018/33/regulation/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2018/33/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Interpretation Act (Northern Ireland) 1954<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> applies to these regulations as it applies to an Act of the Northern Ireland Assembly.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of Schedule 1 (activities, installations and mobile plant)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2018/33/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2018/33/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In Schedule 1, in Part C of section 1.1 (combustion activities), after head (a), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>Unless falling within head (a) of this Part, burning any fuel or fuels in a medium combustion plant with a net rated thermal input of 1 megawatt or more but less than a rated thermal input of 20 megawatts.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>Unless falling within another head in this part, the operation of a specified generator.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/nisr/2019/209/regulation/18/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/nisr/2019/209/regulation/18/3" id="regulation-18-3">

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>When interpreting the Waste Framework Directive for the purposes of these Regulations and the legislation specified in regulation 5—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a “permit” or exemption from waste management licensing means a waste management licence under Article 6 of the Waste and Contaminated Land (Northern Ireland) Order 1997, a licence or exemption from waste management licensing under the Waste Management Licensing Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00026"/>, a resolution or a licence under Part II of the Food and Environment Protection Act 1985<FootnoteRef Ref="f00027"/>, a licence under Part 4 of the Marine and Coastal Access Act 2009<FootnoteRef Ref="f00028"/>, a consent under Schedule 1 to the Water (Northern Ireland) Order 1999<FootnoteRef Ref="f00029"/> or a permit under Part 2 of the Pollution, Prevention and Control (Industrial Emissions) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2013<FootnoteRef Ref="f00030"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a reference to one or more Member States in a provision imposing an obligation or conferring a discretion on a Member State or Member States is to be read as a reference to the appropriate authority, or local authority which, immediately before IP completion day, was responsible for Northern Ireland’s compliance with that obligation or able to exercise that discretion so far as it related to Northern Ireland;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the appropriate authority is the Northern Ireland department which, immediately before IP completion day, was responsible for compliance with that obligation or exercise of that discretion in Northern Ireland; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>“local authority” in Northern Ireland means a district council within the meaning of section 1 of the Local Government Act (Northern Ireland) 1972.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>

</P2>

PART 3Amendment of subordinate legislationAmendment of the Waste Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2011 10 1 The Waste Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2011 are amended as follows. 2 In regulation 9— a omit the definition of “Commission Directive (EU) 2015/1127”; b for the definition of “municipal waste” substitute— “municipal waste” means— mixed waste and separately collected waste from households, including paper and cardboard, glass, metals, plastics, bio-waste, wood, textiles, packaging, waste electrical and electronic equipment, waste batteries and accumulators, and bulky waste, including mattresses and furniture; and mixed waste and separately collected waste from other sources, where such waste is similar in nature and composition to waste from households; but does not include waste from production, agriculture, forestry, fishing, septic tanks and sewage network and treatment, including sewage sludge, end-of-life vehicles or waste generated by construction and demolition activities;; ; c in the definition of “recovery” for “Annex II to the Directive, as amended by Commission Directive (EU) 2015/1127,” substitute “Annex II to the Waste Framework Directive”; d in the definition of “the Waste Framework Directive” for “(EU) 2017/997” substitute “(EU) 2018/851”; and e in the definition of “prevention”, in paragraph (g), for “harmful” substitute “hazardous”. 3 In regulation 10, in sub-paragraph (1)(a) for “Annex IV of the Waste Framework Directive” substitute “the Schedule”. 4 In regulation 11(1)— a after sub-paragraph (a), insert— aa includes one of more programmes of food waste prevention measures; ; b in sub-paragraph (c) for “waste prevention measures; and” substitute “waste prevention measures and their contribution to waste prevention;”; c in sub-paragraph (d) for “.” substitute “;” and d after sub-paragraph (d) insert— e sets out at least the waste prevention measures in the Schedule; and f where relevant, describes the contribution of instruments listed in Part 4 of Schedule 3 to the Waste and Contaminated Land (Northern Ireland) Order 1997. . 5 For regulation 12(1)(a) substitute— a establish appropriate qualitative and quantitative indicators and targets, such as on the quantity of waste that is generated, against which to monitor and access the implementation of the waste prevention measures; and 6 In regulation 18— a in paragraph (1)— i omit “, from 1st January 2015”; ii omit “and are—” and insert “.”; and iii omit sub-paragraphs (a) and (b). b in paragraph (2) omit “, from 1st January 2015,”; and c for paragraph (3) substitute— 3 The duties in this regulation apply where separate collection is necessary to ensure that waste undergoes preparing for re-use, recycling or other recovery operations in accordance with the waste hierarchy and the protection of human health and the environment and to facilitate or improve preparing for re-use, recycling or recovery, unless one of the following conditions is met— a collecting the waste paper, metal, plastic or glass together results in output from those operations which is of comparable quality to that achieved through separate collection; b separate collection of the waste does not deliver the best environmental outcome when considering the overall environmental impacts of the management of the relevant waste streams; c separate collection of the waste is not technically feasible taking into consideration good practices in waste collection; or d separate collection of the waste would entail disproportionate economic costs taking into account the costs of adverse environmental and health impacts of mixed waste collection and treatment, the potential for efficiency improvements in waste collection and treatment, revenues from sales of secondary raw materials as well as the application of the polluter-pays principle and extended producer responsibility. . 7 In regulation 19, for paragraphs (1) and (2), substitute— 1 Subject to paragraph (2), a district council which collects, transports or receives waste must ensure that where that waste has been separately collected it is not mixed with other material with different properties. 2 The duty in paragraph (1) applies where keeping waste separate is necessary to ensure that waste undergoes preparing for re-use, recycling or other recovery operations in accordance with the waste hierarchy and the protection of human health and the environment and to facilitate or improve preparing for re-use, recycling or recovery, unless one of the following conditions is met—— a mixing certain types of waste together results in output from those operations which is of comparable quality to that achieved through keeping waste separate; b keeping waste separate does not deliver the best environmental outcome when considering the overall environmental impacts of the management of the relevant waste streams; c keeping waste separate is not technically feasible taking into consideration good practices in waste collection; or d keeping waste separate would entail disproportionate economic costs taking into account the costs of adverse environmental and health impacts of mixed waste collection and treatment, the potential for efficiency improvements in waste collection and treatment, revenues from sales of secondary raw materials as well as the application of the polluter-pays principle and extended producer responsibility. . 8 Add the Schedule— SCHEDULE WASTE PREVENTION MEASURES Regulation 10(1)(a)

The waste prevention measures are measures to at least— promote and support sustainable production and consumption models; encourage the design, manufacturing and use of products that are resource-efficient, durable (including in terms of life span and absence of planned obsolescence), reparable, re-usable and upgradable; target products containing critical raw materials to prevent those materials becoming waste; encourage the re-use of products and the setting up of systems promoting repair and re-use activities, including in particular for electrical and electronic equipment, textiles and furniture, as well as packaging and construction materials and products; encourage, as appropriate and without prejudice to intellectual property rights, the availability of spare parts, instruction manuals, technical information, or other instruments, equipment or software enabling the repair and re-use of products without compromising their quality and safety; reduce waste generation in processes related to industrial production, extraction of minerals, manufacturing, construction and demolition, taking into account best available techniques; reduce the generation of food waste in primary production, in processing and manufacturing, in retail and other distribution of food, in restaurants and food services as well as in households; encourage food donation and other redistribution for human consumption, prioritising human use over animal feed and the reprocessing into non-food products; promote the reduction of the content of hazardous substances in materials and products; reduce the generation of waste, in particular waste that is not suitable for preparing for re-use or recycling; identify products that are the main sources of littering and take appropriate measures to prevent and reduce litter from such products; aim to halt the generation of marine litter; and develop and support information campaigns to raise awareness about waste prevention and littering.

.

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2005/658" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2005/658" NumberOfProvisions="4" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2025-11-01"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2005/658/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2005/658/body" NumberOfProvisions="4" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2025-11-01"><P1group RestrictExtent="S" RestrictStartDate="2006-04-01"><Title>Amendment of the Contaminated Land (Scotland) Regulations 2000</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-8925e6"/>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Contaminated Land (Scotland) Regulations 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> are amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For regulation 3 (Pollution of controlled waters), substitute–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For the purposes of regulation 2(1)(a), this regulation applies to land where–</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the water environment which is, or is intended to be, used for the supply of drinking water for human consumption is being affected by the land and, as a result, requires a treatment process or a change in such a process to be applied to it before use, so as to be regarded as wholesome within the meaning of Part VIA of the Water (Scotland) Act 1980;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>waters are being affected by the land and, as a result, those waters do not meet or are not likely to meet the criterion for classification applying to the relevant description of waters specified in regulations made under section 30B of the Control of Pollution Act 1974; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the water environment is being affected by the land and–</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>any of the substances by reason of which the pollution of the water environment is being or is likely to be caused falls within any of the families or groups of substances listed in Schedule 1 to these Regulations; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the water environment, or any part of the water environment, is contained within underground strata which comprise wholly or partly Devonian Sandstones or Permo-Triassic Sandstones.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In each of the following provisions, for “controlled waters” wherever the expression occurs, substitute “the water environment”–</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>regulation 5(2),</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>regulation 7(1)(h) and (j), and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in Schedule 2 (Remediation Notice), in the form of remediation notice.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3/4" id="regulation-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 4 (registers)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3/4/a" id="regulation-3-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph 2(c) substitute–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the significant harm or significant pollution of the water environment by reason of which the contaminated land in question is contaminated land;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2005/658/regulation/3/4/b" id="regulation-3-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph 13(c) substitute–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any steps of which the authority has knowledge, carried out under section 27, or by means of enforcement action (within the meaning of section 78YB(2C)) towards remedying any significant harm or significant pollution of the water environment by reason of which the land in question is contaminated land.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to regulation 3, the 1999 Regulations are amended in accordance with paragraphs (2) to (17).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2 (interpretation)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a" id="regulation-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1)–</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/i" id="regulation-2-2-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “application for multi-stage consent” for “of reserved matters” substitute “, consent or agreement required by a condition imposed on a grant of planning permission in principle”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/ii" id="regulation-2-2-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the definition of “the consultation bodies”, insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (Scotland) Regulations 2008 (S.S.I. 2008/432)">Development Management Procedure Regulations</Abbreviation>” means the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (Scotland) Regulations 2008<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/></Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/iii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/iii" id="regulation-2-2-a-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>omit the definition of “general development order”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/iv/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/iv" id="regulation-2-2-a-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for the definition of “outline planning permission” substitute–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“planning permission in principle” has the meaning given in section 59 of the Act<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/></Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/v/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/v" id="regulation-2-2-a-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “project” for “outline planning permission” in both places where those words occur substitute “planning permission in principle”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/vi/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/vi" id="regulation-2-2-a-vi">
<Pnumber>vi</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the definition of “reporter” omit the words “or 130” in both places where they occur;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/vii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/a/vii" id="regulation-2-2-a-vii">
<Pnumber>vii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>omit the definition of “reserved matters”.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/2/b" id="regulation-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (5) insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In these Regulations, references to a relevant planning authority shall, as regards an application being considered on review under section 43A(8) (right to require review of planning decisions and failure to take such decisions) be construed as including a reference to the planning authority acting by virtue of that section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3(1) (prohibition on granting planning permission without consideration of environmental information) omit from the word “and” to “order” inclusive.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3A(2) (consideration of environmental information: multi stage consent) for “outline planning permission” substitute “planning permission in principle”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/5" id="regulation-2-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 7(5) (application made to planning authority without an environmental statement)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/5/a" id="regulation-2-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit paragraph (a); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/5/b" id="regulation-2-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (b) at the end insert “or a review by virtue of section 43A(8) (right to require review of planning decisions and failure to take such decisions)”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/6" id="regulation-2-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 9(5) (appeal to the Scottish Ministers without an environmental statement) omit “and comply with regulation 13(3)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/7" id="regulation-2-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 9, insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Review by the planning authority of an application without an environmental statement</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>9A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where on consideration of a review under section 43A(8) (right to require review of planning decisions and failure to take such decisions) it appears to the planning authority that–</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the relevant application is a Schedule 2 application;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the development in question has not been the subject of a screening opinion or screening direction; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the relevant application is not accompanied by a statement referred to by the appellant as an environmental statement for the purposes of these Regulations,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>paragraphs (3) and (4) of regulation 5 shall apply as if the requirement to review the case under section 43A(8) were a request made by the applicant pursuant to regulation 5(1).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where it appears to the planning authority that the relevant application is an <Acronym Expansion="Environmental Impact Assessment">EIA</Acronym> application and is not accompanied by a statement referred to by the applicant as an environmental statement for the purposes of these Regulations, they shall notify the applicant in writing that the submission of an environmental statement is required.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>An applicant receiving a notification pursuant to paragraph (2) may, within three weeks beginning with the date of the notification, write to the planning authority–</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>stating that the applicant accepts their view and is providing an environmental statement; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>unless the Scottish Ministers have made a screening direction in respect of the development, stating that the applicant is writing to the Scottish Ministers to request a screening direction.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If the applicant does not write to the planning authority in accordance with paragraph (3), the permission sought shall, unless the Scottish Ministers have made a screening direction to the effect that the development is not EIA development, be deemed to be refused at the end of the relevant three week period, and the deemed refusal shall not give rise to an appeal to the Scottish Ministers by virtue of section 47 (right to appeal against planning decisions and failure to take such decisions).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A planning authority which has given a notification in accordance with paragraph (2) shall, unless the Scottish Ministers make a screening direction to the effect that the development is not EIA development, determine the relevant application only by refusing planning permission if the applicant does not submit an environmental statement.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A person who requests a screening direction pursuant to sub-paragraph (3)(b) shall send to the Scottish Ministers with that request copies of–</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the application for planning permission;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>all documents sent to the authority as part of the application; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>all correspondence between the applicant and the authority relating to the proposed development,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>and paragraphs (2) to (5) of regulation 6 shall apply to a request under this regulation as they apply to a request made pursuant to regulation 5(6).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>This regulation shall not apply where regulation 21B applies.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/8" id="regulation-2-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 12(3)(b) (procedure to facilitate preparation of environmental statements) for “or 9(3)” substitute “, 9(3) or 9A(3)(a)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9" id="regulation-2-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 13 (publicity for environmental statement)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/a" id="regulation-2-9-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1) for “he shall serve on any party who holds a notifiable interest in neighbouring land a notice” substitute “the authority to whom the statement is submitted must give notice in accordance with paragraph (1A)”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/b" id="regulation-2-9-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (1) insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Notice under paragraph (1) is to be given where there are premises situated on the neighbouring land to which the notice can be sent to the owner, lessee or occupier of such premises, by sending a notice addressed to “the Owner, Lessee or Occupier” to such premises.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/c" id="regulation-2-9-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit paragraphs (2) to (4); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/9/d" id="regulation-2-9-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (7) for “article 2(1) of the general development order” substitute “regulation 3(1) of the Development Management Procedure Regulations”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/10" id="regulation-2-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 14(1) (consultation where environmental statement received) after “EIA application” insert “(including an EIA application under consideration on review under section 43A(8) (right to require review of planning decisions and failure to take such decisions))”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/11/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/11" id="regulation-2-11">
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 21B(1) (application for multi-stage consent without environmental statement)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/11/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/11/a" id="regulation-2-11-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (a) for “relates to outline” substitute “(including determination following consideration of the application on review under section 43A(8) (right to require review of planning decisions and failure to take such decisions)) relates to”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/11/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/11/b" id="regulation-2-11-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (c) omit “outline”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/12/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/12" id="regulation-2-12">
<Pnumber>12</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulations 21C(1)(a) and (c) (application for multi-stage consent referred to the Scottish Ministers without environmental statement), 21D(1)(a) (appeal in respect of application for multi stage consent without environmental statement) and 21H(a)(ii) and (j) (procedure for application for multi-stage consent), omit “outline”, wherever that word occurs.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/13/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/13" id="regulation-2-13">
<Pnumber>13</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 21E(1) (application for multi-stage consent with environmental statement) at the end of paragraph (b) insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default">
<P3para>
<Text>; or</Text>
</P3para>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the relevant planning authority have under consideration on review under section 43A(8) an application for multi-stage consent where an environmental statement has already been submitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/14" id="regulation-2-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 21G (procedure to facilitate preparation of environmental statements) for paragraph (b) substitute–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 3(b) for “7(4)(a), 8(4), 9(3) or 9A(3)(a)” substitute 7(4)(a), 8(4) or 9(3) as those regulations are applied by regulations 21B(6), 21C(5) or 21D(5), as the case may be.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/15/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/15" id="regulation-2-15">
<Pnumber>15</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 45 (extension of the period for an authority’s decision on a planning application) for paragraph (2) substitute–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where it falls to an authority to determine an EIA application, regulation 26 (time periods for decision) of the Development Management Procedure Regulations has effect as if–</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the reference in paragraph (2)(b) of that regulation to two months there were substituted a reference to four months; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the reference to “validation date” in any case where an environmental statement is required to be submitted in respect of an application is the date on which that statement and the documents which require to accompany it were submitted (if that date is later than would otherwise be determined under regulation 14 (validation date) of the Development Management Procedure Regulations).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/16/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/16" id="regulation-2-16">
<Pnumber>16</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedules 5 (notice under regulation 13), 6 (notice under regulation 13 as applied by regulation 19(2)) and 6A (notice under regulation 13 as applied by regulation 21E(5)), for “Article 9(1) of the Town and Country Planning (General Development Procedure) (Scotland) Order 1992”, substitute “the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (Scotland) Regulations 2008”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/17/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/17" id="regulation-2-17">
<Pnumber>17</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 6A–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/17/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/17/a" id="regulation-2-17-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 1 of column 2, for “of reserved matters” substitute “, consent or agreement required by a condition imposed on a grant of planning permission in principle”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/17/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/17/b" id="regulation-2-17-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 2 in sub-paragraphs (i) and (ii) for “reserved matters” substitute “the application” and in sub-paragraph (iii) for “application for approval of reserved matters” substitute “the application”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/17/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2009/221/regulation/2/17/c" id="regulation-2-17-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 3 omit “for approval of reserved matters, the outline planning permission”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Action Programme for Nitrate Vulnerable Zones (Scotland) Regulations

Amendments to the Action Programme for Nitrate Vulnerable Zones (Scotland) Regulations 2008 2 The Action Programme for Nitrate Vulnerable Zones (Scotland) Regulations 2008 are amended in accordance with regulations 3 to 9. Amendment of regulation 3 3 1 Regulation 3 (interpretation) is amended as follows. 2 After the definition of “crop requirement” insert— “derogated farm” means a farm over which a derogation has been granted; “derogation” means a derogation from the annual limit of nitrogen in livestock manure that can be applied to land granted by the Scottish Ministers in accordance with regulations 14, 14A and 14B; “derogation application” means an application for a derogation submitted by the occupier of a farm; . 3 After the definition of “farmyard manure” insert— “fertilisation accounts” means accounts providing such information relating to the management of nitrogen and phosphate inputs during the preceding calendar year as the Scottish Ministers may specify in accordance with regulation 25(3); . 4 After the definition of “grassland” insert— “grassland farm” means a farm where 80% or more of the agricultural area available for manure application is permanent grassland or temporary grassland (temporary implying leys of less than four years), including crops under-sown with grass but excluding grassland with 50% or more clover; “grazing livestock” means cattle (with the exclusion of veal calves), sheep, deer, goats and horses; . 5 After the definition of “organic manure with high available nitrogen content” insert— “phosphate fertiliser” means any substance containing one or more phosphate compounds used on land to enhance growth of vegetation and includes organic manure; . Amendment of regulation 5 4 1 Regulation 5 (fertiliser and manure management plan) is amended as follows. 2 Omit “and” where it appears at the end of regulation 5(3)(b). 3 After regulation 5(3)(c), insert— and d in respect of derogated farms, in addition to the requirements of sub-paragraphs (a) to (c)— i a note of the number of livestock and a description of the housing and storage system that includes the volume of manure storage available; ii a calculation of manure nitrogen (less losses in housing and storage) and phosphate produced in the farm; iii a description of the crop rotation and area of each crop, including a sketch map indicating location of individual fields; iv a calculation of the foreseeable nitrogen and phosphate crop requirements; v a note of the amount and the type of manure delivered outside the farm or to the farm; vi the results of soil analysis related to nitrogen and phosphate soil status, if available; vii a note of the nitrogen and phosphate application from manure over each field; and viii a calculation of the application of nitrogen and phosphate with chemical and other fertilisers over each field. . 4 After regulation 5(5), insert— 6 Fertiliser and manure management plans in respect of derogated farms shall be revised no later than 7 days after any changes in agricultural practice at the farm. . Amendment of regulation 14 5 1 Regulation 14 (annual farm limit of nitrogen in livestock manure) is amended as follows. 2 At the beginning of paragraph (1), insert “Subject to paragraph (4),”. 3 After paragraph (3), insert— 4 The occupier of any grassland farm within a nitrate vulnerable zone may apply to the Scottish Ministers for a derogation from the annual farm limit of nitrogen in livestock manure specified in paragraph (1). 5 Any derogation granted shall last until the conclusion of the calendar year to which it relates, and shall be subject to renewal. 6 Where the Scottish Ministers grant a derogation, the total annual amount of nitrogen in livestock manure from grazing livestock applied to the derogated farm, whether directly by an animal or by spreading, must not exceed 250kg multiplied by the area of the derogated farm in hectares. 7 Any application for a derogation shall be made in accordance with regulation 14A and any grant of a derogation shall be subject to the conditions of regulation 14B. . Insertion of regulations 14A and 14B 6 1 After regulation 14, insert— Application for a derogation from the annual farm limit of nitrogen in livestock manure 14A 1 The occupier of any grassland farm within a nitrate vulnerable zone who wishes to apply to the Scottish Ministers for a derogation must submit an application— a by 30th April of the calendar year to which the application pertains (in respect of applications other than those pertaining to 2009); b by 31st January 2010 in respect of applications pertaining to 2009. 2 The Scottish Ministers must publish electronically the manner and form in which the derogation application must be made. 3 Where the farm in respect of which a derogation is applied for benefited from a derogation during the calendar year preceding that to which the application relates, the application shall be accompanied by the fertilisation accounts for that preceding calendar year. 4 The Scottish Ministers must approve or refuse a derogation application within 21 days from its receipt and notify the applicant of the decision in writing. 5 Where the Scottish Ministers refuse a derogation application, they shall give the occupier reasons for the refusal. Conditions of a derogation from the annual farm limit of nitrogen in livestock manure 14B A derogation shall be subject to the following conditions— a total nitrogen inputs shall not exceed the foreseeable nutrient demand of the considered crop, taking into account the supply from the soil; b livestock manure shall not be spread in the autumn before grass cultivation; c grass on sandy soils, if ploughed, shall only be ploughed in spring; d ploughed grass on all soil types shall be followed immediately by a crop with high nitrogen demand; e crop rotation shall not include leguminous or other plants fixing atmospheric nitrogen, other than clover in grassland with less than 50% clover or leguminous plants under-sown with grass; f nitrogen and phosphate soil sampling and analysis shall be carried out at least once every four years for, as a minimum, every five hectares of the farm that, having regard to crop rotation and soil characteristics, can reasonably be considered homogeneous; and g fertilisation accounts for each calendar year for which a derogation is granted shall be prepared and submitted to the Scottish Ministers by 30th April of the following year. . Amendment of Regulation 25 7 1 Regulation 25 (records to be kept) is amended as follows. 2 For regulation 25(2) substitute— 2 The occupier of a derogated farm must, in addition to the records to be kept under paragraph (1), keep records of— a the derogation application and decision; b the fertiliser and manure management plan referred to in regulation 5; c fertilisation accounts; and d the results of nitrogen and phosphate analysis in soil referred to inregulation14B. 3 The Scottish Ministers must publish electronically the manner and form in which fertilisation accounts must be prepared and submitted. 4 The records referred to in paragraphs (1) and (2) must be kept for each year. . Amendment of Schedule 1 8 1 Schedule 1 (calculation of nitrogen (“N”) in livestock manure) is amended as follows. 2 Omit the heading “Calculation of nitrogen (‘N’) in livestock manure” and substitute “Calculation of nitrogen (‘N’) and phosphate (‘P2O5’) in livestock manure”. 3 For Table 1, substitute— Table 1 <Strong>Standards for the volume of excreta, nitrogen and phosphate in manure produced by livestock</Strong>

</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of regulation 2</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/139/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/139/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">

<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1), in the definition of “transfer station” for “2.500T” substitute “2,500T”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of regulation 8</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/139/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/139/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 8, for paragraph (4) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>A body corporate becomes bankrupt or incapacitated when it—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>goes into liquidation;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>enters administration under Part 2 of the Insolvency Act 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> or Part 3 of the Insolvency (Northern Ireland) Order 1989<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>has an administrative receiver (as defined in section 251 of the Insolvency Act 1986) appointed in respect of it.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>An individual becomes bankrupt or incapacitated when the individual—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>becomes subject to a bankruptcy restrictions order under section 155 of the Bankruptcy (Scotland) Act 2016<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>becomes incapacitated (within the meaning of the Adults with Incapacity (Scotland) Act 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>starts to serve a sentence of imprisonment or is remanded in custody in the United Kingdom; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>is detained in hospital under the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Scotland) Act 2003<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>An individual or a partnership becomes bankrupt or incapacitated when the estate of that person—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>is sequestrated under the Bankruptcy (Scotland) Act 2016; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>is made subject to a protected trust deed (see section 163 of the Bankruptcy (Scotland) Act 2016).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>A body corporate, individual or partnership which or who is subject to the laws of a jurisdiction other than Scotland becomes bankrupt or incapacitated on the occurrence of circumstances analogous to those described in paragraphs (4) to (6).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of regulation 26</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2017/139/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2017/139/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Environmental Noise (Scotland) Regulations 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> are amended as follows—</Text>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>

<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“Directive” means <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2002/0049" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2002" Number="0049">Directive 2002/49/EC</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council relating to the assessment and management of environmental noise<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/></Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/2/a" id="regulation-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2)(b), omit “in all cases listed as examples in paragraph 3 of Annex I to the Directive”,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/2/b" id="regulation-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3), for “means of the assessment methods set out in Schedule 2” substitute “computation (at the assessment position) and by means of the assessment methods set out in the Annex <Acronym Expansion="2">II</Acronym> to the Directive”,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/2/c" id="regulation-2-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (3) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3A</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In paragraph (3), “assessment position” means the assessment height in paragraph 7 of Annex <Acronym Expansion="4">IV</Acronym> to the Directive</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>, and</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/2/d" id="regulation-2-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit paragraphs (4) and (5).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>

<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2para>
</P2>

<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/4/a" id="regulation-2-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 1 (interpretation), omit the definition of “L<Emphasis><Inferior>A10,18h</Inferior></Emphasis>”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2018/342/regulation/2/4/b" id="regulation-2-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit paragraph 2(a) (road traffic noise).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P3para>
<Text>after “The Crofting Commission”, insert “Crown Estate Scotland”,</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2020/281/article/2/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2020/281/article/2/2/b" id="article-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>

</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>

<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2020/281/article/2/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2020/281/article/2/3/a" id="article-2-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2020/281/article/2/3/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2020/281/article/2/3/a/i" id="article-2-3-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after “Where applicable,” insert “targets for reducing indirect emissions of greenhouse gases,”,</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2020/281/article/2/3/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2020/281/article/2/3/a/ii" id="article-2-3-a-ii">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2020/281/article/2/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2020/281/article/2/3/b" id="article-2-3-b">

<AppendText>.</AppendText>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2020/281/article/2/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2020/281/article/2/3/c" id="article-2-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2020/281/article/2/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2020/281/article/2/3/d" id="article-2-3-d">

<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="default">

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/a" id="regulation-35-a">

<P3para>

<P1para>

<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>

</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/b" id="regulation-35-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>

<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P3>
<Pnumber>ca</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3>

<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/c" id="regulation-35-c">

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/c/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/c/i" id="regulation-35-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>

</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/c/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/c/ii" id="regulation-35-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (1) as renumbered, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where an application is modified by the applicant, any fee payable under a charging scheme for the modification of an application is payable by the applicant.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/d" id="regulation-35-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 7(3)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/d/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/d/i" id="regulation-35-d-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>

</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/d/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/d/ii" id="regulation-35-d-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>

</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e" id="regulation-35-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 8—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e/i" id="regulation-35-e-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (1)(d), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown">

<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e/ii" id="regulation-35-e-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (2), omit “(a) or (b)”,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/e/iii" id="regulation-35-e-iii">

<P3para>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/g" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/g" id="regulation-35-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 13, after sub-paragraph (2), insert—</Text>

<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>

</P3para>
</P3>

<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i" id="regulation-35-i">

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i/i" id="regulation-35-i-i">

<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2025/165/regulation/35/i/ii" id="regulation-35-i-ii">

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55" NumberOfProvisions="17" SchemaVersion="2.0" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd"><Secondary xmlns:leg="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation"><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/body" NumberOfProvisions="17"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/part/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/part/4" NumberOfProvisions="3" id="part-4"><Number>Part 4</Number><Title>Consequential Amendments</Title><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Environmental Protection (Disposal of Polychlorinated Biphenyls and other Dangerous Substances) (Scotland) Regulations 2000</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/regulation/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/regulation/14" id="regulation-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In the Environmental Protection (Disposal of Polychlorinated Biphenyls and other Dangerous Substances) (Scotland) Regulations 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>, in the definition of “disposal” in regulation 2 (interpretation and notices) and in the heading to schedule 1 (disposal operations D8, D9, D10, D12 and D15 as set out in Part II of schedule 4 of the Waste Management Licensing (Scotland) Regulations 2011) for “Part II of schedule 4 of the Waste Management Licensing (Scotland) Regulations 2011” substitute <InlineAmendment>“Annex I of Directive 2008/98EC of the European Parliament and of the Council on waste”</InlineAmendment><FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55" NumberOfProvisions="17" SchemaVersion="2.0" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd"><Secondary xmlns:leg="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation"><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/body" NumberOfProvisions="17"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/part/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/part/2" NumberOfProvisions="11" id="part-2"><Number>Part 2</Number><Title>Amendment of the Environmental Authorisations (Scotland) Regulations 2018</Title><P1group><Title>Amendment of regulation 2 (interpretation)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1) (interpretation)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/a" id="regulation-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of <InlineAmendment>“enforcing officer”</InlineAmendment>—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/a/i" id="regulation-3-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>omit the definitions of <InlineAmendment>“fuel”</InlineAmendment> and <InlineAmendment>“fit and proper person”</InlineAmendment>,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/a/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/a/ii" id="regulation-3-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>fish farm</Term>” has the meaning given by section 166 of the Marine (Scotland) Act 2010<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>fit and proper person</Term>” means a person SEPA considers to be a fit and proper person having regard to guidance published under regulation 66(1)(e),</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>fuel</Term>” means any solid, liquid, or gaseous combustible material,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/b" id="regulation-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of <InlineAmendment>“harm to the water environment”</InlineAmendment> insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>harm to the Scottish marine area</Term>” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>harm to the health of human beings or other living organisms,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>harm to the quality of the Scottish marine area, including—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="roman" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>harm to the quality of the Scottish marine area taken as a whole,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>other impairment of, or interference with, the quality of aquatic ecosystems or terrestrial ecosystems directly depending on aquatic ecosystems,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>offence to the senses of human beings,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>damage to property, or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>impairment of, or interference with, amenities or other legitimate uses of the Scottish marine area,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/c" id="regulation-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of <InlineAmendment>“pollution”</InlineAmendment><FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/c/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/c/i" id="regulation-3-c-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>omit <InlineAmendment>“, or cause offence to any human sense,”</InlineAmendment>,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/c/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/c/ii" id="regulation-3-c-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after <InlineAmendment>“quality of the environment,”</InlineAmendment> insert <InlineAmendment><InlineAmendment>“cause offence to any human sense,”</InlineAmendment></InlineAmendment>,</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ssi/2026/55/regulation/3/d" id="regulation-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of <InlineAmendment>“SEPA”</InlineAmendment> insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>Scottish marine area</Term>” has the meaning given by section 1 of the Marine (Scotland) Act 2010,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

				“chimney" for the words from  “smoke" to  “emitted" there shall be substituted the words  “smoke, grit, dust or fumes may be emitted and, in particular, includes flues", and after the definition of  “fireplace" there shall be inserted the following definition, that is to say  “'fumes’ means any airborne solid matter smaller than dust".</Text></P1para></P1></P1group></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Primary></Legislation>
