<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28" NumberOfProvisions="102" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2015-03-12"><Primary><Schedules RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2011-04-22"><Title> SCHEDULES</Title><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6" NumberOfProvisions="21" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." id="schedule-6" RestrictStartDate="2009-10-01"><Number>SCHEDULE 6</Number><TitleBlock><Title> Minor and consequential amendments</Title></TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/crossheading/the-merchant-shipping-act-1995-c-21" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/crossheading/the-merchant-shipping-act-1995-c-21" NumberOfProvisions="19" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="1997-07-17" id="schedule-6-crossheading-the-merchant-shipping-act-1995-c-21"><Title> The Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (c. 21)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/paragraph/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/paragraph/4" RestrictStartDate="1997-07-17" id="schedule-6-paragraph-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/paragraph/4/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/paragraph/4/1" id="schedule-6-paragraph-4-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>With respect to applications made after the commencement of this paragraph, section 158 of the 1995 Act (limitation actions), including that section as set out in Schedule 4 to that Act, is amended as follows.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/paragraph/4/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/paragraph/4/2" id="schedule-6-paragraph-4-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (2)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/paragraph/4/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/paragraph/4/2/a" id="schedule-6-paragraph-4-2-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words “and is entitled to limit it” there is substituted <InlineAmendment>“
                        but has not found that he is not entitled to limit it
                      ”</InlineAmendment>, and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/paragraph/4/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/paragraph/4/2/b" id="schedule-6-paragraph-4-2-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for “the limit of the liability” there is substituted <InlineAmendment>“
                        the limit which would apply to the applicant’s liability if he were entitled to limit it
                      ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/paragraph/4/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/schedule/6/paragraph/4/3" id="schedule-6-paragraph-4-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After subsection (2) there is inserted—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>2A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Where—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>a distribution is made under subsection (2)(b) above without the court having found that the applicant is entitled to limit his liability, and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the court subsequently finds that the applicant is not so entitled,</Text></P3para></P3><Text>the making of the distribution is not to be regarded as affecting the applicant’s liability in excess of the amount distributed.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></Pblock></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Primary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28" NumberOfProvisions="102" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2015-03-12"><Primary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/body" NumberOfProvisions="45" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2015-03-12"><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/crossheading/liability-and-compensation" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/crossheading/liability-and-compensation" NumberOfProvisions="7" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." id="crossheading-liability-and-compensation" RestrictStartDate="1997-07-17"><Title> Liability and compensation</Title><P1group RestrictStartDate="1997-07-17"><Title> Carriage of hazardous and noxious substances.</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/section/14" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/section/14" id="section-14"><Pnumber>14</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/section/14/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/section/14/1" id="section-14-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In Part VI of the 1995 Act (prevention of pollution), after Chapter <Acronym Expansion="4">IV</Acronym> there is inserted—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default"><Chapter><Number>Chapter V</Number><Title> Carriage of hazardous and noxious substances</Title><P1group><Title> Introductory.</Title><P1><Pnumber>182A</Pnumber><P1para><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In this Chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, “<Term>the Convention</Term>” means the International Convention on Liability and Compensation for Damage in Connection with the Carriage of Hazardous and Noxious Substances by Sea 1996.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The text of the Convention, excluding the annexes, is set out in Schedule 5A.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In interpreting the definition of “<Term>hazardous and noxious substances</Term>” in Article 1, paragraph 5 of the Convention, any reference in that paragraph to a particular convention or code as amended shall be taken to be a reference to that convention or code as amended from time to time (whether before or after the commencement of this Chapter).</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group><Title> Power to give effect to Convention.</Title><P1><Pnumber>182B</Pnumber><P1para><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Her Majesty may by Order in Council make such provision as She considers appropriate for the purpose of giving effect to—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the Convention on or after its ratification by the United Kingdom; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any revision of the Convention which appears to Her Majesty in Council to have been agreed to by the Government of the United Kingdom.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The power conferred by subsection (1) above to make provision for the purpose of giving effect to the Convention or an agreement revising the Convention includes power to provide for the provision to come into force even though the Convention or the agreement has not come into force.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Without prejudice to the generality of subsection (1) above, an Order under that subsection may include provision—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>requiring contributions to be paid in accordance with the Convention to the International Hazardous and Noxious Substances Fund established under the Convention;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for applying for the purpose mentioned in subsection (1) above any enactment or instrument relating to the pollution of the sea or other waters (including provisions creating offences) with such modifications, if any, as may be prescribed by the Order;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>making such modifications of any enactment or instrument (including, where the Order is made under paragraph (b) of that subsection, modifications of Schedule 5A and section 182C) as appear to Her Majesty to be appropriate for the purpose specified in that subsection;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>with respect to the application of the Order to the Crown;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>e</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for detaining any ship in respect of which a contravention of a provision made by or under the Order is suspected to have occurred and, in relation to such a ship, for applying section 284 with such modifications, if any, as are prescribed by the Order;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>f</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for a certificate issued by or on behalf of the Secretary of State and stating that at a particular time a particular substance was, or was not, a hazardous or noxious substance for the purposes of the Convention to be conclusive evidence of that matter.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>An Order under subsection (1) above may—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>make different provision for different circumstances;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>make provision for references in the Order to any specified document to operate as references to that document as revised or re-issued from time to time;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>provide for the delegation of functions exercisable by virtue of the Order;</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>include such incidental, supplemental and transitional provisions as appear to Her Majesty to be expedient for the purposes of the Order; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>e</Pnumber><P3para><Text>authorise the making of regulations for the purposes of this section (except the purposes of subsection (3)(a), (b) and (c) above).</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A draft of an Order in Council proposed to be made by virtue of this section shall not be submitted to Her Majesty in Council unless it has been approved by a resolution of each House of Parliament.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group><P1group><Title> Power of Secretary of State to make orders.</Title><P1><Pnumber>182C</Pnumber><P1para><P2><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Secretary of State may by order make such amendments of Schedule 5A and any Order in Council under section 182B(1) as appear to him to be appropriate for the purpose of giving effect to any amendment of a relevant limit which is adopted in accordance with article 48 of the Convention.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (1) above, “<Term>a relevant limit</Term>” means any of the limits for the time being specified in article 9, paragraph 1 and article 14, paragraph 5 of the Convention.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Chapter></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/section/14/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/section/14/2" id="section-14-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After Schedule 5 to the 1995 Act there is inserted, as Schedule 5A to that Act, the provision set out in Schedule 3.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock></Body></Primary></Legislation>

id="section-8"><Pnumber>8</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/section/8/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/section/8/1" id="section-8-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Section 85 of the 1995 Act (safety and health on ships) is amended as mentioned in subsections (2) to (5).</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/section/8/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/section/8/2" id="section-8-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (1), for paragraphs (b) and (c) and the words following paragraph (c) there is substituted—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for securing the safety of other ships and persons on them while they are within United Kingdom waters and for protecting the health of persons on ships other than United Kingdom ships while they are within United Kingdom waters.</Text></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/section/8/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/section/8/3" id="section-8-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After subsection (1) there is inserted—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>1A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Except as provided by subsection (1B) below, safety regulations shall not apply in relation to—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>a qualifying foreign ship while it is exercising—</Text><P4><Pnumber>i</Pnumber><P4para><Text>the right of innocent passage; or</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>ii</Pnumber><P4para><Text>the right of transit passage through straits used for international navigation; or</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>persons on such a ship while it is exercising any such right.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>1B</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Safety regulations shall apply in relation to a qualifying foreign ship, and persons on such a ship, even though the ship is exercising a right mentioned in subsection (1A)(a) above, to the extent that the safety regulations give effect to any provisions of an international agreement ratified by the United Kingdom so far as it relates to the safety of ships or persons on them or to the protection of the health of persons on ships.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/section/8/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/section/8/4" id="section-8-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (3)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1997/28/section/8/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1997/28/section/8/4/a" id="section-8-4-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>the words from “and regulations” to <InlineAmendment>“
                      relates to safety

DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/crossheading/the-offshore-safety-act-1992-c-15" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/crossheading/the-offshore-safety-act-1992-c-15" NumberOfProvisions="1" RestrictStartDate="1999-02-15" id="schedule-4-crossheading-the-offshore-safety-act-1992-c-15"><Title> The Offshore Safety Act 1992 (c. 15)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33" RestrictStartDate="1999-02-15" id="schedule-4-paragraph-33"><Pnumber>33</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/1" id="schedule-4-paragraph-33-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Offshore Safety Act 1992 shall be amended as follows.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/2" id="schedule-4-paragraph-33-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In section 1 (application of Part I of Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 for offshore purposes)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/2/a" id="schedule-4-paragraph-33-2-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in subsection (3), for paragraph (b) there shall be substituted—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>sections 20 and 25 of the Petroleum Act 1998;</Text></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment><AppendText>,and in paragraph (c) the words from “section” to “requirements and”shall be omitted;</AppendText></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/2/b" id="schedule-4-paragraph-33-2-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in subsection (4), for the definitions of “pipe-line” and “pipe-line works” there shall be substituted—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P3para><Text>“<Term>pipe-line</Term>” means, subject to subsection (4A), a controlled pipeline within the meaning of Part III of the Petroleum Act 1998; and</Text></P3para><P3para><Text>“<Term>pipe-line works</Term>” means works of any of the following kinds, namely—</Text><P4><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P4para><Text>assembling or placing a pipe-line or length of pipe-line;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P4para><Text>inspecting, testing, maintaining, adjusting, repairing, altering or renewing a pipe-line or length of pipe-line;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P4para><Text>changing the position of or dismantling or removing a pipe-line or length of pipe-line;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P4para><Text>opening the bed of the sea for the purposes of works mentioned in paragraphs (a) to (c), tunnelling or boring for those purposes and other works needed for or incidental to those purposes;</Text></P4para></P4><P4><Pnumber>e</Pnumber><P4para><Text>works for the purpose of determining whether a place is suitable as part of the site of a proposed pipe-line and the carrying out of surveying operations for the purpose of settling the route of a proposed pipe-line.</Text></P4para></P4></P3para></BlockAmendment><AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/2/c" id="schedule-4-paragraph-33-2-c"><Pnumber>c</Pnumber><P3para><Text>after subsection (4) there shall be inserted—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>4A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In this section “<Term>pipe-line</Term>” does not include—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any pipe-line so far as it forms part of the equipment of a vessel or vehicle; or</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>any apparatus and works associated with a pipe or system of pipes and prescribed for the purpose of this paragraph by regulations made by the Secretary of State.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>4B</Pnumber><P2para><Text>A statutory instrument containing regulations made by virtue of subsection (4A) shall be subject to annulment in pursuance of a resolution of either House of Parliament; and section 25 of the Petroleum Act 1998 shall apply in relation to any such regulations as it applies in relation to regulations under section 20 of that Act.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment><AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/2/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/2/d" id="schedule-4-paragraph-33-2-d"><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in subsection (5), paragraph (b) and, in paragraph (c), the words “16(1) or” shall be omitted and at the end of paragraph (c) there shall be inserted—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><Text>; or
                        </Text><P3><Pnumber>d</Pnumber><P3para><Text>section 14(2) or 45 of the Petroleum Act 1998,</Text></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/3" id="schedule-4-paragraph-33-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In section 3 (consequential provisions), in subsections (2)(b) and (4) for “section 2 of the Petroleum (Production) Act 1934” there shall be substituted <InlineAmendment>“
                    section 3 of the Petroleum Act 1998
                  ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1998/17/schedule/4/paragraph/33/4" id="schedule-4-paragraph-33-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In section 5 (directions for preserving security of petroleum and petroleum products), in the definition of “<Term id="term-petroleum">petroleum</Term>” in subsection (7), for “the Petroleum (Production) Act 1934” there shall be substituted <InlineAmendment>“
                    Part I of the Petroleum Act 1998
                  ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></Pblock></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Primary></Legislation>

RestrictStartDate="2022-11-30"><Number>SCHEDULE 13</Number><TitleBlock><Title> Functions transferred to justices’ chief executives</Title></TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/22/schedule/13/crossheading/the-merchant-shipping-act-1995-c21" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/22/schedule/13/crossheading/the-merchant-shipping-act-1995-c21" NumberOfProvisions="1" RestrictStartDate="2001-04-01" id="schedule-13-crossheading-the-merchant-shipping-act-1995-c21"><Title> The Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (c.21)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/22/schedule/13/paragraph/174" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/22/schedule/13/paragraph/174" RestrictStartDate="2001-04-01" id="schedule-13-paragraph-174"><Pnumber>174</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/22/schedule/13/paragraph/174/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/22/schedule/13/paragraph/174/1" id="schedule-13-paragraph-174-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Section 68 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (power to summon witness) is amended as follows.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/22/schedule/13/paragraph/174/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/22/schedule/13/paragraph/174/2" id="schedule-13-paragraph-174-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (4)
					(particulars of fine to be given to clerk), for “clerk” substitute <InlineAmendment>“
                    proper officer
                  ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/22/schedule/13/paragraph/174/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/22/schedule/13/paragraph/174/3" id="schedule-13-paragraph-174-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After that subsection insert—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>4A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (1) above “<Term>proper officer</Term>” means—</Text><P3><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in relation to a magistrates’ court in England and Wales, the justices’ chief executive for the court, and</Text></P3para></P3><P3><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in relation to a magistrates’ court in Northern Ireland, the clerk of the court.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></Pblock></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Primary></Legislation>

RestrictStartDate="2018-09-01"><Title> SCHEDULES</Title><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5" NumberOfProvisions="48" id="schedule-5" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2018-09-01"><Number>SCHEDULE 5</Number><TitleBlock><Title> Minor and consequential amendments</Title></TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/crossheading/environment-act-1995-c-25" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/crossheading/environment-act-1995-c-25" NumberOfProvisions="1" id="schedule-5-crossheading-environment-act-1995-c-25" RestrictStartDate="2000-04-01"><Title> Environment Act 1995 (c. 25)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44" RestrictStartDate="2000-04-01" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44"><Pnumber>44</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/1" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Section 42 of the Environment Act 1995 (approval of charging schemes) shall be amended as follows.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/2" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (3)(b)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/2/a" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44-2-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in sub-paragraph (i) for the words “Minister” and “his” there shall be substituted respectively the words <InlineAmendment>“
                        Food Standards Agency
                      ”</InlineAmendment> and <InlineAmendment>“
                        its
                      ”</InlineAmendment>; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/2/b" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44-2-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>sub-paragraph (ii) shall be omitted.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/3" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (4)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/3/a" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44-3-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words “Minister’s or the Secretary of State’s” there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                        Food Standards Agency’s
                      ”</InlineAmendment>;</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/3/b" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44-3-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in paragraph (b), for the words from “the Minister” to “be” there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                        or the Food Standards Agency
                      ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/4" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (7), the words from “and, if” to the end shall cease to have effect.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/5" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (9)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/5/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/5/a" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44-5-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for paragraphs (a) and (b) there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                        such of the costs and expenses incurred by the Food Standards Agency as fall within subsection (3) above
                      ”</InlineAmendment>; and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/5/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/5/b" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44-5-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>for the words from “to the Secretary” to the end there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                        to the Food Standards Agency
                      ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/28/schedule/5/paragraph/44/6" id="schedule-5-paragraph-44-6"><Pnumber>6</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (10), for the words from “paragraph (a) or” to the end there shall be substituted the words <InlineAmendment>“
                    that subsection shall be determined by the Secretary of State.
                  ”</InlineAmendment></Text></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></Pblock></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Primary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/29" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/29" NumberOfProvisions="1243" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2026-08-05"><Primary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/29/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/29/body" NumberOfProvisions="537" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2026-08-05"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/29/part/IX" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/29/part/IX" NumberOfProvisions="35" id="part-IX" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2025-02-24"><Number>Part IX</Number><Title> Environmental functions</Title><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/29/part/IX/crossheading/air-quality" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/29/part/IX/crossheading/air-quality" NumberOfProvisions="9" id="part-IX-crossheading-air-quality" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2012-05-03"><Title> Air quality</Title><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W+S" RestrictStartDate="2011-04-22"><Title> Directions under the Environment Act 1995.</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/29/section/367" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/29/section/367" id="section-367"><Pnumber>367</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/1" id="section-367-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Section 85 of the <CommentaryRef Ref="c12807781"/>Environment Act 1995 (reserve powers of the Secretary of State in relation to air quality) shall be amended in accordance with <Addition ChangeId="d29p29869" CommentaryRef="c12807791">subsections (2) to (5)</Addition>below.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/2" id="section-367-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (1) (definition of “<Term id="term-appropriate-authority">appropriate authority</Term>” for the purposes of the section)—</Text><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/2/a" id="section-367-2-a"><Pnumber>a</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in paragraph (a), for “England and Wales, the Secretary of State; and” there shall be substituted <InlineAmendment>“
                        local authorities in England and Wales other than local authorities in Greater London, the Secretary of State;
                      ”</InlineAmendment>, and</Text></P3para></P3><P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/2/b" id="section-367-2-b"><Pnumber>b</Pnumber><P3para><Text>after that paragraph there shall be inserted—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default"><P3><Pnumber>aa</Pnumber><P3para><Text>in relation to local authorities in Greater London, the Mayor of London; and</Text></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment><AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para></P3></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/3" id="section-367-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After subsection (4) there shall be inserted—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>4A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The powers of the Mayor of London to give directions under this section to a local authority in Greater London may only be exercised after consultation with the local authority concerned.</Text></P2para></P2><P2><Pnumber>4B</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In exercising any function under subsection (2), (3) or (4) above the Mayor of London shall have regard to any guidance issued by the Secretary of State to local authorities under section 88(1) below.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/4" id="section-367-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In subsection (5) (power of the Secretary of State to give directions relating to obligations under the  <Substitution ChangeId="key-e6aabb-1559056704370" CommentaryRef="key-e6aabb">EU</Substitution>  Treaties or to international obligations) after “local authorities” there shall be inserted <InlineAmendment>“
                    , other than local authorities in Greater London,
                  ”</InlineAmendment>.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/29/section/367/5" id="section-367-5"><Pnumber>5</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After subsection (6) (publishing of directions under the section) there shall be inserted—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>6A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Mayor of London shall send a copy of any direction he gives under this section to the Secretary of State.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Pblock></Part></Body></Primary></Legislation>

RestrictStartDate="1999-11-01"><Title> SCHEDULES</Title><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3" NumberOfProvisions="19" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="1999-12-23" id="schedule-3"><Number>SCHEDULE 3</Number><TitleBlock><Title> Minor and consequential amendments</Title></TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3/part/I" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3/part/I" NumberOfProvisions="5" RestrictStartDate="1999-12-23" id="schedule-3-part-I"><Number>Part I</Number><Title> England and Wales</Title><Pblock DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3/part/I/crossheading/water-industry-act-1991-c-56" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3/part/I/crossheading/water-industry-act-1991-c-56" NumberOfProvisions="5" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2000-04-01" id="schedule-3-part-I-crossheading-water-industry-act-1991-c-56"><Title> Water Industry Act 1991 (c. 56)</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3/paragraph/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3/paragraph/4" RestrictStartDate="1999-12-23" id="schedule-3-paragraph-4"><Pnumber>4</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3/paragraph/4/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3/paragraph/4/1" id="schedule-3-paragraph-4-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Section 195 of that Act (the Director’s register) is amended as follows.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3/paragraph/4/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3/paragraph/4/2" id="schedule-3-paragraph-4-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>At the end of subsection (1) there is inserted <InlineAmendment>“
                       and of section 143 above
                    ”</InlineAmendment> .</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3/paragraph/4/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/9/schedule/3/paragraph/4/3" id="schedule-3-paragraph-4-3"><Pnumber>3</Pnumber><P2para><Text>After subsection (3) there is inserted—</Text><BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default"><P2><Pnumber>3A</Pnumber><P2para><Text>The Director shall also cause to be entered on the register the provisions of any guidance given to him by the Secretary of State under section 143(7) above.</Text></P2para></P2></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></Pblock></Part></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Primary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/9" NumberOfProvisions="58" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="1999-06-30"><Primary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1999/9/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/1999/9/body" NumberOfProvisions="23" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I."                   Subject to subsections (2A), (3) and (3A)

whose area the seizure takes place.7A person commits an offence if—ahe fails without reasonable excuse to comply with a requirement imposed under paragraph (a) of subsection (2) above;bhe fails an authorised officer or constable in the exercise of a power under that subsection.8A person is not guilty of an offence by virtue of subsection (7)(a) above unless it is shown—athat the waste in question was controlled waste; andbthat the waste was or was being transported to or from a place in Great Britain.9Where an authorised officer or constable has stopped a vehicle under subsection (5) above, he may (in addition to any requirement that may be imposed under paragraph (a) of subsection (2) above) require any occupant of the vehicle to give him—athe occupant's name and address;bthe name and address of the registered owner of the vehicle;cany other information he may reasonably request.10A person commits an offence if—ahe fails without reasonable excuse to comply with a requirement under subsection (9) above;bhe gives information required under that subsection that is—ito his knowledge false or misleading in a material way, oriigiven recklessly and is false or misleading in a material way.11A person guilty of an offence under this section is liable on summary conviction to a fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.Seizure of vehicles etc: supplementary5A1Where under section 5 above an authorised officer of a regulation authority or a constable seizes a vehicle or its contents (“seized property”) on behalf of a regulation authority, the authority may remove the seized property to such a place as the authority consider appropriate.2A regulation authority must deal with any seized property in accordance with regulations made by the appropriate person.3Regulations under subsection (2) above may in particular include provision as to—athe duties of a regulation authority in relation to the safe custody of seized property;bthe circumstances in which the authority must return any such property to a person claiming entitlement to it;cthe manner in which such persons, and the seized property to which they are entitled, may be determined;dthe circumstances in which the authority may sell, destroy or otherwise dispose of seized property;ethe uses to which the proceeds of any such sale may be put.4Regulations making provision under subsection (3)(d) above—amust (subject to paragraph (c) below) require the regulation authority to publish a notice in such form, and to take any other steps, as may be specified in the regulations for informing persons who may be entitled to the seized property that it has been seized and is available to be claimed;bmust (subject to paragraph (c) below) prohibit the authority from selling, destroying or otherwise disposing of any seized property unless a period specified in the regulations has expired without any obligation arising under the regulations for the authority to return the property to any person;cmay allow for the requirements in paragraphs (a) and (b) above to be dispensed with if the condition of the seized property requires its disposal without delay.5The appropriate person may issue guidance to regulation authorities in relation to the performance of their functions under regulations under subsection (2) above.Failure to produce authority: fixed penalty notices381In the Control of Pollution (Amendment) Act 1989 (c. 14), after section 5A (as inserted by section 37 above) insert—Fixed penalty notices for offences under section 55B1This section applies where it appears to a regulation authority that a person has failed without reasonable excuse to comply with a requirement under section 5(2)(a) above (requirement to produce authority to transport waste).2The regulation authority may give that person a notice offering him the opportunity of discharging any liability to conviction for an offence under section 5(7)(a) above by payment of a fixed penalty.3Where a person is given a notice under this section in respect of an offence—ano proceedings may be instituted for that offence before expiration of the period of fourteen days following the date of the notice; andbhe may not be convicted of that offence if he pays the fixed penalty before the expiration of the period.4A notice under this section must give such particulars of the circumstances alleged to constitute the offence as are necessary for giving reasonable information of the offence.5A notice under this section must also state—athe period during which, by virtue of subsection (3) above, proceedings will not be taken for the offence;bthe amount of the fixed penalty; andcthe person to whom and the address at which the fixed penalty may be paid.6Without prejudice to payment by any other method, payment of the fixed penalty may be made by pre-paying and posting a letter containing the amount of the penalty (in cash or otherwise) to the person mentioned in subsection (5)(c) above at the address so mentioned.7Where a letter is sent in accordance with subsection (6) above payment is to be regarded as having been made at the time at which that letter would be delivered in the ordinary course of post.8The form of a notice under this section must be such as the appropriate person may by order prescribe.9The fixed penalty payable to a regulation authority under this section is, subject to subsection (10) below, £300.10The appropriate person may by order substitute a different amount for the amount for the time being specified in subsection (9) above.11The regulation authority to which a fixed penalty is payable under this section may make provision for treating it as having been paid if a lesser amount is paid before the end of a period specified by the authority.12The appropriate person may by regulations restrict the extent to which, and the circumstances in which, a regulation authority may make provision under subsection (11) above.13In any proceedings a certificate which—apurports to be signed on behalf of the chief finance officer of the regulation authority, andbstates that payment of a fixed penalty was or was not received by a date specified in the certificate,is evidence of the facts stated.14In this section “chief finance officer”, in relation to a regulation authority, means the person having responsibility for the financial affairs of the authority.Use of fixed penalties under section 5B5C1This section applies in relation to amounts paid to a regulation authority in pursuance of notices under section 5B above (its “fixed penalty receipts”).2Fixed penalty receipts—awhere received by the Environment Agency, must be paid to the Secretary of State;bwhere received by a waste collection authority, must be used in accordance with the following provisions of this section.3A waste collection authority may use its fixed penalty receipts only for the purposes of—aits functions under section 5 above (including functions relating to the enforcement of offences under that section);bsuch other of its functions as may be specified in regulations made by the appropriate person.4Regulations under subsection (3)(b) above may in particular have the effect that an authority may use its fixed penalty receipts for the purposes of any of its functions.5A waste collection authority must supply the appropriate person with such information relating to its use of its fixed penalty receipts as the appropriate person may require.6The appropriate person may by regulations—amake provision for what a waste collection authority is to do with its fixed penalty receipts—ipending their being used for the purposes of functions of the authority referred to in subsection (3) above;iiif they are not so used before such time after their receipt as may be specified by the order;bmake provision for accounting arrangements in respect of a waste collection authority's fixed penalty receipts.7The provision that may be made under subsection (6)(a)(ii) above includes (in particular) provision for the payment of sums to a person (including the appropriate person) other than the authority.8Before making regulations under this section, the appropriate person must consult—athe authorities to which the regulations are to apply;bsuch other persons as the appropriate person thinks fit.9The powers to make regulations conferred by this section are, for the purposes of subsection (1) of section 100 of the Local Government Act 2003, to be regarded as included among the powers mentioned in subsection (2) of that section.

<P4para>

<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>

</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="double" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>Northern Ireland information notice</Term>” means a notice given under paragraph <InternalLink Ref="schedule-3-paragraph-9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2021/30/schedule/3/paragraph/9" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2021/30/schedule/3/paragraph/9">9</InternalLink> of Schedule 3;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="double" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>review application</Term>” has the meaning it has in Part <InternalLink Ref="schedule-3-part-1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2021/30/schedule/3/part/1" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2021/30/schedule/3/part/1">1</InternalLink> of Schedule 3 (see paragraph <InternalLink Ref="schedule-3-paragraph-12" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/ukpga/2021/30/schedule/3/paragraph/12" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/2021/30/schedule/3/paragraph/12">12</InternalLink> of that Schedule);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="double" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term>Scottish devolved function</Term>” means a function exercisable in or as regards Scotland, the exercise of which would be within devolved competence (within the meaning of section 54 of the Scotland Act 1998);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" Format="double" TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown">
<UnorderedList Class="Definition" Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>

</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056" NumberOfProvisions="165" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/body" NumberOfProvisions="37" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Citation, commencement, interpretation and extent</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1" id="regulation-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/1" id="regulation-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations may be cited as the Waste Management Licensing Regulations 1994 and, except for regulations 4 and 5, shall come into force on 1st May 1994.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/2" id="regulation-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Regulations 4 and 5 shall come into force on 10th August 1994.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/3" id="regulation-1-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In these Regulations, unless the context otherwise requires—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Environmental Protection Act 1990 c. 43">1990 Act</Abbreviation>” means the Environmental Protection Act 1990;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Environmental Protection (Prescribed Processes and Substances) Regulations 1991 (S.I. 1991/472)">1991 Regulations</Abbreviation>” means the Environmental Protection (Prescribed Processes and Substances) Regulations 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“construction work” includes the repair, alteration or improvement of existing works;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Abbreviation Expansion="Council Directive 75/442/EEC on waste as amended by Council Directives 91/156/EEC and 91/692/EEC">the Directive</Abbreviation>” means Council Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1975/0442" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1975" Number="442">75/442/<Acronym Expansion="European Economic Community">EEC</Acronym></Citation> on waste<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> as amended by Council Directives <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1991/0156" id="c00002" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1991" Number="156">91/156/EEC</Citation><FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> and <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1991/0692" id="c00003" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1991" Number="692">91/692/EEC</Citation><FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Directive waste” means any substance or object in the categories set out in Part II of Schedule 4 which the producer or the person in possession of it discards or intends or is required to discard but with the exception of anything excluded from the scope of the Directive by Article 2 of the Directive, “discard” has the same meaning as in the Directive, and “producer” means anyone whose activities produce Directive waste or who carries out preprocessing, mixing or other operations resulting in a change in its nature or composition;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“disposal” means any of the operations listed in Part III of Schedule 4, and anyreference to waste being disposed of is a reference to its being submitted to any ofthose operations;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“disposal licence” and “disposal authority” have the meaning given by sections 3(1)and 30(2) to (2D) respectively of the Control of Pollution Act 1974<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“enforcing authority” and “local enforcing authority” have the meaning given bysection 1(7) and (8) of the 1990 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“exempt activity” means any of the activities set out in Schedule 3;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“inland waters”—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in England and Wales, has the meaning given by section 221(1) of the Water Resources Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in Scotland, has the meaning given by section 30A of the Control of Pollution Act 1974<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/> except that it includes any loch or pond whether or not it discharges into a river or watercourse;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“operational land” has the meaning given by sections 263 and 264 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/> or, in Scotland, sections 211 and 212 of the Town and Country Planning (Scotland) Act 1972<FootnoteRef Ref="f00015"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“recovery” means any of the operations listed in Part IV of Schedule 4, and any reference to waste being recovered is a reference to its being submitted to any of those operations;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“scrap metal” has the meaning given by section 9(2) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 1964<FootnoteRef Ref="f00016"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“special waste” has the meaning given by regulation 2 of the Control of Pollution (Special Waste) Regulations 1980<FootnoteRef Ref="f00017"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“waste” means Directive waste;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“waste management licence” has the meaning given by section 35(1) of the 1990 Act,and “site licence” has the meaning given by section 35(12) of the 1990 Act;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“waste oil” means any mineral-based lubricating or industrial oil which has become unfit for the use for which it was originally intended and, in particular, used combustion engine oil, gearbox oil, mineral lubricating oil, oil for turbines and hydraulic oil;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“waste regulation authority”, “waste disposal authority” and “waste collection authority” have the meaning given by section 30 of the 1990 Act; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“work” includes preparatory work.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/4" id="regulation-1-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Any reference in these Regulations to carrying on business as a scrap metal dealer has the meaning given by section 9(1) of the Scrap Metal Dealers Act 1964, and any reference, in relation to Scotland, to carrying on business as a metal dealer has the meaning given by section 37(2) of the Civic Government (Scotland) Act 1982<FootnoteRef Ref="f00018"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5" id="regulation-1-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Regulations 13, 14 and 15, and Schedule 4, shall apply in relation to land in the area of a waste disposal authority in Scotland which is occupied by the authority as if—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1056/regulation/1/5/a" id="regulation-1-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>references to a waste management licence were references to a resolution undersection 54 of the 1990 Act;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>

<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Sections 28, 29, 32, 38, 44 and 47 of the 1987 Act shall also apply for the purposes of providing for the enforcement of these Regulations and in respect of proceedings for contravention thereof as if—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>references to safety provisions were references to these Regulations;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in section 28, subsections (3), (4) and (5) were omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sections 28 and 29 the words “or any provision made by or under Part III of this Act”, on each occasion that they occur, were omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in section 29, subsections (4), (6) and (7) and paragraph</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>of subsection (5) were omitted; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in section 38(1), paragraphs (a) to (c) and (e) were omitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Sections 39 and 40 shall apply to offences under section 32 as it is applied to these Regulations by paragraph (1) above.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1386/regulation/3/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1386/regulation/3/e" id="regulation-3-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 7 shall be re-numbered as regulation 9, and paragraph (1) shall be amended as follows—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1386/regulation/3/e/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1386/regulation/3/e/i" id="regulation-3-e-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>delete the words “any of the provisions of regulation 3(1) or”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1386/regulation/3/e/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1386/regulation/3/e/ii" id="regulation-3-e-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>delete “regulation 6(2)” and substitute “regulation 7(2)”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1994/1386/regulation/3/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/1386/regulation/3/f" id="regulation-3-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>regulation 8 shall be re-numbered as regulation 10.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592" NumberOfProvisions="110" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Schedules><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9" NumberOfProvisions="11" NumberFormat="default" id="schedule-9"><Number>SCHEDULE 9</Number><TitleBlock>
<Title>MODIFICATIONS</Title>
</TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/part/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/part/2" NumberOfProvisions="1" id="schedule-9-part-2"><Title>The Factories Act 1961</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2" id="schedule-9-paragraph-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Factories Act 1961<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> is modified as follows—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/a" id="schedule-9-paragraph-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in section 127, sub-section (3) shall cease to have effect;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/b" id="schedule-9-paragraph-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in section 176, in sub-section (1)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/b/i" id="schedule-9-paragraph-2-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “building operation” shall be deleted and the following substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P4para>
<Text>“building operation” and “work of engineering construction” mean “construction work” within the meaning assigned to that phrase by regulation 2(1) of the Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 1994 (<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1994/3140" id="c00001" Class="UnitedKingdomStatutoryInstrument" Year="1994" Number="3140">S.I. 1994/3140</Citation>);</Text>
</P4para></BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/b/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1996/1592/schedule/9/paragraph/2/b/ii" id="schedule-9-paragraph-2-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the definition of “work of engineering construction” is deleted.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1></Part></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1) (interpretation) the definition of “river purification authority” shall cease to have effect and there shall be inserted at the appropriate place—</Text>

law.title: Control of Pollution (Silage, Slurry and Agricultural Fuel Oil) Regulations

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547" NumberOfProvisions="2" xml:lang="en" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="1997-04-01"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/body" NumberOfProvisions="2" NumberFormat="default" RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="1997-04-01"><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W" RestrictStartDate="1997-04-01"><Title>Amendment of the Control of Pollution (Silage, Slurry and Agricultural Fuel Oil) Regulations 1991</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-b68866"/>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Control of Pollution (Silage, Slurry and Agricultural Fuel Oil) Regulations 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> shall be amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2, for the definition of “relevant substance”, the following definitions shall be substituted —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant substance” means slurry, fuel oil, a crop being made into silage or silage which is being stored;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“silage effluent” means effluent from silage or a crop being made into silage;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“silo” means any structure used for making or storing silage;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3 —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/a" id="regulation-2-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1)–</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/a/i" id="regulation-2-3-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>for the words “Subject to regulation 7 below,” there shall be substituted the words “Subject to paragraph (1A) below,”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/a/ii" id="regulation-2-3-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the words “any crop which is being made into silage” there shall be inserted the words “or any silage which is being stored”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/a/iii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/a/iii" id="regulation-2-3-a-iii">
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a), at the beginning, there shall be inserted the words “subject to paragraph (1B) below,”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/a/iv" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/a/iv" id="regulation-2-3-a-iv">
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (b) for the words “inland or coastal waters” there shall be substituted the words “inland freshwaters or coastal waters”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/a/v" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/a/v" id="regulation-2-3-a-v">
<Pnumber>v</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (b), the following shall be added —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3para>
<Text>;or</Text>
</P3para>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>it is a crop being made into field silage or silage which is being stored on open land and —</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the Agency is given notice of the place where the silage is to be made or stored at least 14 days before it is first used for that purpose; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the place is at least 10 metres from any inland freshwaters or coastal waters, and at least the specified distance<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> from any protected water supply source<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>, which silage effluent could enter if it escaped.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/b" id="regulation-2-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (1), the following paragraphs shall be added —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Paragraph (1) above shall not apply to silage whilst it is stored temporarily in a container, trailer or vehicle in connection with its transport about the farm or elsewhere.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Agency may by notice relax the requirements of paragraph (1)(a) above subject to such conditions (if any) as are specified in the notice where a silo is used solely for the purpose of storing silage made elsewhere if it is satisfied that there is no significant risk of pollution of controlled waters from that use of the silo.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1C</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A water supply source is a protected water supply source if —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any relevant abstraction from the source is licensed under Part II of the Water Resources Act 1991; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any relevant abstraction from the source is not so licensed but the person making or storing the silage was aware of the source’s location before the making of the silage began or, in the case of silage made elsewhere, before it was stored on the land in question.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1D</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The specified distance in relation to a protected water supply source is 50 metres from the nearest relevant abstraction point.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/c" id="regulation-2-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) for the words “inland or coastal waters” there shall be substituted the words “inland freshwaters or coastal waters”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/3/d" id="regulation-2-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end of paragraph (2), the following paragraph shall be added —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this regulation —</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“field silage” means silage made on open land by a method which is different from that described in paragraph (1)(b) above;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“relevant abstraction” means the abstraction of water from inland freshwaters or ground waters for use for —</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>human consumption or other domestic purposes within the meaning of section 218 of the Water Industry Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>; or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>for manufacturing food or drink for human consumption;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“water supply source” means inland freshwaters or ground waters from which any relevant abstraction is made or licensed to be made.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Regulations 7<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> and 8(2) shall be omitted; but regulation 3 shall apply in relation to the making of field silage or storage of any silage at any place where silage was made in reliance on the exemption in regulation 7 as if the Agency had been given notice in accordance with regulation 3(1)(c)(i).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/5" id="regulation-2-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 8(3) for the words “paragraphs (1) and (2)” there shall be substituted “paragraph (1)”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/6" id="regulation-2-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The following paragraph shall be substituted for regulation 9(1) —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Agency may serve notice on any person, who has custody or control of any relevant substance in circumstances in which these Regulations apply, requiring him to carry out such works, take such precautions or such other steps as are specified in the notice and which, in the opinion of the Agency, are appropriate, having regard to any requirements of these Regulations in relation to that substance, for reducing to a minimum any significant risk of pollution of controlled waters arising from the custody or control of that substance.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/7" id="regulation-2-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 10(5) for the words “by a period equal to the period beginning with the date on which notice of appeal is served and ending” there shall be, substituted the words “so that it expires”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/8" id="regulation-2-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph 6 of Schedule 1 for the words “inland or coastal waters” there shall be substituted the words “inland freshwaters or coastal waters”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/9" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/9" id="regulation-2-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 2 —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/9/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/9/a" id="regulation-2-9-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end of paragraph 5(1), there shall be added the words “or such smaller capacity as the Agency may agree in writing is adequate to avoid any significant risk of pollution of controlled waters”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/9/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/9/b" id="regulation-2-9-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 7 for the words “inland or coastal waters” there shall be substituted the words “inland freshwaters or coastal waters” and at the end of that paragraph, there shall be added the words “unless such precautions are taken as the Agency may agree in writing are adequate to avoid any significant risk of pollution of controlled waters”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/10" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1997/547/regulation/2/10" id="regulation-2-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In paragraph 7 of Schedule 3 for the words “inland or coastal waters” there shall be substituted the words “inland freshwaters or coastal waters”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>
