<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-6d7a90"/>120</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/1" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Environment Act 1995 is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 31 (guidance on sustainable development and other aims and objectives)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2/a" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsections (5), (6) and (7), for “each House of Parliament”, “either House” and “Parliament”, as the case may be, there is substituted “the Scottish Parliament”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2/b" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (5) “or, if the draft is laid on different days, the later of the two days.” is omitted; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/2/c" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (7) “ during which both Houses are” is omitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/3" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 42(7) (approval of charging schemes), after “charging scheme” there is inserted “submitted by the Agency”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/4" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the following sections “in the case of the Agency only,” is inserted in the places indicated–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/4/a" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sections 44(1) (general financial duties) and 48(2) (borrowing powers), at the beginning of paragraph (b) in each subsection;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/4/b" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in section 45(2) (accounts and records), after “appropriate Ministers have”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/4/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/4/c" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sections 47 (grants to the new agencies), 49(1) (government loans to the new agencies) and 50(1) (government guarantees of a new Agency’s borrowing), after “appropriate Minister may,”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/4/d" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/4/d" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-4-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in section 49(2), after “that Minister may”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/5" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 44 (general financial duties)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/5/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/5/a" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (3)–</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/5/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/5/a/i" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-5-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>“the Treasury and” is omitted;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/5/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/5/a/ii" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-5-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after “a new Agency,” there is inserted “and, in the case of the Agency only, after consultation with Treasury,”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/5/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/5/b" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in subsection (4), after “Treasury” there is inserted “(in the case of the Agency only)”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/6" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 50(4), after “direction under this subsection” there is inserted “in the case of the Agency only”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/1999/1820/schedule/2/paragraph/120/7" id="schedule-2-paragraph-120-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 98 (1) (grants for purposes conducive to conservation), after “ Treasury” there is inserted “ as respects England and Wales”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1842/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1842" NumberOfProvisions="2" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1842/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1842/body" NumberOfProvisions="2" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Water Industry Act 1991</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1842/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1842/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1842/regulation/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1842/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Water Industry Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> shall be amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1842/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1842/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 7(5) (continuity of appointments, replacement appointments etc.) the following shall be substituted for paragraph (a)—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the premises are, or are likely to be, supplied with not less than the following quantity of water in any period of twelve months:</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>if the area of the relevant undertaker concerned is wholly or mainly in Wales, 250 megalitres;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in all other cases, 100 megalitres; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1842/regulation/2/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1842/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In section 158 (powers to lay pipes in streets), the following shall be substituted for subsection (9)—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="primary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the company which has replaced the relevant undertaker has done so as water undertaker, in the application of this section and section 159 below in relation to that company any pipe supplying, or intended to supply, any of the premises referred to in subsection (8)(c) above with a supply of water which exceeds, or is likely to exceed, in any period of twelve months—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>if the area of the relevant undertaker concerned is wholly or mainly in Wales, 250 megalitres;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in all other cases, 100 megalitres,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>shall, for the purposes of subsection (7) above, be deemed to be a water main.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-783b10"/>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1937/regulation/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1937/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Pipe-lines Act 1962<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> is amended as set out in Schedule 1 to these Regulations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1937/regulation/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1937/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Gas Act 1986<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> is amended as set out in Schedule 2 to these Regulations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1937/regulation/2/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1937/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Gas Act 1995<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/> is amended as set out in Schedule 3 to these Regulations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2000/1937/regulation/2/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2000/1937/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Petroleum Act 1998<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> is amended as set out in Schedule 4 to these Regulations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2174/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/2174" NumberOfProvisions="26" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2174/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/2174/body" NumberOfProvisions="16" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations 1992</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2174/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/2174/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations 1992<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/> shall be amended—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/2174/regulation/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/2174/regulation/6/a" id="regulation-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in regulation 2(1), by inserting, before the definition of “new workplace”, the following definition—</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“<Term id="term-disabled-person">disabled person</Term>” has the meaning given by section 1 of the Disability Discrimination Act 1995;</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha" Start="2">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in the definition of “workplace” in regulation 2(1), by deleting the words “but shall not” to the end of the definition;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by inserting after regulation 4 the following regulation—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Stability and solidity</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>4A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where a workplace is in a building, the building shall have a stability and solidity appropriate to the nature of the use of the workplace.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in regulation 5(3)—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="roman">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by deleting the word “and” after sub-paragraph (a);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem NumberOverride="ii">
<Para>
<Text>by adding the word “and” after sub-paragraph (b); and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem NumberOverride="iii">
<Para>
<Text>by adding the following sub-paragraph—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>equipment and devices intended to prevent or reduce hazards</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by deleting regulation 6(3);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in regulation 7, by inserting the following paragraph—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Without prejudice to the generality of paragraph (1)—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a workplace shall be adequately thermally insulated where it is necessary, having regard to the type of work carried out and the physical activity of the persons carrying out the work; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>excessive effects of sunlight on temperature shall be avoided.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in paragraph (2) of regulation 24, by adding the words “and the facilities are easily accessible, of sufficient capacity and provided with seating”;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in regulation 25, by substituting for paragraph (3) the following paragraph—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Rest rooms and rest areas shall—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>include suitable arrangements to protect non-smokers from discomfort caused by tobacco smoke; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>be equipped with—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>an adequate number of tables and adequate seating with backs for the number of persons at work likely to use them at any one time; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>seating which is adequate for the number of disabled persons at work and suitable for them.</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>by inserting after regulation 25 the following regulation—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Disabled persons</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber>25A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Where necessary, those parts of the workplace (including in particular doors, passageways, stairs, showers, washbasins, lavatories and workstations) used or occupied directly by disabled persons at work shall be organised to take account of such persons.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043" NumberOfProvisions="3" xml:lang="en" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictStartDate="2002-12-11" RestrictExtent="E+W+S"><Secondary xmlns:leg="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation"><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/body" NumberOfProvisions="3" RestrictStartDate="2002-12-11" RestrictExtent="E+W+S" NumberFormat="default"><P1group RestrictStartDate="2002-12-11" RestrictExtent="E+W+S"><Title>Air quality objectives for benzene and carbon monoxide</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/1" id="regulation-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Schedule to the Air Quality (England) Regulations 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> (Air Quality Objectives) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the Table—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/2/a" id="regulation-2-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>there is created an additional row which relates to benzene and—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/2/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/2/a/i" id="regulation-2-2-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the column headed “Air quality objective levels” there are inserted the words “5 micrograms per cubic metre or less, when expressed as an annual mean”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/2/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/2/a/ii" id="regulation-2-2-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in the column headed “Air quality objective dates” there are inserted the words “31st December 2010”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/2/b" id="regulation-2-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the row which relates to carbon monoxide and the column headed “Air quality objective levels” the number “10” is substituted for “11.6” and the words “maximum daily” are inserted before “running”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/3" id="regulation-2-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the Interpretation note—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/3/a" id="regulation-2-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph 3 (calculation of a running 8 hour mean) there is substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1 RestrictStartDate="2002-12-11" RestrictExtent="E+W+S">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A maximum daily running 8 hour mean is calculated on a daily basis. The maximum daily running 8 hour mean for a particular substance at a particular location for a particular day is the maximum of the running 8 hour means ending during that day.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purpose of sub-paragraph (1) a “running 8 hour mean” is a mean which is calculated on an hourly basis, yielding one running 8 hour mean per hour. The running 8 hour mean for the relevant substance at the relevant location for a particular hour is the mean of the hourly means for the substance at the location for the hour and the preceding 7 hours.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/3/b" id="regulation-2-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 4 (calculation of an annual mean)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/3/b/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/3/b/i" id="regulation-2-3-b-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after the word “year” in sub-paragraph (1)(c) there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>;</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha" Start="4">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in the case of benzene, either the mean of the daily levels for that year or the mean of the hourly means for that year</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/3/b/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/3/b/ii" id="regulation-2-3-b-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (3) there is added—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purpose of any calculation of the annual mean for benzene on the basis of the mean of the daily levels, the daily level for benzene at a particular location for a particular day is the level at which benzene is recorded as being present in the air at that location during the fortnight in which the day occurs on the basis of a continuous sample of air taken throughout that fortnight (each day in the fortnight therefore being attributed with the same daily level).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For the purpose of sub-paragraph (4) “fortnight” means a complete fortnight, that is a period of two weeks beginning on a Monday (no particular week in a calendar year being included in more than one fortnight), except that it also includes—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in any calendar year beginning on a day other than a Monday, the period from the beginning of the year until the first Monday in that year; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in any year, the period from the end of the last complete fortnight in the year to the end of that year.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2002/3043/regulation/2/3/c" id="regulation-2-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph 5 (calculation of an hourly mean) for the second sentence there is substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>The hourly mean for a particular substance at a particular location for a particular hour is the mean of the levels recorded for that substance at that location:</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in the case of benzene, at a frequency of not less than once during the hour; and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>in the case of carbon monoxide, nitrogen dioxide and sulphur dioxide, at a frequency of not less than once every 10 seconds during the hour.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList></Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/604/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/604" NumberOfProvisions="48" xml:lang="en" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/604/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/604/body" NumberOfProvisions="48" NumberFormat="default"><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/604/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/604/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Climate Change Levy (General) Regulations 2001<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/> are amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2003/604/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2003/604/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1), substitute “the Schedules” for “the Schedule” and omit the expression ““Schedule” refers to the Schedule to these Regulations;”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (1)(c), delete “and”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/2/b" id="regulation-3-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (1)(d), insert “; and”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/2/c" id="regulation-3-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (1)(d) insert —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>describe what additional information concerning the improvement works is available, and where it can be obtained.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 6 (Notification of determination that improvement works are likely to have significant effects on the environment), amend paragraph (2) as follows –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3/a" id="regulation-3-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a), at the beginning insert “inform the public of the need for a determination of whether the improvement works should proceed, and”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3/b" id="regulation-3-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end of sub-paragraph (b), insert “; and”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/3/c" id="regulation-3-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (b) insert–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>give details of the drainage body responsible for taking the decision as to whether to carry out the improvement works, from whom relevant information can be obtained and to which comments or questions can be submitted, and details of the time by which comments or questions must be submitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>give an indication of the availability of the information gathered;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>give details of times and places where, and the means by which, the relevant information will be made available.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/4" id="regulation-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 12 (Determination of whether improvement works should proceed)–</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/4/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/4/a" id="regulation-3-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (7)(c)(ii) substitute–</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>the main reasons and considerations upon which this determination was based, including information about the public participation process; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/4/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/4/b" id="regulation-3-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (8) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In relation to any determination made by itself or by the appropriate Authority in accordance with this regulation, the drainage body shall maintain a record of, and make available to the public on request, the following information—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the content of the decision and any conditions attached thereto;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the main reasons and considerations on which the decision is based, including information about representations received in the course of the public participation process; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a description, where necessary, of the main measures to avoid and reduce the major adverse effects.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/5" id="regulation-3-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>in regulation 13 (charges), amend paragraph (1) as follows —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/5/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/5/a" id="regulation-3-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a)(ii), after “regulation 12(6)(b)”, insert “or regulation 13A”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/5/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/5/b" id="regulation-3-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (b)(ii), after “regulation 12(6)(c)”, insert “or regulation 13A”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/3/6" id="regulation-3-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 13 insert —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Public participation</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The drainage body shall make available to the public —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the time that the notice under regulation 5(1) is published, all relevant information that is relevant to the improvement works;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any further information which is relevant to the determination under regulation 12(7) above, and which only becomes available after the time that the public was given notice in accordance with regulation 5(1)(d), whether as a result of a request from the appropriate Authority under regulation 5(6) above or otherwise; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>any further information which is relevant to the assessment under regulation 12(1) above, and which becomes available after the time that the public notice was published in accordance with regulation 6(2) above.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2005-06-25" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Public notices</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The 1999 Regulations shall be further amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulations 5(1) and 6(2), for “by notice in at least two local newspapers”, substitute “, subject to regulation 13B below, by notice in at least two local newspapers and on any website maintained by the drainage body”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/3" id="regulation-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulations 5(3), (4) and (5), after “paragraph (1)(d) above” insert “(or the period of 28 days referred to in regulation 13B(3)(a) below, whichever is the greater)”</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/4" id="regulation-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulations 10(3) and 12(6)(a), at the beginning insert “Subject to regulation 13B(1) below,”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/5" id="regulation-4-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulations 12(3) and 12(8), after “shall” insert “, subject to regulation 13B below,”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/4/6" id="regulation-4-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 13A, insert —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Notices on the site of the proposed improvement works</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">13B</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the site of the proposed improvement works is easily visible from a public highway, a drainage body may, instead of placing a notice in a local paper in accordance with regulation 5(1), 6(2), 10(3), 12(3), 12(6)(a) or 12(8), post on the site a notice or notices containing, subject to paragraph (2), the information specified in the regulation in question.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In a notice posted under paragraph (1) in substitution to a notice published under regulation 5(1) or 12(6)(a), the period specified as the period within which representations may be made shall be not less than 28 days from the date on which the notice is first posted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The notice mentioned in paragraph (1) must –</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>be left in position for not less than seven consecutive days in the 28 days following the date on which the notice is first posted; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>be affixed firmly to some object on the site in such a way as to be easily visible to, and readable by, members of the public without going on to the land.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2005-06-25" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Other amendments of the 1999 Regulations</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/1" id="regulation-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The 1999 Regulations shall be further amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2" id="regulation-5-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2 (Interpretation) –</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/a" id="regulation-5-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “consultation bodies” —</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/a/i" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/a/i" id="regulation-5-2-a-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph (a), after “English Nature ”, insert “, English Heritage”; and</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/a/ii" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/a/ii" id="regulation-5-2-a-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in paragraph (b), after “Countryside Council for Wales”, insert “and Cadw, being the executive agency responsible for carrying out the functions vested in the National Assembly relating to the historic environment”;</Text>
</P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/b" id="regulation-5-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “the Directive”, at the end insert “and Council Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2003/0035" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2003" Number="35">2003/35/<Acronym Expansion="European Community">EC</Acronym></Citation> on providing for public participation in respect of the drawing up of certain plans and programmes relating to the environment and amending with regard to public participation and access to justice Council Directives <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1985/0337" id="c00002" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1985" Number="337">85/337/<Acronym Expansion="European Economic Community">EEC</Acronym></Citation> and <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1996/0061" id="c00003" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1996" Number="61">96/61/EC</Citation>”;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/c" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/2/c" id="regulation-5-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “improvement works”, after the words “or otherwise improve” (in each place where they occur) insert “or alter,”; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/3" id="regulation-5-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 3 (Restriction on improvement works), for paragraph (2) substitute —</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where the appropriate Authority considers, in relation to particular improvement works, that there are exceptional grounds for doing so, it may direct that the provisions of these Regulations shall not apply in relation to the works in question.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this event, the appropriate authority shall —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>consider whether another form of assessment would be appropriate;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>where it carries out any other form of assessment, make available to the public the information obtained under that assessment, the reasons for its decision to give a direction under paragraph (2) and any information relied on in making that decision;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/1399/regulation/5/4" id="regulation-5-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In Schedule 3 (Information for other <Acronym Expansion="European Economic Area">EEA</Acronym> states), in paragraph 4, for “the following information:–”, substitute “the information required to be given under regulation 6(2),”, and delete sub-paragraphs (a), (b) and (c).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

b the 60th day after any day in the subsequent calendar year on which the station’s exemption certificate is revoked pursuant to regulation 4(2) of those Regulations (station ceases to operate, current CHPQA certificate not sent to Secretary of State by 30th June, or relevant written request to Secretary of State). The “reconciliation span” relating to this reconciliation day is the completed calendar year. 3 A reconciliation day for an incompleted calendar year is the 60th day after any day in that incompleted calendar year on which the station’s exemption certificate is revoked pursuant to regulation 4(2) of those Regulations. The “reconciliation span” relating to any such reconciliation day spans 1st January in that calendar year to the day before that reconciliation day, inclusive. 9C 1 The recipient must review the correctness of the supplier certificate no later than a reconciliation day in paragraph 9B. This review is only in relation to that part of the recipient’s relief percentage that is determined on the basis mentioned in paragraph 9A (taxable commodities supplied to combined heat and power stations). 2 That correctness must be reviewed in relation to the efficiency percentage determined for the relevant reconciliation span (for determination of efficiency percentage, see regulations 3(2) and 6(2) of the Climate Change Levy (Combined Heat and Power Stations) Regulations 2005). In the case of a reconciliation span for an incompleted calendar year, treat the actual efficiency percentage as one determined for the 12 month period preceding the relevant reconciliation day and as if that period was an Annual Operation (for Annual Operation, see regulation 51B(6)), but as zero for any time the exemption certificate stands revoked. 3 The review must properly take into account— a each quantity of taxable commodity supplied on the basis of the supplier certificate or certificates in question and not previously the subject of a review under this paragraph, and b the actual efficiency percentage for the station in question at the time or times when that taxable commodity is supplied. 4 Sub-paragraph (5) or (6) applies if the review demonstrates that the supplier certificate was incorrect as respects the taxable commodity referable to paragraph 15 of the Act (supplies to combined heat and power stations). 5 If the CCL relief percentage applied was too low, the recipient may act in accordance with paragraphs 6 to 9 (recipient’s tax credit for supply incorrectly made on basis of its being a taxable supply) (but only in relation to the taxable commodity referable to paragraph 15 of the Act – supplies to combined heat and power stations). After 21st July 2005, and irrespective of when the supplies in question were made or other relevant events occurred, paragraph 5(5) does not apply where this paragraph applies. 6 If the CCL relief percentage applied was too high, paragraphs 5(7) to 5(9G) apply accordingly (deemed taxable self supplies, exemption from registration, payment of CCL due, etc). 7 This paragraph only applies to supplies made after 31st December 2004, but not to those supplies in relation to which corresponding arrangements have been initiated or made before 22nd July 2005. Corresponding arrangements are only— a claims by the recipient for tax credits or similar repayments, or b steps taken by the recipient to correct the position following a review demonstrating that a CCL relief percentage was too high (delivery of updated supplier certificate such that error corrected in one year, adjustment in CCL return, payment to Commissioners – see paragraph 5(6) as in force before 22nd July 2005). ; n in paragraph 12(1), for everything after “anticipated” substitute “events.”; o omit paragraph 12(2); p after paragraph 13(1), insert— 1A Where a supplier changes under paragraph (1) without the recipient’s active participation and the supplier certificate and supporting analysis document are transferred to the later supplier— a continuity is preserved for all CCL purposes in relation to the change, and b the certificate and document are deemed to have been originally given by the recipient to that later supplier. If there is no such transfer, the supplier certificate and supporting analysis document shall not have effect in relation to supplies from the later supplier. ; q in paragraph 13(2), for “In these circumstances,” substitute “In the case of sub-paragraph (1) or if continuity is not preserved in the case of sub-paragraph (1A),”; r after paragraph 15, insert— 16 A supplier certificate ceases to be valid for the purposes of regulation 34, 35 or 36 on the 5th anniversary of its implementation date (about which, see regulation 37(6)). . 6 Arrangements initiated or made before 22nd July 2005 on the basis of paragraph 5(5) or 5(6) of Schedule 1 to those Regulations as then in force remain subject to the provisions applicable when they were initiated or made (tax credit claims and corrections to over-estimated relief). Electricity from combined heat and power stations 7 1 Renumber regulation 51A of those Regulations as regulation 51A(1), for “Schedule 2” in its introductory words substitute “Schedules 1 and 2”, and insert after the meaning for “CHP declaration contract”— “CHPQA” refers to the Combined Heat and Power Quality Assurance Standard, Issue 1, November 2000 originally published by the Department for the Environment, Transport and the Regions (including the later of version Final 1.0 or 2.0 of CHPQA Guidance Notes 0 to 4 (including 2(S), 3(S) and 4(S)), 10 to 28 and 30); . 2 Insert as regulation 51A(2) of those Regulations— 2 In the case of electricity produced in a given station after 21st July 2005, this Part and Schedule 2 (and the related penalties provided for by regulation 60(1)(ha) and regulation 60(1)(hb)) only apply if at least some of that electricity is supplied otherwise than from that station (indirect supplies, see paragraph 20A(2) of the Act). . 3 For regulation 51B(1) of those Regulations, substitute— 1 The relevant Authority must certify QPO electricity in accordance with this Part and Schedule 2. . 4 In regulation 51B(5) of those Regulations, for the acronym and words after “metering requirements of” substitute “the CHPQA”. 5 For regulation 51B(6) of those Regulations, substitute— 6 The relevant Authority must only certify for the purposes of paragraphs (1) and (2) on the basis that— a each quantity of electricity produced by an individual station is referable to the Annual Operation in which it is produced, and b every such quantity in a given Annual Operation comprises the same relative proportions of QPO electricity and non-QPO electricity. This requirement is subject to the other provisions of this Part and Schedule 2 (non-certification, restricting validity to indirect supplies, reconciliation). “Annual Operation” has the same meaning as in regulations 2(3), 3(2), 4 and 6(1) of the Climate Change Levy (Combined Heat and Power Stations) Regulations 2005 (namely, 1st January to 31st December). . 6 To regulation 51B(8) of those Regulations, add— The relevant Authority must both certify QPO electricity in accordance with paragraphs (1), (2), (3), (6) and (7) and issue the relevant CHP LEC no later than the end of the third month following the end of the month in which the electricity is produced. Whilst the relative proportions mentioned in paragraph (6)(b) are unknown, the relevant Authority must use a reasonable estimate of what those relative proportions will be. If the relevant Authority must investigate further whether the electricity in question is “QPO electricity”, it must certify the QPO electricity and issue the relevant CHP LEC no later than the end of the month following the month in which that investigation ought reasonably to have been concluded. . 7 Omit regulation 51C(4)(h) of those Regulations (Authority not otherwise satisfied that electricity should be certified). 8 In Schedule 2 paragraph 3(4) to those Regulations, for “120th day following when the supply is treated as taking place” substitute “end of the second month following the one in which the CHP LEC is issued”. 9 For Schedule 2 paragraph 8(1) to those Regulations, substitute— 1 This paragraph only applies whilst the relevant Authority has information on the basis of which it reasonably believes that the person mentioned in paragraph 2 is not fully complying with the CHP outputs record requirements in paragraphs 2 to 7. . 10 In Schedule 2 paragraphs 8(2) and 8(3) to those Regulations, for “may” substitute “must”. 11 In Schedule 2 to those Regulations, after paragraph 11(7) insert— 8 In the case of electricity and a station to which this paragraph applied before 22nd July 2005 but not after 21st July 2005 (see regulation 51A(2)), the relevant Authority must treat 22nd July 2005 as a reconciliation day for an incompleted calendar year running from 1st January to 21st July 2005 inclusive (the “reconciliation span”). The determination in sub-paragraph (1) must be made on the basis that a partly exempt station’s annual limit for that incompleted calendar year is the former limit multiplied by the fraction with a numerator of 202 and a denominator of 365. For these purposes, the “former limit” is the one in force on 1st January 2005 under regulation 5(2) of the Climate Change Levy (Combined Heat and Power Stations) Prescribed Conditions and Efficiency Percentages Regulations 2001. .

<Text>The Offshore Chemicals Regulations 2002<FootnoteRef Ref="f00017"/> are amended as set out in Schedule 2 to these Regulations.</Text>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2055/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2055" NumberOfProvisions="36" xml:lang="en" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Schedules><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2" NumberOfProvisions="7" NumberFormat="default" id="schedule-2"><Number>SCHEDULE 2</Number><TitleBlock>
<Title>AMENDMENT OF THE OFFSHORE CHEMICALS REGULATIONS 2002</Title>
</TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/1" id="schedule-2-paragraph-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 2 omit the definitions of “address” and “electronic communication”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/2" id="schedule-2-paragraph-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 16 (appointment of inspectors)—</Text>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/2/1" id="schedule-2-paragraph-2-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>in paragraph (2), omit “their conclusions”; and</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/2/2" id="schedule-2-paragraph-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>omit paragraph (4).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/3" id="schedule-2-paragraph-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After regulation 16 insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Context="main" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Enforcement notices</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">16A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If the Secretary of State is of the opinion that any person has contravened or is contravening any condition of a permit or is likely to contravene any such condition, the Secretary of State or an inspector appointed by her under regulation 16 may serve on the operator a notice in writing (“an enforcement notice”) which—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>states that the Secretary of State is of the opinion mentioned in paragraph (1);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>specifies the matters which constitute, constituted or, as the case may be, are likely to constitute the contravention;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>specifies the steps that must be taken to remedy or, as the case maybe, prevent the contravention; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>specifies the period within which those steps must be taken.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The steps that may be specified under paragraph (1)(c) include steps that must be taken to remedy any pollution caused by a contravention.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a person to whom an enforcement notice is addressed has failed to take the action required by it within such time as may be specified by it and such a notice has not been revoked, the Secretary of State may undertake any action so required and the reasonable costs and expenses of the Secretary of State’s so doing shall be recoverable as a debt from that person.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A person to whom an enforcement notice is addressed shall afford such assistance as the Secretary of State may reasonably require for the purpose of facilitating the exercise of any powers conferred on the Secretary of State by paragraph (3).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Secretary of State or an inspector appointed by her under regulation 16 may revoke an enforcement notice served under paragraph (1).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The exercise by the Secretary of State of any power conferred by paragraph (1) or (3) shall be without prejudice to the exercise by her of any other power under any other provision of these Regulations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Prohibition notices</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">16B</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>If the Secretary of State is of the opinion that the operation of an offshore installation involves an imminent risk of serious pollution as a consequence of any use or discharge of offshore chemicals, the Secretary of State or an inspector appointed by her under regulation 16 may serve a notice in writing (“a prohibition notice”) on the operator of the installation.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A prohibition notice may be served whether or not the risk relates to the contravention of a permit and may relate to any aspects of the operation of the offshore installation, whether or not regulated by the conditions such a permit.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>A prohibition notice—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>shall state that the Secretary of State is of the opinion mentioned in paragraph (1) above;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>shall specify the risk involved in the operation of the offshore installation;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>shall specify the steps that must be taken to remove it and the period within which they must be taken; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>may direct that any permit shall, until the notice is withdrawn wholly or in part, cease to have effect and, where the direction applies to part only of the operation of the offshore installation, it may impose conditions to be observed in carrying on that part of the operation which is authorised under the relevant permit.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The Secretary of State or an inspector appointed by her under regulation 16 may by notice withdraw a prohibition notice wholly or in part at any time and shall withdraw a notice when the Secretary of State is satisfied that the steps required by the notice have been taken.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>It shall be the duty of the person to whom the prohibition notice is addressed to comply with its terms save to the extent that it is withdrawn wholly or in part.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>The service of a prohibition notice shall be without prejudice to the exercise by any person of any power under any other provision of these Regulations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/4" id="schedule-2-paragraph-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 18 (offences)(1) in paragraph (1) (which deals with specifying offences)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/4/a" id="schedule-2-paragraph-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit “or” where it occurs in sub-paragraph (f);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/4/b" id="schedule-2-paragraph-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>insert “; or” at the end of sub-paragraph (g); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/4/c" id="schedule-2-paragraph-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after sub-paragraph (g) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P3>
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>fails to comply with the terms of an enforcement notice or a prohibition notice.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2005/2055/schedule/2/paragraph/5" id="schedule-2-paragraph-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 19 there is substituted a provision identical to that set out in paragraph 6 of Schedule 1 to these Regulations.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Secondary></Legislation>

PART 7 <SmallCaps>Records and Returns</SmallCaps><Emphasis>Producer and transport records</Emphasis>Consignee and self-disposal quarterly returns531Every consignee shall make a return, in these Regulations referred to as a consignee quarterly return, to the Agency of information relating to all consignments of hazardous waste received by him in any quarter in accordance with paragraph (4).2The return shall include—arejected consignments;bhazardous waste delivered by pipeline where regulation 41 applies; andcin the case of multiple collections, each individual consignment collected.3Where in any quarter hazardous waste is disposed of by depositing it within the curtilage of the premises at which it is produced, the producer shall make a return in respect of that quarter of information relating to the deposit to the Agency (including the consignment code), in accordance with paragraph (4).4A return to be made pursuant to this regulation in respect of a quarter shall be made no later than the time specified in the right hand column of the table below in relation to the quarter specified in the left hand column:
Quarter in which the hazardous waste was received, or deposited, as the case may beReturn to be received by the Agency not later than
Ending on 31st March30st April in the same year as the quarter falls
Ending on 30th June31st July in the same year as the quarter falls
Ending on 30th September31st October in the same year as the quarter falls
Ending on 31st December31st January in the year next following the year in which the quarter falls
5The Agency may prescribe a format for returns to be made under this regulation and, where for the time being a format is prescribed pursuant to this paragraph—athe Agency shall publish the format on its website and in such other manner as it may consider appropriate for informing persons required to submit such returns of its content; andbthe Agency shall not be obliged to consider a return as properly made for the purposes of these Regulations unless it is made in that format, or in a format substantially to like effect.6If the Agency prescribe a fee payable by a consignee by charging scheme made under section 41 of the Environment Act 1995 as a means of recovering its costs incurred in performing functions in relation to the consignments included on the consignee quarterly returns, a consignee may recover from a consignor any fees paid under these Regulations in relation to consignments sent by that consignor.Consignee's return to the producer, holder or consignor541Without prejudice to any duty under these Regulations on the part of the consignee to send any document or copy thereof to the producer, holder or consignor, a consignee shall send to a producer or holder identified in the relevant part of a consignment note—aa return in a form corresponding to that set out in Schedule 8 or a form substantially to like effect within one month of the end of the quarter in which the waste concerned was accepted; orba copy of the consignment note together with a description of the method of disposal or recovery undertaken in relation to the waste, within one month of the end of the quarter in which the waste concerned was accepted.2Where hazardous waste was delivered by pipeline in a case to which regulation 41 applies, paragraph (1) shall apply so that the return required under sub-paragraph (a) or the information required under sub-paragraph (b) shall be supplied within one month of the end of the quarter in which the waste concerned was piped.3Where regulation 42 applies, this regulation does not apply to the consignment or part concerned.Duties to supply information551A person who is required to retain any record pursuant to any of the foregoing provisions of this Part shall, at any time during the period in which the record is required to be retained produce that record to the Agency or emergency services on request.2A producer holder, previous holder, consignor, carrier or consignee of hazardous waste shall supply to the Agency on request such information as it may reasonably require for the purposes of performing its functions in connection with these Regulations and for the purposes of monitoring the production, movement, storage, treatment, recovery and disposal of hazardous waste.3An establishment or undertaking to which hazardous waste is delivered for recovery or disposal, as the case may be, has the duty to supply to the Agency on request documentary evidence that the disposal or recovery operation concerned has been carried out, indicating where applicable, the relevant entry listed in Annex I or Annex II, as the case may be, of the Waste Directive.4A person who is required to supply the production in a visible and legible documentary form of any information is held in electronic form.6Any request for information under this regulation shall be in writing and shall specify the
