PART 8 <SmallCaps>THE AGENCY'S FUNCTIONS</SmallCaps>Inspections of hazardous waste producers56It is the duty of the Agency to carry out appropriate periodic inspections of hazardous waste producers.Inspections of collection and transport operations57. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .Agency to retain registers etc58The Agency shall retain registers and any accompanying records sent to it pursuant to regulation 51(3) for a period of not less than three years commencing with the receipt thereof by the Agency.Fees591Section 41 of the 1995 Act (power to make schemes imposing charges) is amended as follows.2For subsection (1)(c) substitute—cas a means of recovering costs incurred by it in performing functions conferred by regulations made for the purpose of implementing Council Directive 91/689/EEC the Agency may require the payment to it of such charges as may from time to time be prescribed;.3Schedule 9 has effect to make provision in relation to fees to be charged by the Agency in connection with these Regulations until a charging scheme made under section 41 of the 1995 Act to recover the costs incurred by the Agency in performing functions under these Regulations takes effect.

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244" NumberOfProvisions="26" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/body" NumberOfProvisions="26" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Merchant Shipping Act 1995</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Chapter 3 of Part 6 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (liability for oil pollution) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Meaning of “the Liability Convention”, “the Bunkers Convention” and other expressions</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 152 (meaning of “the Liability Convention” and related expressions) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, before ““the Liability Convention”“ there is inserted ““the Bunkers Convention”,“.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (1) —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a" id="regulation-3-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of “the Liability Convention”, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the Bunkers Convention” means the International Convention on Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage 2001;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention country” means a country in respect of which the Bunkers Convention is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention State” means a State which is a party to the Bunkers Convention;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b" id="regulation-3-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Liability Convention State”, after “the” there is inserted “Liability”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4" id="regulation-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), after “Convention” (in the first place it appears), there is inserted “or the Bunkers Convention” and for “the Liability Convention” (in the second place it appears), there is substituted “that Convention”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244" NumberOfProvisions="26" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/body" NumberOfProvisions="26" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Merchant Shipping Act 1995</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Chapter 3 of Part 6 of the Merchant Shipping Act 1995 (liability for oil pollution) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Meaning of “the Liability Convention”, “the Bunkers Convention” and other expressions</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 152 (meaning of “the Liability Convention” and related expressions) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, before ““the Liability Convention”“ there is inserted ““the Bunkers Convention”,“.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (1) —</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/a" id="regulation-3-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>before the definition of “the Liability Convention”, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“the Bunkers Convention” means the International Convention on Civil Liability for Bunker Oil Pollution Damage 2001;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention country” means a country in respect of which the Bunkers Convention is in force;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Bunkers Convention State” means a State which is a party to the Bunkers Convention;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText></P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/3/b" id="regulation-3-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “Liability Convention State”, after “the” there is inserted “Liability”.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/3/4" id="regulation-3-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), after “Convention” (in the first place it appears), there is inserted “or the Bunkers Convention” and for “the Liability Convention” (in the second place it appears), there is substituted “that Convention”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Liability for oil pollution in case of tankers</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/1" id="regulation-4-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 153 (liability for oil pollution in case of tankers) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/2" id="regulation-4-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For “owner” and “owners” (in each place), there is substituted respectively “registered owner” and “registered owners”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/3" id="regulation-4-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), the words after paragraph (b) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/4" id="regulation-4-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (2), there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Chapter, such a threat is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/4/5" id="regulation-4-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subsections (7) and (8) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Liability for pollution by bunker oil</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After section 153, there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P1group>
<Title>Liability for pollution by bunker oil</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter="">153A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to subsection (3), where, as a result of any occurrence, any bunker oil is discharged or escapes from a ship then (except as otherwise provided by this Chapter) the owner of the ship shall be liable—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused outside the ship in the territory of the United Kingdom by contamination resulting from the discharge or escape; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the cost of any measures reasonably taken after the discharge or escape for the purpose of preventing or minimising any damage so caused in the territory of the United Kingdom by contamination resulting from the discharge or escape; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused in the territory of the United Kingdom by any measures so taken.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Subject to subsection (3), where, as a result of any occurrence, there arises a grave and imminent threat of damage being caused outside a ship by the contamination that might result if there were a discharge or escape of bunker oil from the ship then (except as otherwise provided by this Chapter) the owner of the ship shall be liable—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the cost of any measures reasonably taken for the purpose of preventing or minimising any such damage in the territory of the United Kingdom; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for any damage caused outside the ship in the territory of the United Kingdom by any measures so taken.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>There shall be no liability under this section in relation to —</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil from a ship to which section 153 applies, or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2) arising in relation to a potential discharge or escape of bunker oil from such a ship,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>where that bunker oil is also persistent hydrocarbon mineral oil.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the subsequent provisions of this Chapter—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil from a ship, other than a discharge or escape of oil excluded by subsection (3), is referred to as a discharge or escape of bunker oil falling within subsection (1) of this section; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2), other than one excluded by subsection (3), is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where a person incurs a liability under subsection (1) or (2) he shall also be liable for any damage or cost for which he would be liable under that subsection if the references in it to the territory of the United Kingdom included the territory of any other Bunkers Convention country.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Where—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>as a result of any occurrence, a liability is incurred under this section by the owner of each of two or more ships, but</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>the damage or cost for which each of the owners would be liable cannot reasonably be separated from that for which the other or others would be liable,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>each of the owners shall be liable, jointly with the other or others, for the whole of the damage or cost for which the owners together would be liable under this section.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In this Chapter (except in section 170(1)) “owner”, except when used in the term “registered owner”, means the registered owner, bareboat charterer, manager and operator of the ship.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Further liability for oil pollution</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/1" id="regulation-6-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>Section 154 (liability for pollution in case of other ships) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/2" id="regulation-6-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading, for “in case of other ships” there is substituted “in other cases”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/3" id="regulation-6-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>For “owner” and “owners” (in each place), there is substituted respectively “registered owner” and “registered owners”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/4" id="regulation-6-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsections (1) and (2), at the beginning there is inserted “Subject to subsection (2A),” and the words “other than a ship to which section 153 applies” are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/5" id="regulation-6-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (2), the words after paragraph (b) are omitted.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/6" id="regulation-6-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After subsection (2), there is inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2A</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>No liability shall be incurred under this section by reason of—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of oil from a ship to which section 153 applies or a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of that section;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of bunker oil falling within section 153A(1) or a relevant threat of contamination falling within section 153A(2).</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2B</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the subsequent provisions of this Chapter—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a discharge or escape of oil from a ship, other than one excluded by subsection (2A), is referred to as a discharge or escape of oil falling within subsection (1) of this section; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>a threat mentioned in subsection (2), other than one excluded by subsection (2A), is referred to as a relevant threat of contamination falling within subsection (2) of this section.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText></P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1244/regulation/6/7" id="regulation-6-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In subsection (5), after “section”, there is inserted “(apart from subsection (2A))”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Electricity Safety, Quality and Continuity Regulations

the esqcr.title: Electricity Safety, Quality and Continuity Regulations 2002

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1521/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1521" NumberOfProvisions="6" xml:lang="en" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1521/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1521/body" NumberOfProvisions="6" NumberFormat="default"><P1group><Title>Citation, commencement and interpretation</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/1" id="regulation-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/1/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/1/1" id="regulation-1-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>These Regulations may be cited as the Electricity Safety, Quality and Continuity (Amendment) Regulations 2006 and shall come into force on 1st October 2006.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/1/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/1/2" id="regulation-1-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In these Regulations—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/1/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/1/2/a" id="regulation-1-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>“the <Abbreviation Expansion="Electricity Safety, Quality and Continuity Regulations 2002 (S.I. 2002/2665)">ESQCR</Abbreviation>” means the Electricity Safety, Quality and Continuity Regulations 2002<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/1/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/1/2/b" id="regulation-1-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>unless the context otherwise requires, any reference to a numbered regulation or paragraph is a reference to a regulation or paragraph bearing that number in the ESQCR.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment to British Standard Requirements</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 1(5), in the definition of “British Standard Requirements”, after “February 2002” insert “and as further amended by Amendment <Abbreviation Expansion="Number">No.</Abbreviation> 2 (AMD 14905) March 2004”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Application of ESQCR to tramways <Abbreviation Expansion="et cetera" xml:lang="la">etc.</Abbreviation></Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2006/1521/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 1(5)—</Text>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2157/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2157" NumberOfProvisions="14" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Schedules><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2157/schedule/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2157/schedule" NumberOfProvisions="4" id="schedule"><Number>THE SCHEDULE</Number><TitleBlock>
<Title>AMENDMENTS TO PART 1 OF SCHEDULE 2 TO THE SUPPLY OF MACHINERY (SAFETY) REGULATIONS 2008</Title>
</TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/2157/schedule/paragraph/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/2157/schedule/paragraph/1" id="schedule-paragraph-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For point 4 of the General Principles at the start of Annex I (Essential health and safety requirements relating to the design and construction of machinery) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" Format="double"><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>This Annex is organised in several parts. The first one is of general scope and applicable to all kinds of machinery. The other parts refer to certain kinds of more specific hazards. Nevertheless, it is essential to examine the whole of this Annex in order to be sure of meeting all the relevant essential requirements. When machinery is being designed, the requirements of the general part and the requirements of one or more of the other parts shall be taken into account, depending on the results of the risk assessment carried out in accordance with point 1 of these General Principles. Essential health and safety requirements for the protection of the environment are applicable only to the machinery referred to in section 2.4.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982" NumberOfProvisions="23" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/body" NumberOfProvisions="23"><P1group><Title>Interpretation</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In these Regulations, “the <Abbreviation Expansion="Offshore Chemicals Regulations 2002 (S.I. 2002/1355)">2002 Regulations</Abbreviation>” means the Offshore Chemicals Regulations 2002<FootnoteRef Ref="f00002"/>.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of the 2002 Regulations</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The 2002 Regulations are amended as follows.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 2 (interpretation)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/a" id="regulation-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “discharge” substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“discharge”, in relation to an offshore chemical, means any intentional emission of the chemical, or any of its degradation or transformation products, from an offshore installation into the relevant area;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/b" id="regulation-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “discharge” insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“enforcement notice” means a notice served under regulation 16A(1) or (1A);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/c" id="regulation-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “the Gazettes” insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“installation” includes any floating structure or device maintained on a station by whatever means;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/d" id="regulation-4-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “offshore chemical”, omit “intentionally” and after “used” insert “, or intended to be used,”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/e" id="regulation-4-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “offshore installation” substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“offshore installation” means an installation or pipeline which is used for the purposes of, or in connection with, offshore petroleum activities or offshore storage and unloading activities;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/f/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/f" id="regulation-4-f">
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “permit application”, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“permit holder” means the holder from time to time of a permit;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/g/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/g" id="regulation-4-g">
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit the definition of “pipeline”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/h/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/h" id="regulation-4-h">
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “prescribed date”, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“prohibition notice” means a notice served under regulation 16B(1);</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“release”, in relation to an offshore chemical, means the emission (other than by way of discharge) of the chemical, or any of its degradation or transformation products, from an offshore installation into the relevant area;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/i" id="regulation-4-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “relevant area”—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/i/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/i/i" id="regulation-4-i-i">
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (a) omit “and Wales”;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/i/ii/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/i/ii" id="regulation-4-i-ii">
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para>
<Text>in sub-paragraph (b) after “Scottish controlled waters” insert “and Welsh controlled waters”;</Text>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/j/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/j" id="regulation-4-j">
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “use” substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“use”, in relation to an offshore chemical, means any intentional application of the chemical in the carrying out of offshore activities under normal operating conditions;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“Welsh controlled waters” means those parts of the territorial sea adjacent to Wales which are controlled waters within the meaning of section 104 of the Water Resources Act 1991<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/>.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/k/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2011/982/regulation/4/k" id="regulation-4-k">
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (2) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In these Regulations, in relation to an offshore storage or unloading activity—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>any reference to the use, discharge or release of an offshore chemical is to be read as a reference to its use in, or discharge or release into, the reserved area;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>any reference to pollution is to be read as a reference to pollution introduced into the reserved area.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/3135/regulation/5/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/3135/regulation/5/1" id="regulation-5-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In regulation 3 (interpretation)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/3135/regulation/5/1/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/3135/regulation/5/1/a" id="regulation-5-1-a">

<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">

</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/3135/regulation/5/1/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/3135/regulation/5/1/b" id="regulation-5-1-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>

<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2013/3135/regulation/5/1/b/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2013/3135/regulation/5/1/b/i" id="regulation-5-1-b-i">

<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1771" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1771" NumberOfProvisions="37" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" xml:lang="en" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictStartDate="2014-07-25" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Secondary xmlns:leg="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation"><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1771/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1771/body" NumberOfProvisions="5" RestrictStartDate="2014-07-25" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><P1group RestrictStartDate="2014-07-25" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Substitution of the word ‘will’ for the word ‘must’</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1771/regulation/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1771/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1771/regulation/3/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1771/regulation/3/1" id="regulation-3-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 are amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1771/regulation/3/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1771/regulation/3/2" id="regulation-3-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the regulations, schedule and part of a schedule set out in Schedule 1 to these Regulations for every use of the word ‘will’ substitute the word ‘must’.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1771/regulation/3/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1771/regulation/3/3" id="regulation-3-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the regulations set out in schedule 2 to these Regulations, substitute the word ‘will’ for ‘must;’ as set out in column 3 of that schedule.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Sulphur Content of Liquid Fuels (England and Wales) Regulations

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975" NumberOfProvisions="14" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" xml:lang="en" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Secondary xmlns:leg="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation"><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/body" NumberOfProvisions="14" RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><P1group RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Amendment of the Sulphur Content of Liquid Fuels (England and Wales) Regulations 2007</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/2" id="regulation-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Sulphur Content of Liquid Fuels (England and Wales) Regulations 2007<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> are amended in accordance with regulations 3 to 9.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Regulation 2</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/3" id="regulation-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 2 (interpretation) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" Format="double"><P1 RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI">
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In these Regulations—</Text><UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“combustion plant” means any technical apparatus in which fuels are oxidised in order to use the heat generated;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“Council <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1999/0032" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1999" Number="0032">Directive 1999/32/EC</Citation>” means Council <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1999/0032" id="c00002" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1999" Number="0032">Directive 1999/32/EC</Citation> relating to a reduction in the sulphur content of certain liquid fuels and amending <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1993/0012" id="c00003" Class="EuropeanEconomicCommunityDirective" Year="1993" Number="0012">Directive 93/12/EEC</Citation><FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“gas oil” means any petroleum-derived liquid fuel—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>that falls within CN code 2710 19 25, 2710 19 29, 2710 19 47, 2710 19 48, 2710 20 17 or 2710 20 19; or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>where less than 65 per cent by volume (including losses) distils at 250°C and at least 85 per cent by volume (including losses) distils at 350°C by the <Acronym Expansion="American Society for Testing and Materials">ASTM</Acronym> D86 method,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
<Text>but excluding marine fuels, diesel fuels (as defined by Article 2(2) of <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1998/0070" id="c00004" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1998" Number="0070">Directive 98/70/EC</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council relating to the quality of petrol and diesel fuels<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>) and fuels used in non-road mobile machinery or agricultural tractors;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“heavy fuel oil” means any petroleum-derived liquid fuel—</Text>
<OrderedList Type="alpha" Decoration="parens">
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>that falls within CN code 2710 19 51 to 2710 19 68, 2710 20 31, 2710 20 35 or 2710 20 39;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>which, by reason of its distillation limits, falls within the category of heavy oils intended for use as fuel and of which less than 65 per cent by volume (including losses) distils at 250°C by the ASTM D86 method; or</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>where the distillation cannot be determined by the ASTM D86 method, that is categorised as heavy fuel oil,</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
<Text>but excluding marine fuel and gas oil;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“marine fuel” means any petroleum-derived liquid fuel intended for use or in use on board a vessel, including those fuels defined in <Acronym Expansion="International Standards Organisation">ISO</Acronym> 8217<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>“sulphur content of liquid fuels permit” has the meaning given in regulation 4(5)(b).</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In paragraph (1)—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>an ASTM method means a method laid down by the American Society for Testing and Materials in the 1976 edition of standard definitions and specifications for petroleum and lubricating products<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the reference to a numbered CN code is a reference to the code set out in Annex I to Council Regulation 2658/87 on the tariff and statistical nomenclature and on the Common Customs Tariff<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Expressions used in these Regulations that also appear in Council <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1999/0032" id="c00005" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1999" Number="0032">Directive 1999/32/EC</Citation> have the same meaning as they do in that Directive.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Regulation 4</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/4" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 4 (maximum sulphur content of heavy fuel oil) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" Format="double"><P1 RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI">
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>No person shall use any heavy fuel oil that has a sulphur content exceeding 1 per cent by mass.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Until 1st January 2016, paragraph (1) shall not apply to the use of heavy fuel oil—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in a new plant that—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>is subject to Article 4(1) of <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2001/0080" id="c00006" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2001" Number="0080">Directive 2001/80/EC</Citation> and is operated in accordance with a permit containing a condition that emission limit values for sulphur dioxide are at least as stringent as those set out for new plants in Part A of Annex <Acronym Expansion="4">IV</Acronym> of that Directive; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>is subject to Article 4(2) of <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2001/0080" id="c00007" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2001" Number="0080">Directive 2001/80/EC</Citation> and is operated in accordance with a permit containing a condition that emission limit values for sulphur dioxide are at least as stringent as those set out for new plants in Part B of Annex IV of that Directive;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in an existing plant—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>operated in accordance with a permit containing a condition that emission limit values for sulphur dioxide are at least as stringent as those set out for new plants in Part A of Annex IV of <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2001/0080" id="c00008" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2001" Number="0080">Directive 2001/80/EC</Citation>; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>that is a participating plant operated in accordance with a permit containing a condition prohibiting the monthly average emissions of sulphur dioxide from the plant from exceeding 1,700 mg/Nm<Superior>3</Superior> at an oxygen content in the flue gas of 3 per cent by volume on a dry basis;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in a combustion plant, other than a plant to which sub-paragraph (a) or (b) applies, that is operated in accordance with a permit containing a condition prohibiting the monthly average of emissions of sulphur dioxide from the plant from exceeding 1,700 mg/Nm<Superior>3</Superior> at an oxygen content in the flue gas of 3 per cent by volume on a dry basis; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in a combustion plant, other than a gas engine, a gas turbine or a plant to which sub-paragraph (a) or (b) applies, that—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>forms part of a refinery; and</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>is operated in accordance with a permit containing a condition that the monthly average of emissions of sulphur dioxide averaged over all combustion plants in the refinery, irrespective of the type of fuel or fuel combination used, does not exceed 1,700 mg/Nm<Superior>3 </Superior>at an oxygen content in the flue gas of 3 per cent by volume on a dry basis.</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>As from 1st January 2016, paragraph (1) shall not apply to the use of heavy fuel oil—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in a combustion plant that—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>falls within the scope of Chapter <Acronym Expansion="3">III</Acronym> of Directive 2010/75/<Acronym Expansion="European Union">EU</Acronym>; and</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>is operated in accordance with a permit containing a condition that emission limit values for sulphur dioxide are at least as stringent as those set out in Annex V to that Directive;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in a combustion plant that—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>falls within the scope of Chapter III of Directive 2010/75/EU;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>is not subject to the emission limit values for sulphur dioxide set out in Annex V to that Directive; and</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>is operated in accordance with a permit containing a condition prohibiting the monthly average emissions of sulphur dioxide from the plant from exceeding 1,700 mg/Nm<Superior>3</Superior> at an oxygen content in the flue gas of 3 per cent by volume on a dry basis;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in a combustion plant, other than a plant to which sub-paragraph (a) or (b) applies, that is operated in accordance with a permit containing a condition prohibiting the monthly average emissions of sulphur dioxide from exceeding 1,700 mg/Nm<Superior>3</Superior> at an oxygen content in the flue gas of 3 per cent by volume on a dry basis; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in a combustion plant, other than a gas engine, a gas turbine or a plant to which sub-paragraph (a) or (b) applies, that—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>forms part of a refinery; and</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>is operated in accordance with a permit containing a condition that the monthly average of emissions of sulphur dioxide averaged over all combustion plants in the refinery, irrespective of the type or fuel or fuel combination used, does not exceed 1,700 mg/Nm<Superior>3</Superior> at an oxygen content in the flue gas of 3 per cent by volume on a dry basis.</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>An authority that grants a permit referred to in paragraph (2) or (3) shall carry out appropriate monitoring of emissions of sulphur dioxide to ensure that the limitations on emissions contained in that permit are not exceeded.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this regulation—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“<Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2001/0080" id="c00009" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2001" Number="0080">Directive 2001/80/EC</Citation>” means <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2001/0080" id="c00010" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2001" Number="0080">Directive 2001/80/EC</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council on the limitation of emissions of certain pollutants into the air from large combustion plants<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“Directive 2010/75/EU” means Directive 2010/75/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council on industrial emissions (integrated pollution prevention and control) (Recast)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“existing plant” and “new plant” have the meaning given in Article 2(10) and 2(9) respectively of <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2001/0080" id="c00011" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2001" Number="0080">Directive 2001/80/EC</Citation>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“gas engine” and “gas turbine” have the meaning given in Article 3(34) and (33) respectively of Directive 2010/75/EU;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“participating plant” has the meaning given in regulation 3(1)(a) of the Large Combustion Plants (National Emission Reduction Plan) Regulations 2007<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“permit” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>if the operation of the combustion plant requires an authorisation or permit—</Text><OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="roman">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>an authorisation under Part I of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 (integrated pollution control and air pollution control by local authorities)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/>; or</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>a permit under regulations made under section 2 of the Pollution Prevention and Control Act 1999 (regulation of polluting activities)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/>; or</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>a sulphur content of liquid fuels permit which—</Text><OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="roman">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>was granted for the purposes of the Sulphur Content of Liquid Fuels (England and Wales) Regulations 2000<FootnoteRef Ref="f00015"/> and which is still subsisting; or</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>is granted under these Regulations.</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Schedule (sulphur content of liquid fuels permits) has effect.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Regulation 5</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/5" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 5 (maximum sulphur content in gas oil) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" Format="double"><P1 RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI">
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>No person shall use any gas oil that has a sulphur content exceeding 0.1 per cent by mass.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Regulation 6</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/6" id="regulation-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For regulation 6 (sampling and analysis) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" Format="double"><P1 RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI">
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Secretary of State shall take all necessary measures to ensure that periodic sampling is carried out of heavy fuel oil and gas oil and that the samples are analysed to check that the use of those fuels complies with regulations 4(1) and 5.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Sampling shall be carried out with sufficient frequency and in such a way that the Secretary of State is satisfied that the samples are representative of the fuels examined.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The samples shall be analysed without undue delay.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The reference method adopted for determining the sulphur content of fuels sampled pursuant to paragraph (1) shall be defined by EN ISO 8754:2003 or EN ISO 14596:2007<FootnoteRef Ref="f00016"/>.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>New regulation 9</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/7" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/7" id="regulation-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After regulation 8 (revocation and saving) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P1group>
<Title>Review</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Secretary of State must from time to time—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>carry out, in relation to England, a review of these Regulations;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>set out the conclusions of the review in a report; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>publish the report.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In carrying out the review the Secretary of State must, so far as reasonable, have regard to how Council <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1999/0032" id="c00012" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1999" Number="0032">Directive 1999/32/EC</Citation>, which is being implemented by means of these Regulations, is implemented in other member States.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The report must in particular—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>set out the objectives intended to be achieved by the regulatory system established by these Regulations;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>assess the extent to which those objectives are achieved, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>assess whether those objectives remain appropriate and, if so, the extent to which they could be achieved with a system that imposes less regulation.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The first report under this regulation must be published before 29th August 2019.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Reports under this regulation are afterwards to be published at intervals not exceeding five years.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group RestrictStartDate="2014-08-29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+NI"><Title>Schedule 1</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/8" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/8" id="regulation-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/8/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/8/1" id="regulation-8-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Schedule 1 (sulphur content of liquid fuel permits) is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/8/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/8/2" id="regulation-8-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the heading to that Schedule—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/8/2/a" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/8/2/a" id="regulation-8-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit “1”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/8/2/b" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/8/2/b" id="regulation-8-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for “Regulation 4(5)” substitute “Regulation 4(6)”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/8/3" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2014/1975/regulation/8/3" id="regulation-8-3">

<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 4 (sections 22 to 24: references in relation to completed mergers), in the text of section 22 of the 2002 Act as it has effect as substituted by that regulation, after subsection (2) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>No reference shall be made under section 32(b) of the <Abbreviation Expansion="Water Industry Act 1991 c. 56">1991 Act</Abbreviation> if the period within which the CMA is required by section 34ZA of the 2002 Act to decide whether the duty to make a reference applies has expired without such a decision having been made.</Text>

</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>

<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>

<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>

</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2015/1936/regulation/6/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2015/1936/regulation/6/b" id="regulation-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after that subsection insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>No reference shall be made under section 32(a) of the 1991 Act if the period within which the CMA is required by section 34ZA of the 2002 Act to decide whether the duty to make a reference applies has expired without such a decision having been made.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>

<AppendText>.</AppendText>

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562" NumberOfProvisions="77" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Schedules><Schedule DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2" NumberOfProvisions="12" id="schedule-2"><Number>SCHEDULE 2</Number><TitleBlock>
<Title>Further amendments</Title>
</TitleBlock><ScheduleBody><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/part/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/part/2" NumberOfProvisions="8" id="schedule-2-part-2"><Number>PART 2</Number><Title>Secondary legislation</Title><P1group><Title>The Radioactive Contaminated Land (Modification of Enactments) (Wales) Regulations 2006</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10" id="schedule-2-paragraph-10">
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/1" id="schedule-2-paragraph-10-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Radioactive Contaminated Land (Modification of Enactments) (Wales) Regulations 2006<FootnoteRef Ref="f00055"/> are amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/2" id="schedule-2-paragraph-10-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 5(2) (modification of section 78A of the Environmental Protection Act 1990), in the inserted section 78A(2A) (definition of “land contaminated by a nuclear occurrence”)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/2/a" id="schedule-2-paragraph-10-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (a), after “7,” insert “7B,”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/2/b" id="schedule-2-paragraph-10-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (b), for “7(1)(a) or (b)” substitute “7(1A)(b) or (1C)(b)”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/2/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/2/c" id="schedule-2-paragraph-10-2-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (b), for “10(1)” substitute “10(1)(b)”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/2/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/2/d" id="schedule-2-paragraph-10-2-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (b) (and before the “or”) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P3>
<Pnumber>ba</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>damage caused by preventive measures taken after a breach of a duty imposed by section 7, 7B, 8, 9 or 10 of the 1965 Act in respect of which a claim for compensation may be made under section 11H(2) of the 1965 Act or could have been made if section 11H(4) of the 1965 Act had not been enacted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/2/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/2/e" id="schedule-2-paragraph-10-2-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (c)(i), for “16(1) and (2)” substitute “16(1), (1ZA), (1ZB), (2), (3B) or (3C)”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/3" id="schedule-2-paragraph-10-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 17 (modification of section 78YB of the Environmental Protection Act 1990), in paragraph (3) (insertion of section 78YB(4A) to (4C))—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/3/a" id="schedule-2-paragraph-10-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after inserted subsection (4A) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4AA</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Nothing in this Part applies in respect of land which, except for this subsection, would otherwise fall to be regarded as contaminated land within a relevant disposal site.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/3/b" id="schedule-2-paragraph-10-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after inserted subsection (4B) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4BA</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Nothing in this Part applies in respect of land which, except for this subsection, would otherwise fall to be regarded as contaminated land within a site used by the Secretary of State for Defence for a purpose which, if section 7B of the 1965 Act applied to the Crown, would cause the site to be a relevant disposal site.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2016/562/schedule/2/paragraph/10/4" id="schedule-2-paragraph-10-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 17(4), in the substituted section 78YB(5) (definitions), at the appropriate place insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“relevant disposal site” has the meaning given by section 7B of the 1965 Act.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></ScheduleBody></Schedule></Schedules></Secondary></Legislation>

<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>No provision of these regulations shall prevent the master from requiring a worker to perform any hours of work necessary—</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>for the immediate safety of—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the ship;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>persons on board; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>cargo; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>for the purpose of giving assistance to—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>other ships; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>persons in distress.</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In the circumstances described in paragraph (1), the master may require a worker to perform any hours of work necessary until the normal situation has been restored.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>As soon as practicable after the normal situation has been restored, the master shall ensure that any worker who has performed work in a scheduled rest period is provided with an adequate period of rest.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110" NumberOfProvisions="36" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/body" NumberOfProvisions="36"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/part/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/part/3" NumberOfProvisions="2" id="part-3"><Number>PART 3</Number><Title>Amendment of other Regulations</Title><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Air Quality Standards (Wales) Regulations 2010</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19" id="regulation-19">
<Pnumber>19</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/1" id="regulation-19-1">
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Air Quality Standards (Wales) Regulations 2010 are amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/2" id="regulation-19-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 20(8) insert—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/2/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/2/a" id="regulation-19-2-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the English language text—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The air quality plan must include an assessment of the need to apply lower emission limit values for individual medium combustion plants than those set out in <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2015/2193" id="c00004" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2015" Number="2193">Directive 2015/2193/EU</Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council of 25 November 2015 on the limitation of emissions of certain pollutants into the air from medium combustion plants (“the Medium Combustion Plant Directive”) provided that, in the opinion of the Welsh Ministers, applying such emission limit values would effectively contribute to a noticeable improvement of air quality.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In considering whether to impose lower emission limit values, the Welsh Ministers must take into account the results of the information exchange referred to in Article 6(10) of the Medium Combustion Plant Directive.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this regulation—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“emission limit values” has the meaning given in paragraph 5 of Schedule 25A to the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016, and</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“medium combustion plants” has the meaning given in paragraph 2(1) of Schedule 25A to those Regulations.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/2/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/110/regulation/19/2/b" id="regulation-19-2-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the Welsh language text insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="main" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="regulation" Format="default" NumberFormat="default">
<P2>
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Rhaid i’r cynllun ansawdd aer gynnwys asesiad o’r angen i gymhwyso gwerthoedd terfyn allyriadau is ar gyfer gweithfeydd hylosgi canolig unigol na’r rhai a nodir yng Nghyfarwyddeb 2015/2193/EU Senedd Ewrop a’r Cyngor ar 25 Tachwedd 2015 ar gyfyngu ar allyriadau llygryddion penodol i’r aer o weithfeydd hylosgi canolig (“y Gyfarwyddeb Gweithfeydd Hylosgi Canolig”) ar yr amod, ym marn Gweinidogion Cymru, y byddai cymhwyso gwerthoedd terfyn allyriadau o’r fath yn cyfrannu’n effeithiol at welliant amlwg yn ansawdd yr aer.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>10</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Wrth ystyried a ddylid gosod gwerthoedd terfyn allyriadau is, rhaid i Weinidogion Cymru ystyried canlyniadau’r cyfnewid gwybodaeth y cyfeirir ato yn Erthygl 6(10) o’r Gyfarwyddeb Gweithfeydd Hylosgi Canolig.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>11</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Yn y rheoliad hwn—</Text>
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>mae i “gwerthoedd terfyn allyriadau” yr un ystyr ag a roddir i “emission limit values” ym mharagraff 5 o Atodlen 25A i Reoliadau Trwyddedu Amgylcheddol (Cymru a Lloegr) 2016; ac</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para>
<Text>mae i “gweithfeydd hylosgi canolig” yr un ystyr ag a roddir i “medium combustion plants” ym mharagraff 2(1) o Atodlen 25A i’r Rheoliadau hynny.</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></Body></Secondary></Legislation>
