xmls: <Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/321" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/321" NumberOfProvisions="29" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2023-07-05"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/321/body" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/321/body" NumberOfProvisions="29" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2018-04-09"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/321/part/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/321/part/1" NumberOfProvisions="19" id="part-1" RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2018-04-09"><Number>PART 1</Number><Title>General</Title><P1group RestrictExtent="E+W+S+N.I." RestrictStartDate="2018-04-09"><Title>Amendment of the Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations 2013</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/321/regulation/6" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/321/regulation/6" id="regulation-6"><Pnumber><CommentaryRef Ref="key-12af6a"/>6</Pnumber><P1para><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/321/regulation/6/1" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/321/regulation/6/1" id="regulation-6-1"><Pnumber>1</Pnumber><P2para><Text>Regulation 14 of the Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations 2013<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/> is amended as follows.</Text></P2para></P2><P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/321/regulation/6/2" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/321/regulation/6/2" id="regulation-6-2"><Pnumber>2</Pnumber><P2para><Text>In paragraph (6) of that regulation, omit sub-paragraph (d) and for sub-paragraph (g) substitute—</Text><BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double"><P3><Pnumber>g</Pnumber><P3para><Text>Article 9 of Regulation (EU) No 996/2010 of the European Parliament and of the Council on the investigation and prevention of accidents and incidents in civil aviation and repealing <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/1994/0056" id="c00002" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="1994" Number="0056">Directive 94/56/EC</Citation>.</Text></P3para></P3></BlockAmendment></P2para></P2></P1para></P1></P1group></Part></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396" NumberOfProvisions="27" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/body" NumberOfProvisions="27"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Landfill Tax Regulations 1996</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/19/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/19" id="regulation-19">
<Pnumber>19</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 21 (entitlement to credit)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/19/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/19/a" id="regulation-19-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (4)(c), omit “taxable” and after “has been made”, insert “at a UK landfill site”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/19/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/19/b" id="regulation-19-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (7), after the definition of “screening bund”, omit the full stop, substitute a semi-colon and insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“UK landfill site” means—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>a landfill site;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>a landfill site in respect of which there is an authorisation in force at the time of the disposal within the meaning of section 12(1) of the Landfill Tax (Scotland) Act 2014<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/>; or</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>an authorised landfill site within the meaning of section 5 of the Landfill Disposals Tax (Wales) Act 2017<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/>.</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/19/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/19/c" id="regulation-19-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (7), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>For the purposes of paragraph (4)(c) only, “disposal” shall be construed—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>when that disposal takes place in England or Northern Ireland, in accordance with the definition in regulation 2(1);</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in Scotland, in accordance with section 4 of the Landfill Tax (Scotland) Act 2014; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in Wales, in accordance with section 4 of the Landfill Disposals Tax (Wales) Act 2017.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396" NumberOfProvisions="27" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/body" NumberOfProvisions="27"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Landfill Tax Regulations 1996</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/4" id="regulation-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 2 (interpretation), in paragraph (1)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/4/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/4/a" id="regulation-4-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit the definition of “accounting period” and substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“accounting period” has the meaning given in regulation 10;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/4/b" id="regulation-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for the definition of “disposal”, substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“disposal” and “disposed of” shall be construed in accordance with section 40A of the Act (including any order made under that section or section 46 of the Act) (save in regulation 21(4)(c));</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/4/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/4/c" id="regulation-4-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “disposal”, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“environmental regulator” means the Environment Agency in England and the Department of Agriculture, Environment and Rural Affairs, or any agency thereof, in Northern Ireland;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/4/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/4/d" id="regulation-4-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the definition of “landfill site”, for “section 66”, substitute “section 40(4)”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396" NumberOfProvisions="27" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/body" NumberOfProvisions="27"><P1group><Title>Amendments to the Landfill Tax Regulations 1996</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/5" id="regulation-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In regulation 4 (notification of liability to be registered)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/5/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/5/a" id="regulation-5-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (1), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>A registered person who is required by section 47(3A) of the Act to notify the Commissioners of their intention to carry out taxable activities shall do so by providing the information prescribed by paragraph (6).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/5/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/5/b" id="regulation-5-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (2), after “landfill site”, add “ or place other than a landfill site”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/5/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/5/c" id="regulation-5-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraphs (2), (3) and (4), in each case, for “the notification” substitute “a notification”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/5/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/5/d" id="regulation-5-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (4), for “The”, substitute “Subject to paragraph (5), a ” and omit “after 1st August 1996”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2018/396/regulation/5/e/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2018/396/regulation/5/e" id="regulation-5-e">
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after paragraph (4), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Commissioners may allow a registered person additional time to comply with paragraph (4) in relation to a notification made under section 47(3A) of the Act.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>For the purposes of paragraph (1A), the prescribed information required from a registered person is—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>their name and address and, where applicable, company registration number;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>their contact telephone number;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>if a business, whether they are a sole trader, partnership or a company;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the address of each place other than a landfill site at which they intend to carry out taxable activities;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the details of any licence or permit issued by an environmental regulator in respect of each place;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>whether any of the intended disposals are within the scope of any published guidance issued by an environmental regulator in the form of a regulatory position statement;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>if any disposals have already taken place at any place other than a landfill site at the time of notification, the address of each place at which such disposal occurred and the volume of the material disposed of;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>a signed declaration that the information provided under the preceding sub-paragraphs is true and complete.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<P1para>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2019/1056/article/2/1/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2019/1056/article/2/1" id="article-2-1">

<P2para><Text>Section 1 of the Climate Change Act 2008 is amended as follows.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2019/1056/article/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2019/1056/article/2/2" id="article-2-2">

</P3>

</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>Directive (EU) 2019/904 of the European Parliament and of the Council on the reduction of the impact of certain plastic products on the environment<FootnoteRef Ref="f00034"/></Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
</P4para>
</P4>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/603/regulation/2/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/603/regulation/2/4" id="regulation-2-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In the Schedule, in Part 2, after paragraph 64, insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment TargetSubClass="unknown" Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" Format="double"><P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">64A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Pollution Prevention and Control (Designation of Directives) (England and Wales) Order 2019<FootnoteRef Ref="f00035"/>.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

law.title: Greater Manchester Combined Authority (Fire and Rescue Functions) Order

the prsr act 2011.title: Police Reform and Social Responsibility Act 2011

xmls:
<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641" NumberOfProvisions="20" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/body" NumberOfProvisions="20"><P1group><Title>Amendment of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority (Fire and Rescue Functions) Order 2017</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/2" id="article-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>The Greater Manchester Combined Authority (Fire and Rescue Functions) Order 2017<FootnoteRef Ref="f00003"/> is amended as set out in articles 3 to 10.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of article 2</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/3/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/3" id="article-3">
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In article 2 (interpretation)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/3/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/3/a" id="article-3-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “the LDEDC Act 2009” insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the PRSR Act 2011” means the Police Reform and Social Responsibility Act 2011<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/3/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/3/b" id="article-3-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “the Area” insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the chief fire officer” means the person with responsibility for managing the fire and rescue service;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/3/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/3/c" id="article-3-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>after the definition of “constituent councils” insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the deputy mayor for policing and crime” means the deputy mayor for policing and crime for the Area<FootnoteRef Ref="f00005"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“financial year” means a period of 12 months beginning with 1st April;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/3/d/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/3/d" id="article-3-d">
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>at the end insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“the Police, Fire and Crime Panel” means the police and crime panel for the Area<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“proposed allocation of budget” has the meaning given in article 5C(1)</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of article 5</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/4/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/4" id="article-4">
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In article 5 (arrangements for exercise of fire and rescue functions), after paragraph (1) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Mayor may arrange under section 107D(3) of the LDEDC Act 2009 for the deputy mayor for policing and crime to exercise fire and rescue functions other than any of the functions to which article 6 applies.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1B</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Where the Mayor makes arrangements described in paragraph (1A), the deputy mayor for policing and crime may, for the purposes of the exercise of fire and rescue functions, do anything that the GMCA may do under section 113A of the LDEDC Act 2009.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1C</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Mayor may not make arrangements described in paragraph (1A), and arrangements described in paragraph (2), to have effect concurrently.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Insertion of articles 5A to 5D</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/5" id="article-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After article 5 insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P1group>
<Title>Police, Fire and Crime Panel: oversight functions in relation to fire and rescue functions</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">5A</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Police, Fire and Crime Panel has oversight functions<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/> in relation to—</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>any fire and rescue functions of the Mayor that are exercisable by the deputy mayor for policing and crime as a result of arrangements described in article 5(1A); and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>fire and rescue functions exercisable by the Mayor,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<Text>as set out in articles 5B to 5D, and by virtue of Schedule 1.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The modifications of enactments set out in Schedule 1 have effect for the purposes of the application of those enactments to the GMCA as fire and rescue authority.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Police, Fire and Crime Panel: scrutiny of the local risk plan</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">5B</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Before issuing a local risk plan or varying the GMCA’s priorities and objectives set out in a local risk plan, the Mayor must—</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>consult the chief fire officer in preparing the draft plan, or the draft variation;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>send the draft priorities and objectives, or the draft variation of the priorities and objectives, to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>have regard to any report or recommendations made by the Police, Fire and Crime Panel in relation to the draft priorities and objectives, or the draft variation of the priorities and objectives, in accordance with section 28(3) of the PRSR Act 2011 <FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/>; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>as soon as reasonably practicable, give the Police, Fire and Crime Panel a response to any such report or recommendations, and publish the response in such manner as the Mayor considers appropriate.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In complying with paragraph (1)(b), the Mayor must ensure that the Police, Fire and Crime Panel has a reasonable amount of time to consider the draft priorities and objectives, or the draft variation of the priorities and objectives, and to produce its report or recommendations.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Mayor must consult the chief fire officer before issuing or varying a local risk plan if, and to the extent that, the priorities and objectives in the plan or variation are different from the draft prepared in accordance with paragraph (1).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Mayor must keep the priorities and objectives in the local risk plan under review and, in particular, review them in the light of any report or recommendations made to the Mayor by the Police, Fire and Crime Panel under section 28(4) of the PRSR Act 2011.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>If the Mayor issues or varies a local risk plan, the Mayor must—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>send a copy of the issued local risk plan, or the variation, to the chief fire officer; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>publish a copy of the issued plan, or the variation, in such manner as the Mayor considers appropriate.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The duty under paragraph (5) to send or publish a copy of the variation may instead be satisfied by sending or publishing a copy of the plan as varied.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this article “priorities and objectives” means the GMCA’s priorities and objectives in connection with the discharge of the GMCA’s functions as a fire and rescue authority, as required to be set out in the local risk plan.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Mayor to notify Police, Fire and Crime Panel of proposed allocation of budget for fire and rescue functions</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">5C</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Mayor must, in each financial year, notify the Police, Fire and Crime Panel of the Mayor’s proposed allocation of the draft budget for fire and rescue functions in relation to the following financial year (“proposed allocation of budget”).</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The notification described in paragraph (1) must be given before the date on which the GMCA determines whether to approve the Mayor’s annual budget in relation to the following financial year, and the Police, Fire and Crime Panel must have a reasonable amount of time to review the proposed allocation of budget before the GMCA makes its determination.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Police, Fire and Crime Panel to review proposed allocation of budget for fire and rescue functions</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">5D</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Police, Fire and Crime Panel must review any proposed allocation of budget notified to it under article 5C.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Police, Fire and Crime Panel must make a report to the Mayor in relation to the proposed allocation of budget.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Where the Police, Fire and Crime Panel makes a report described in paragraph (2), the Mayor must—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>have regard to the report and to any recommendations made in it;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>provide the Police, Fire and Crime Panel with a response to the report and any recommendations made in it; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>publish the response in such manner as is required by the Police, Fire and Crime Panel.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of article 6</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/6" id="article-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In article 6 (fire and rescue functions excluded from the power to make arrangements)—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/6/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/6/a" id="article-6-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>for paragraph (3)(a) substitute—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>appointing, suspending, or dismissing, the chief fire officer;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>,</AppendText>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/6/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/6/b" id="article-6-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (3)(b) and (c), for “that person” in both places it appears substitute “the chief fire officer”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of the heading to article 14</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/7" id="article-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>For the heading to article 14 substitute “Schedule 2”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Amendment of article 14</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/8/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/8" id="article-8">
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>In article 14 for “The Schedule” substitute “Schedule 2”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group><P1group><Title>Insertion of Schedule 1</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2020/641/article/9/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2020/641/article/9" id="article-9">
<Pnumber>9</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Before Schedule 2 (as renumbered), insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="schedule" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary">
<Schedule>
<Number>SCHEDULE 1</Number>
<TitleBlock>
<Title>Modification of enactments in their application to the GMCA as fire and rescue authority: oversight functions of the Police, Fire and Crime Panel</Title>
</TitleBlock>
<Reference>Article 5A</Reference>
<ScheduleBody>
<Part>
<Number>PART<Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>1</Number><Title>Primary legislation</Title>
<P1group>
<Title>Local Government Finance Act 1988</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Local Government Finance Act 1988<FootnoteRef Ref="f00009"/> is modified as follows.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Section 114<FootnoteRef Ref="f00010"/> (functions of responsible officer as regards reports) applies, in any case where the report prepared under subsection (2) or (3) of that section relates to the fire and rescue functions of the GMCA, as if subsection (4) included a requirement to provide a copy of the report to each member of the Police, Fire and Crime Panel.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Section 115<FootnoteRef Ref="f00011"/> (authority’s duties as regards reports) applies, in any case where a report prepared by the Mayor of the GMCA under subsection (1E) of that section relates to the fire and rescue functions of the GMCA, as if it included a requirement to provide a copy of the report to each member of the Police, Fire and Crime Panel.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Local Government and Housing Act 1989</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Local Government and Housing Act 1989 is modified as follows.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Section 4<FootnoteRef Ref="f00012"/> (designation and reports of head of paid service) applies, in any case where the report prepared under subsection (2) of that section relates to the fire and rescue functions of the GMCA, as if subsection (4) included a requirement to provide a copy of the report to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Section 5<FootnoteRef Ref="f00013"/> (designation and reports of monitoring officer) applies, in any case where the report prepared under that section relates to the fire and rescue functions of the GMCA, as if subsection (3)(b) included a requirement to provide a copy of the report to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Fire and Rescue Services Act 2004</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Section 28 (inspectors) of the FRS Act 2004<FootnoteRef Ref="f00014"/><Character Name="NonBreakingSpace"/>applies as if for subsections (A6) to (A8) there were substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>A6</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>When carrying out an inspection under subsection (A3) of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority as fire and rescue authority, an English inspector must not review or scrutinise decisions made, or other action taken, by the fire and rescue authority in connection with the discharge of an excluded function.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>A7</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>For the purposes of subsection (A6), the following are excluded functions—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the function of preparing the priorities and objectives of the local risk plan and the fire and rescue declaration;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the function of allocating budget for fire and rescue functions;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>any function specified in article 26 of the Fire and Rescue Authority (Police and Crime Commissioner) (Application of Local Policing Provisions, Inspection, Powers to Trade and Consequential Amendments) Order 2017<FootnoteRef Ref="f00015"/>.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>A8</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In subsection (A7), “local risk plan” has the meaning given in article 2 of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority (Fire and Rescue Functions) Order 2017.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Local Democracy, Economic Development and Construction Act 2009</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Paragraph 1(3) of Schedule 5A to the Local Democracy, Economic Development and Construction Act 2009<FootnoteRef Ref="f00016"/> applies as if, at the end of each of paragraphs (a) and (b), there were inserted “other than fire and rescue functions of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority in respect of which the police and crime panel has oversight functions”.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Police Reform and Social Responsibility Act 2011</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">5</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The PRSR Act 2011 is modified as follows.</Text></P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Section 12(2) to (5) (annual reports) applies as if—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>references to an elected local policing body in subsections (2) and (4) were references to the GMCA as fire and rescue authority;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the reference to the elected local policing body in subsection (3) were to the Mayor;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>references to an annual report were to a fire and rescue declaration;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>reference to the relevant police and crime panel (within the meaning of that Act) were to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Section 13 (information for police and crime panels) applies as if—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>references to an elected local policing body were to the GMCA as fire and rescue authority;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>references to the relevant police and crime panel (within the meaning of that Act) were to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Section 17(2), (3) and (4) (duties when carrying out functions) applies as if—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in subsection (2)—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the reference to an elected local policing body were to the GMCA as fire and rescue authority;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the reference to the relevant police and crime panel (within the meaning of that Act) were to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the reference to any report or recommendations made by the panel on the annual report for the previous financial year were to any report or recommendations made by the Police, Fire and Crime Panel for the previous financial year with respect to the fire and rescue declaration;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in subsection (3) and (4), references to an elected local policing body were to the GMCA as fire and rescue authority.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Section 28<FootnoteRef Ref="f00017"/> (police and crime panels outside London) applies as if—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>subsection (1) were omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>references to—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>a police and crime panel (within the meaning of that Act);</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>a police and crime panel for a police area; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the police and crime panel for a police area in England,</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<Text>were to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>after subsection (1), there were inserted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1C</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Subsection (1D) applies if the person who is the mayor for a police area also exercises for that area—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the functions of a police and crime commissioner, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>fire and rescue functions.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1D</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The police and crime panel for the police area is to be known as “the Police, Fire and Crime Panel”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in subsection (2), the reference to the functions of the police and crime commissioner for that police area were to the fire and rescue functions of the GMCA;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>for subsection (3) there were substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Police, Fire and Crime Panel must—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>review any draft priorities and objectives, or the draft variation of the priorities and objectives, given to the panel by the Mayor in accordance with article 5B of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority (Fire and Rescue Functions) Order 2017, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>make a report or recommendations to the Mayor on the draft priorities and objectives, or the draft variation of the priorities and objectives.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3A</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>For the purposes of subsection (3)—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>“priorities and objectives” means the Greater Manchester Combined Authority’s priorities and objectives in connection with the discharge of that authority’s functions as a fire and rescue authority, as required to be set out in that authority’s local risk plan, and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>“local risk plan” has the meaning given in article 2 of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority (Fire and Rescue Functions) Order 2017.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>f</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in subsection (4)—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>references to an annual report were to a fire and rescue declaration;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>references to the police and crime commissioner were to the Mayor;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>g</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>subsection (5) were omitted;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>h</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in subsection (6)—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>for paragraph (a) there were substituted</Text><BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>review or scrutinise decisions made, or other action taken, by the Greater Manchester Combined Authority, the Mayor or the deputy mayor for policing and crime of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority, or any other person in the exercise of fire and rescue functions pursuant to arrangements made under section 107D(3) of the Act in connection with the discharge of those fire and rescue functions,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>in paragraph (b), references to the relevant police and crime commissioner were to whichever of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority, the Mayor, and the deputy mayor for policing and crime of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority exercises fire and rescue functions;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>in the words following paragraph (b), “or by Schedule 1, 5 or 8” were omitted;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in subsection (7), references to the relevant police and crime commissioner were to whichever of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority, the Mayor, and the deputy mayor for policing and crime exercises fire and rescue functions;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>j</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in subsection (8), reference to the police area were to the Area;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>k</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>subsection (10) were omitted.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Section 29<FootnoteRef Ref="f00018"/> (power to require attendance and information) applies as if the modifications made by paragraph 24 of Schedule 1 to the Greater Manchester Combined Authority (Transfer of Police and Crime Commissioner Functions to the Mayor) Order 2017 did not apply, and as if—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>for subsection (1) there were substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Police, Fire and Crime Panel of the Greater Manchester Combined Authority (“the GMCA”) may require the following to attend before it (at reasonable notice) to answer any question which appears to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel to be necessary in order for it to carry out its oversight functions—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the Mayor of the GMCA,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the deputy mayor for policing and crime for the GMCA,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>staff of the GMCA deployed wholly or partly in relation to the GMCA’s fire and rescue functions,</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>any member of the GMCA who exercises fire and rescue functions by virtue of arrangements made under section 107D(3) of the Local Democracy, Economic Development and Construction Act 2009.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>for subsection (2) there were substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Nothing in subsection (1) requires a person mentioned paragraphs (a) to (d) of that subsection to give any evidence, or produce any document, which discloses advice given by them to any other person mentioned in paragraphs (a), (b) or (d).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in subsection (3)—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>references to a police and crime panel (within the meaning of that Act) were to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>references to the relevant police and crime commissioner were to the Mayor;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>for subsections (4) and (5) there were substituted—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>4</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>A person mentioned in paragraph (a), (b), (c) or (d) of subsection (1) must comply with any requirement imposed on them in accordance with subsection (1) or (3).</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in subsection (6)—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>references to a police and crime panel were to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>reference to the relevant police and crime commissioner were to the Mayor or the deputy mayor for policing and crime;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>reference to the relevant chief constable were to the chief fire officer for the Area.</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In Schedule 1, paragraph 9<FootnoteRef Ref="f00019"/> (scrutiny of senior appointments) applies as if the modification made by paragraph 32(e) of Schedule 1 to the Greater Manchester Combined Authority (Transfer of Police and Crime Commissioner Functions to the Mayor) Order 2017 did not apply, and as if—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>references to the police and crime commissioner were to the Mayor;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>references to the police and crime panel, or to the relevant police and crime panel, were to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the reference to criteria in sub-paragraph (2)(b) included criteria relevant to the exercise, by the candidate, of fire and rescue functions.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>8</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In Schedule 6—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>paragraph 4(6) (membership and status)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00020"/> applies as if the reference to functions included functions conferred by, or by virtue of, this Order;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>paragraph 27 (special functions) applies as if the special functions mentioned in sub-paragraph (2) of that paragraph included the following functions conferred on the Police, Fire and Crime Panel by, or by virtue of, this Order—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>scrutiny of the priorities and objectives of the local risk plan;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>scrutiny of the fire and rescue declaration;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>scrutiny of the allocation of budget;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>scrutiny of the appointment of a chief fire officer;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in paragraph 32A<FootnoteRef Ref="f00021"/> (duty to produce panel with fire and rescue expertise), sub-paragraphs (2) to (4) apply in relation to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</Part>
<Part>
<Number>PART 2</Number><Title>Secondary legislation</Title>
<P1group>
<Title>Fire and Rescue Authority (Police and Crime Commissioner) (Application of Local Policing Provisions, Inspection, Powers to Trade and Consequential Amendments) Order 2017</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">6</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Articles 3 to 23 of the Fire and Rescue Authority (Police and Crime Commissioner) (Application of Local Policing Provisions, Inspection, Powers to Trade and Consequential Amendments) Order 2017 apply as if—</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>references to “the Authority”, other than the reference in article 21(3)(c), were to the Mayor in the exercise of the fire and rescue functions;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>references to the police and crime panel (within the meaning of that Order) were to the Police, Fire and Crime Panel;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in article 6(8) (panel to review and report on proposed appointment of chief fire officer)—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>in sub-paragraph (a) for “ordinary election of a police and crime commissioner under section 50 of the Police Reform and Social Responsibility Act 2011” there were substituted “election for the return of the Mayor”;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>in sub-paragraph (b), for “police and crime commissioner” there were substituted “Mayor”, and for “that Act” there were substituted “the Police Reform and Social Responsibility Act 2011”;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>in article 21(3)(c) (response to representations regarding proposal to dismiss chief fire officer) the reference to the head of the Authority’s paid service were reference to the GMCA’s head of paid service.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</Part>
</ScheduleBody>
</Schedule>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

<Legislation xmlns="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2021/1420/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2021/1420" NumberOfProvisions="24" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/namespaces/legislation http://www.legislation.gov.uk/schema/legislation.xsd" SchemaVersion="1.0"><Secondary><Body DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2021/1420/body/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2021/1420/body" NumberOfProvisions="24"><Part DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2021/1420/part/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2021/1420/part/2" NumberOfProvisions="20" id="part-2"><Number>PART 2</Number><Title>Amendment of the Renewable Transport Fuel Obligations Order 2007</Title><P1group><Title>Insertion of Schedules 2 and 3</Title><P1 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/uksi/2021/1420/article/14/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/uksi/2021/1420/article/14" id="article-14">
<Pnumber>14</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>After Schedule 1 (as so renumbered) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="schedule" Format="double" TargetClass="secondary" TargetSubClass="order">
<Schedule>
<Number>SCHEDULE 2</Number>
<TitleBlock>
<Title>Land criteria</Title>
</TitleBlock>
<Reference>Article 2(1)</Reference>

<ScheduleBody>
<P1group>
<Title>Meeting the land criteria</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>A relevant feedstock meets the land criteria if the renewable transport fuel supplier provides evidence, by reference to the guidance published by the Administrator under article 15(1)(m), that satisfies the Administrator that the relevant feedstock was not obtained from land of a description falling within paragraphs 2 to 4, subject to the exceptions set out in those paragraphs.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Prohibited land categories</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Land with a high biodiversity value that had one of the following statuses in or after January 2008, whether or not the land continues to have that status—</Text>
<P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>primary forest or other wooded land of native species, where there is no clearly visible indication of human activity and the ecological processes are not significantly disturbed;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>land not falling within sub-paragraph (a) which is, or which has been identified as, highly biodiverse forest or other wooded land that is species-rich and not degraded, unless—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the land is designated for nature protection purposes; and</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>evidence is provided that satisfies the Administrator that the production of the relevant feedstock did not interfere with the purposes for which the land is designated for nature protection purposes;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>land not falling within sub-paragraphs (a) or (b) which is designated for nature protection purposes, including for the protection of rare, threatened or endangered ecosystems or species, unless evidence is provided that satisfies the Administrator that the production of the relevant feedstock did not interfere with the purposes for which the land is designated for nature protection purposes;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>highly biodiverse grassland spanning more than one hectare that is—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>natural grassland that would remain as grassland and that maintains its natural species composition and ecological characteristics and processes in the absence of human intervention; or</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>non-natural grassland that would cease to be grassland in the absence of human intervention and that is species-rich and not degraded and which has been identified as being highly biodiverse, unless evidence is provided that satisfies the Administrator that the harvesting of the raw material is necessary to preserve its status as highly biodiverse grassland.</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<P2para><Text>Land with high-carbon stock that had one of the following statuses at any time in January 2008 and which no longer has that status—</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>wetlands, where the land is covered with, or saturated by, water permanently or for a significant part of the year;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>continuously forested areas spanning more than one hectare with trees higher than five metres and a canopy cover of more than 30%, or trees able to reach those thresholds in situ;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>land spanning more than one hectare with trees higher than five metres and a canopy cover of between 10% and 30%, or trees able to reach those thresholds in situ, unless evidence is provided that satisfies the Administrator that the GHG emission saving from the use of the renewable transport fuel concerned is equal to or greater than the minimum GHG emission saving applicable to the fuel at the time when it is used, as set out in Schedule 1.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>But this paragraph does not apply if, at the time the relevant feedstock was harvested, the land concerned had the same status as it had in January 2008.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">4</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Land that was peatland at any time in January 2008, unless evidence is provided that satisfies the Administrator that the cultivation and harvesting of the raw material concerned did not involve drainage of previously undrained soil.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</ScheduleBody>
</Schedule>
<Schedule>
<Number>SCHEDULE 3</Number>
<TitleBlock>
<Title>Forest criteria</Title>
</TitleBlock>
<Reference>Article 2(1)</Reference>

<ScheduleBody>
<P1group>
<Title>Meeting the forest criteria</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">1</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<Text>Forest biomass meets the forest criteria if the renewable transport fuel supplier provides evidence, by reference to the guidance published by the Administrator under article 15(1)(m), that satisfies the Administrator that the requirements in paragraphs 2 and 3 are met, subject to the exceptions set out in those paragraphs.</Text>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Legal framework</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">2</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<P2para><Text>The country in which the forest biomass was harvested has in place a legal framework, including monitoring and enforcement systems, to ensure that—</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the forest biomass has been harvested in accordance with applicable laws;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the area of harvesting of the forest biomass is subject to forest regeneration, and for this purpose “<Term>forest regeneration</Term>” means the re-establishment of a forest stand by natural or artificial means following the removal of the previous stand by felling or as a result of natural causes, including fire or storm;</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the forest biomass has not been harvested from wetlands, peatlands or from a protected area, unless—</Text>
<P4>
<Pnumber>i</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the land is designated for nature protection purposes; and</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>ii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the production of the relevant feedstock did not interfere with the purposes for which the land is designated for nature protection purposes;</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the harvesting of the forest biomass has been carried out with consideration for the maintenance of, and with the aim of minimising any decline in, soil quality and biodiversity; and</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>e</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>the harvesting of the forest biomass has been carried out in a manner that maintains or improves the long-term production capacity of the forest from which it was harvested.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>But if evidence is not available to demonstrate that the legal framework described in sub-paragraph (1) is in place in the country concerned, then the Administrator must be satisfied that management systems at the forest sourcing area level were in place in that country to ensure that the conditions in sub-paragraph (1)(a) to (e) were met.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>3</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>In this Schedule, “<Term>sourcing area</Term>” means the geographically defined area from which the forest biomass is sourced, from which reliable and independent information is available to show that the conditions in sub-paragraph (1)(a) to (e) were met, and where conditions are sufficiently homogeneous to evaluate the risk of the sustainability and legality characteristics of the forest biomass.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
<P1group>
<Title>Land-use, land-use change and forestry</Title>
<P1>
<Pnumber PuncAfter=".">3</Pnumber>
<P1para>
<P2>
<Pnumber>1</Pnumber>

<P2para><Text>The country or regional economic integration organisation of origin of the forest biomass is a party to the 2015 Paris Agreement adopted under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change<FootnoteRef Ref="f00004"/> and—</Text><P3>
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>has submitted a nationally determined contribution (“<Term>NDC</Term>”) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change, covering emissions and removals from agriculture, forestry and land use which ensures that changes in carbon stock associated with forest biomass harvest are counted towards the country’s commitment to reduce or limit GHG emissions as specified in the NDC; or</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
<P3>
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>has laws in place, which are applicable in the area of the harvesting, and which regulate the harvesting of forest biomass, to conserve and enhance carbon stocks and sinks, and which require that evidence is provided to show that reported land-use, land-use change and forestry-sector emissions do not exceed removals.</Text>
</P3para>
</P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2>
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>But if evidence is not available to demonstrate that the requirement in sub-paragraph (1) is satisfied, then the Administrator must be satisfied that management systems were in place at the forest sourcing area level to ensure that carbon stocks and sink levels in the forest are maintained or increased over the long-term.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</P1para>
</P1>
</P1group>
</ScheduleBody>
</Schedule>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>.</AppendText>
</P1para>
</P1></P1group></Part></Body></Secondary></Legislation>

Amendments to Part 1 (preliminary), article 2 (interpretation) 3 In article 2 (interpretation) of Part 1 (preliminary) omit the existing definition of “book of reference” and replace with ““book of reference” means the documents of that description which are certified by the Secretary of State as the book of reference and the supplemental book of reference under article 45 for the purposes of this Order;”. 4 In article 2 (interpretation) of Part 1 (preliminary) for ““Order land” means the land which is required for, or is required to facilitate, or is incidental to, or is affected by, the authorised development shown edged red on the land plans and described in the book of reference;” substitute ““Order land” means the land which is required for, or is required to facilitate, or is incidental to, or is affected by, the authorised development shown edged red on the land plans and shown shaded orange on the land plans and described in the book of reference;”. 5 In article 2 (interpretation) of Part 1 (preliminary) before ““Teesworks Limited” insert ““supplemental land” means the land which is required for, or is required to facilitate, or is incidental to, or is affected by, the authorised development shown shaded orange on the land plans and described in the book of reference;”. Amendment to Part 4 (supplemental powers) 6 In Part 4 (supplemental powers), article 20 (authority to survey and investigate the land) after paragraph (6) insert— 7 The undertaker may not rely upon any powers under this article 20 in respect of the supplemental land. . Amendments to Part 5 (powers of acquisition) 7 In Part 5 (powers of acquisition), before article 22 insert— Supplemental land 21A. — The undertaker may not compulsorily acquire any interest in or rights over or take temporary possession of any part of the supplemental land pursuant to articles 22, 25, 30, 31, 32 and 33. . 8 In Part 5 (powers of acquisition), article 22 (compulsory acquisition of land), paragraph (1) for “The undertaker may” substitute “Subject to article 21A (supplemental land), the undertaker may”. 9 In Part 5 (powers of acquisition), article 25 (compulsory acquisition of rights etc.), paragraph (1) after “subject to the following paragraphs of this article,” insert— and article 21A (supplemental land) . 10 In Part 5 (powers of acquisition), article 30 (rights under or over streets), paragraph (1) for “The undertaker may” substitute “Subject to article 21A (supplemental land), the undertaker may”. 11 In Part 5 (powers of acquisition), article 31 (Temporary use of land for carrying out the authorised development), paragraph 1 for “The undertaker may” substitute “Subject to article 21A (supplemental land), the undertaker may”. 12 In Part 5 (powers of acquisition), article 32 (Temporary use of land for maintaining the authorised development), paragraph (1) after “Subject to paragraph (2),” insert “and article 21A (supplemental land),”. 13 In Part 5 (powers of acquisition), article 33 (Statutory undertakers), after “Subject to the provisions of Schedule 12 (protective provisions)” insert “and article 21A (supplementary land)”. Amendment to Schedule 1 (authorised development) 14 In Schedule 1 (authorised development), before Work No. 7 insert— Work No. 6A – above ground installations required to facilitate Work No. 6, comprising— a above and below ground piping; b a PIG launcher; c remotely operated valves and valve bypass; and d instrumentation and electrical kiosk. 15 In Schedule 1 (authorised development), Work No. 9 is amended as follows— a after paragraph (e) “Work No. 9E – Saltholme laydown;” omit “and”; b after paragraph (f) “Work No. 9F – Haverton Hill laydown” for “.” substitute “; and”; and c after paragraph (f) “Work No. 9F – Haverton Hill laydown; and” insert— g Work No. 9G – temporary construction laydown area. . Amendment to Schedule 2 (requirements) 16 In Schedule 2 (requirements) paragraph 3 (detailed design) sub-paragraph (4) is amended as follows— a at the end of sub-paragraph (b) omit “and”; b at the end of sub-paragraph (c) for “.” substitute “; and”; and c after sub-paragraph (c) insert— d the siting and external appearance of cable support structures. <Pnumber>1</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>The Environmental Damage (Prevention and Remediation) (Wales) Regulations 2009 are amended as follows.</Text>

<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/2/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/2" id="regulation-2-2">
<Pnumber>2</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 2(1) (interpretation), in the appropriate place in alphabetical order insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“baseline” (“<Emphasis>gwaelodlin</Emphasis>”) means the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured for the purposes of the Territorial Sea Act 1987<FootnoteRef Ref="f00006"/>;</Text>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>;</AppendText>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>“marine waters” (“dyfroedd morol”) means waters classified as marine waters pursuant to Directive <Citation URI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/european/directive/2008/0056" id="c00001" Class="EuropeanUnionDirective" Year="2008" Number="56">2008/56/<Acronym Expansion="European Community">EC</Acronym></Citation> of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing a framework for Community action in the field of marine environmental policy<FootnoteRef Ref="f00007"/>;</Text>

<P3para>
<Text>in paragraph (1)—</Text>
<P4 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/3/a/i/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/3/a/i" id="regulation-2-3-a-i">

<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">

<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>

<P3>
<Pnumber>d</Pnumber>
<P3para><Text>land,</Text>

<UnorderedList Decoration="none" Class="Definition">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>All marine waters within any of the following descriptions—</Text>
<OrderedList Decoration="parens" Type="alpha">
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>marine waters up to one nautical mile seaward from the baseline in Wales so far as not already addressed as damage to water;</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
<ListItem>
<Para><Text>marine waters from one nautical mile seaward from the baseline in Wales, extending out to 12 nautical miles from the baseline in Wales</Text></Para>
</ListItem>
</OrderedList>
</Para>
</ListItem>
</UnorderedList>
</BlockAmendment>
<AppendText>; and</AppendText>
</P4para></P4>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/4/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/4/b" id="regulation-2-4-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>omit paragraph (2).</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/5/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/5" id="regulation-2-5">
<Pnumber>5</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>After regulation 8(1) (exemptions) insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P2>
<Pnumber>1A</Pnumber>
<P2para><Text>Paragraph (1) applies in relation to damage to marine waters as if, in sub-paragraph (a), for “the coming into force of these Regulations” there were substituted “19 July 2015”.</Text>
</P2para>
</P2>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/6/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/6" id="regulation-2-6">
<Pnumber>6</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 10 (enforcing authorities under the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2010)<FootnoteRef Ref="f00008"/> omit paragraph (3)(b)(iii) and insert—</Text>
<BlockAmendment Context="unknown" TargetClass="unknown" TargetSubClass="unknown" Format="double">
<P4>
<Pnumber>iii</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the Welsh Ministers, if the damage is to marine waters; and</Text></P4para>
</P4>
<P4>
<Pnumber>iv</Pnumber>
<P4para><Text>the Natural Resources Body for Wales, if the damage is to natural habitats or protected species or a site of special scientific interest.</Text></P4para>
</P4>
</BlockAmendment>
</P2para>
</P2>
<P2 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/7/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/7" id="regulation-2-7">
<Pnumber>7</Pnumber>
<P2para>
<Text>In regulation 11(1) (enforcing authorities in other cases) after the entry in the table “Damage to water—” create a new row and insert—</Text>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/7/a/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/7/a" id="regulation-2-7-a">
<Pnumber>a</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the first column of the table (Type of environmental damage) “Damage to marine waters—”;</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/7/b/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/7/b" id="regulation-2-7-b">
<Pnumber>b</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the corresponding entry in the second column (Area of damage) insert “All marine waters out to 12 nautical miles from the baseline in Wales”; and</Text>
</P3para></P3>
<P3 DocumentURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/7/c/made" IdURI="http://www.legislation.gov.uk/id/wsi/2015/1394/regulation/2/7/c" id="regulation-2-7-c">
<Pnumber>c</Pnumber>
<P3para>
<Text>in the corresponding entry in the third column (Enforcing authority) insert “the Welsh Ministers”.</Text>
</P3para></P3>
</P2para>
</P2>
